reviews.title: Three years in and going strong.

reviews.cons: Nothing comes to mind at this time, there was very little difficulty with Acumatica during the implementation process or during the utilization of the software since go live.

reviews.title: Good processes, great potential, but poor reporting.
reviews.name: Justin D.
reviews.pros: The ability to customize and build reports, GIs, and dashboards. The processes are solid and intuitive.
reviews.cons: The out of box reports are deficient. For example the P&L which should be the most basic ERP report is way too summarized. Should have the option to run summarized or detailed without having to first build an ARM report.

reviews.title: Improve inventory management
reviews.name: Arthur S.
reviews.pros: It has become more efficient and easier to use.
reviews.cons: It takes time to learn all of the function, because it was so many.

reviews.title: Acumatica - Ready to Scale for Growth
reviews.name: Tyler S.
reviews.pros: What I like most about Acumatica ERP is the flexibility for it to adapt to our changing business needs. We have grown from a single-stream e-commerce business to a multi-channel retail distributor. Acumatica has allowed us to grow and scale with ease.
reviews.cons: It forced us to rethink our broken business processes to ensure our data integrity. We weren't ready for some of the difficult team conversations this brought up. In the end though we are in a much better place.

reviews.title: Loving the ability to continuously i.prove!

reviews.cons: How often have to upgrade our systems. The integration with our wms system is costly and difficult to get updated.

reviews.title: Acumatica Experience
reviews.name: Sharon W.
reviews.pros: User friendly, easy to train others, reporting and dashboards. Add ons, such as AcuContainer and Velixo
reviews.cons: Provide more training for behind the scenes, customer service wait times. We need faster response time from our provider.

reviews.title: The developer-friendly erp

reviews.title: A step into the future.
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: SAP HANA, or Netweaver over HANA DB (HDB) is a step into the future. Before this concept of in-memory computing and memory storage (without reading the disk all the time), some reports took very long to load. Now you can get access to a larger piece of data in seconds. HANA also brings BW to another level of real time reporting, even detailed information can be shown in no time, its very fast. The way we build views by using the HANA Modeler is very simple but yet powerful, you can do a lot with little knowledge and much more with some expertise.
reviews.cons: The tools used to work with HANA are both the HANA Studio or Eclipse with SAP HANA plugins. In my opinion, it could be better than it is; with more components, less bugs (you have to restart the environment every once in a while) and a better explanation about how the aggregation you see has been formed (Simpler than PlanViz).

reviews.title: Excellent ERP software
reviews.name: Matti P.
reviews.pros: One of the best features of SAP HANA is its high performance and real-time processing capabilities. Because it stores data in memory rather than on disk, it can handle large amounts of data and provide fast query response times. This boosts all operations of our company and minimizes downtime.
reviews.cons: Can be complex in the beginning like all ERP tools. It also has limited integration possibilities with non-SAP systems.

reviews.title: SAP Review
reviews.name: Robel T.
reviews.pros: Easy to use and understand, like the save query as it saves me alot of time in repetitive searches I have to do Reports such as: accounts payable open items, cash reconciliation, cash - open items, payment monitor, and supplier account information are easily generated and always accurate
reviews.cons: -When entering invoices with many lines in SAP, calculated tax amounts for each line sometimes changes as I add more lines in the invoice. Software sometimes has trouble calculating correct tax and gross amounts for invoices when multiple lines, cost centres, GL accounts, tax codes are entered -As I enter invoice items while entering an invoice in SAP in the view all screen, I'm unable to enter a credit memo line item. To do this I'd have to go back into basic view, enter the credit memo, then go back into view all.

reviews.title: SAP S/4HANA Cloud Review
reviews.name: Carlos Hugo Martin C.
reviews.pros: It is a platform that has become more customizable over time to suit the needs of different companies, and the Cloud version allows companies to save costs.
reviews.cons: Migrating from an on-premise environment to a cloud environment can be very complex, especially due to the complexity of the customizations, sometimes leading to the option of starting from scratch in the cloud and performing a partial migration of the on-premise environment.

reviews.title: Proper Inventory Management Software
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: The mass amount of data storage and customizable options to ensure procurement processes are running well and the in depth view of inventory management from all levels PR, PO, GRN, Goods Issued, etc. It is a great product to track your businesses success.
reviews.cons: Can be a bit laggy at times. This is to be expected with ERP software processing large volumes of data.

reviews.title: SAP ERP is still worlds leader
reviews.name: Jose Alejandro C.
reviews.pros: I've been working with SAP ERP for last 5 years, and its a very complete suite for ERP tasks, it had made easier our job, many processes have even been speed-up and upgraded lately, they are faster than before, and its an software very much customizable, and has an good support from all modules Finance, Sales.
reviews.cons: Sometimes vendors give you high hopes on this software, and sometimes it has it limits, so i've seen some users that think this was going to be an ultra speed erp, and it is not.

reviews.title: Satisfactory to my needs
reviews.name: Taylor D.
reviews.pros: The ease of use and ability to find the reporting you need in a one stop shop. My company had a very customized environment that made finding the right reports but overall you could find what you are looking for either through the search or utilizing google or AI to guide you.
reviews.cons: My company’s environment is very customized and limits what reporting is anvailable and who has access to what. As an internal auditor it made doing my daily tasks sometimes difficult.

reviews.title: My review for SAP S/4HANA CLOUD
reviews.name: Erwyn M.
reviews.pros: The software has amazing data visualisation features which enables quick analytics and reporting. Ability of the software in Swiftly processing large volumes of data in real-time.
reviews.cons: Pricing of the software is a major challenge towards implementation of the software. It is not affordable to small organisations and businesses.

reviews.title: The Features of SAP S/4HANA Cloud Have Been Exceptional
reviews.name: Mahatma A.
reviews.pros: The flexibility of SAP S/4HANA Cloud gives us value for money. I am impressed by the impressive inventory management capabilities of SAP S/4HANA Cloud.
reviews.cons: SAP S/4HANA Cloud has been working impressively for us. I do not dislike the features of SAP S/4HANA Cloud at all.

reviews.title: Great overall experience, a true SAP product, however with its own particularities.
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: Cloud-based architecture, taking away the burden of updates and maintenance. Scalability is great - adding a new entity is a walk in the park. Integration within SAP ecosystem is excellent.
reviews.cons: Customization is limited. Integration with products outside of the SAP family can be burdensome. Performance can sometimes be an issue for larger volume operations.

reviews.title: SAP S/4HANA Cloud
reviews.name: Cory R.
reviews.pros: Consolidates finance, controlling, and logistics data into one table, simplifying reporting and removing reconciliation needs.
reviews.cons: The standardized public cloud version offers restricted flexibility for highly specific business processes compared to on-premise options.

reviews.title: Effective but overly complex
reviews.name: WILLIAM E.
reviews.pros: Basically it gets the job done. I am able to accomplish what I need to accomplish. There isn't much great I can say about this software.
reviews.cons: This software is overly complex and there is nothing intuitive or user friendly about it. I find myself having to frequently refer to notes and procedures for most applications.

reviews.title: Easy to integrate but pricey
reviews.name: Lance C.
reviews.pros: Easy to integrate with other on-premise systems. Easy to configure the system. Easy to do data analytics.
reviews.cons: Expensive. Not very user-friendly. The online help features are not intuitive. Fairly long learning curve.

reviews.title: A brilliant ERP Software
reviews.name: Lucia B.
reviews.pros: SAP S/4HANA Cloud has advanced Ai capabilities which enables efficient automation of manual process and optimization of financial operations.
reviews.cons: The product is up to scratch. I have not experienced any operational issue so far.

reviews.title: Valuable ERP Cloud solution
reviews.name: Umang R.
reviews.pros: It is a very comprehensive enterprise resource planning tool and can be applied across various functions - supply chain, finance, sales, accounting etc.
reviews.cons: It takes time to implement and get trained. Proper project management is required in implementation and return on investments.

reviews.title: My experience with SAP
reviews.name: Justin C.
reviews.pros: User Interface is easy and simple to use.
reviews.cons: Been using it for over a year and no complaints thus far!

reviews.title: SAP S4 HANA Giant ERP Player
reviews.name: Sanket S.
reviews.pros: 1. It is a real time tracking software for every business process.2. It is very convenient to use once you understand flow of business processes.3. You can manage every process of your business with SAP Standard funtion processes.4. You can customize this software as much as you want. 5. SAP has a vast area of implementation. It is used in almost all types of industries to manage their business processes.
reviews.cons: 1. It is very expensive.2. It can be implemented only by big giant companies who can afford it. 3. Complexity level is high if you are new to the software. 4. Time needed for implementation is massive.5. You will be need to learn and practice if you want to handle SAP Software.

reviews.title: S/4HANA helped massively boost our manufacturing processes
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: The best thing about it is just how integrated it is. We really needed a system where we didn't have to sync a dozen different tools together to run our operations, and S/4HANA has been a lifesaver in that regard. All the modules are linked together so you don't have to worry about integration health and all the data gets synced straight away
reviews.cons: The pricing is a big disadvantage. It could be an issue for companies looking to use SAP to support their expansion.

reviews.title: Not for everyone, but if it fits your needs it is great.
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: It can do everything! It can be molded to do exactly what you need, it is safe and robust to handle the biggest of business
reviews.cons: Quote and budget wisely! Changes will soon stack up and you will be making constant implementations to make it do what you want to do, it does everything out of the box, but probable not the way you want/need it to.

reviews.title: Sap consultant
reviews.name: Osama K.
reviews.pros: Sap finance, sap data warehouse as well as daily financial operations.
reviews.cons: I feel it is expensive implementation and requires alot of effort to learn.

reviews.title: A step into the future.
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: SAP HANA, or Netweaver over HANA DB (HDB) is a step into the future. Before this concept of in-memory computing and memory storage (without reading the disk all the time), some reports took very long to load. Now you can get access to a larger piece of data in seconds. HANA also brings BW to another level of real time reporting, even detailed information can be shown in no time, its very fast. The way we build views by using the HANA Modeler is very simple but yet powerful, you can do a lot with little knowledge and much more with some expertise.
reviews.cons: The tools used to work with HANA are both the HANA Studio or Eclipse with SAP HANA plugins. In my opinion, it could be better than it is; with more components, less bugs (you have to restart the environment every once in a while) and a better explanation about how the aggregation you see has been formed (Simpler than PlanViz).

reviews.title: Excellent ERP software
reviews.name: Matti P.
reviews.pros: One of the best features of SAP HANA is its high performance and real-time processing capabilities. Because it stores data in memory rather than on disk, it can handle large amounts of data and provide fast query response times. This boosts all operations of our company and minimizes downtime.
reviews.cons: Can be complex in the beginning like all ERP tools. It also has limited integration possibilities with non-SAP systems.

reviews.title: SAP Review
reviews.name: Robel T.
reviews.pros: Easy to use and understand, like the save query as it saves me alot of time in repetitive searches I have to do Reports such as: accounts payable open items, cash reconciliation, cash - open items, payment monitor, and supplier account information are easily generated and always accurate
reviews.cons: -When entering invoices with many lines in SAP, calculated tax amounts for each line sometimes changes as I add more lines in the invoice. Software sometimes has trouble calculating correct tax and gross amounts for invoices when multiple lines, cost centres, GL accounts, tax codes are entered -As I enter invoice items while entering an invoice in SAP in the view all screen, I'm unable to enter a credit memo line item. To do this I'd have to go back into basic view, enter the credit memo, then go back into view all.

reviews.pros: I liked how easy it is to use and how to navigate information to get key reports completed.
reviews.cons: Can take time to integrate as implementation is a very long process

reviews.pros: Even though I only really used it as a CRM I could tell that I was only scratching the surface of its capabilities. reviews.cons: The look and feel reminded me of the old minesweeper game on windows 3.1. I could tell that the business put in a lot of work to customize this package however there were a number of kinks and workaround which didn't make sense.

reviews.pros: 1. It is a real time tracking software for every business process.2. It is very convenient to use once you understand flow of business processes.3. You can manage every process of your business with SAP Standard funtion processes.4. You can customize this software as much as you want. 5. SAP has a vast area of implementation. It is used in almost all types of industries to manage their business processes.
reviews.cons: 1. It is very expensive.2. It can be implemented only by big giant companies who can afford it. 3. Complexity level is high if you are new to the software. 4. Time needed for implementation is massive.5. You will be need to learn and practice if you want to handle SAP Software.

reviews.title: S/4HANA helped massively boost our manufacturing processes
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: The best thing about it is just how integrated it is. We really needed a system where we didn't have to sync a dozen different tools together to run our operations, and S/4HANA has been a lifesaver in that regard. All the modules are linked together so you don't have to worry about integration health and all the data gets synced straight away
reviews.cons: The pricing is a big disadvantage. It could be an issue for companies looking to use SAP to support their expansion.

reviews.title: Not for everyone, but if it fits your needs it is great.
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: It can do everything! It can be molded to do exactly what you need, it is safe and robust to handle the biggest of business
reviews.cons: Quote and budget wisely! Changes will soon stack up and you will be making constant implementations to make it do what you want to do, it does everything out of the box, but probable not the way you want/need it to.

reviews.title: Sap consultant
reviews.name: Osama K.
reviews.pros: Sap finance, sap data warehouse as well as daily financial operations.
reviews.cons: I feel it is expensive implementation and requires alot of effort to learn.

reviews.title: A step into the future.
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: SAP HANA, or Netweaver over HANA DB (HDB) is a step into the future. Before this concept of in-memory computing and memory storage (without reading the disk all the time), some reports took very long to load. Now you can get access to a larger piece of data in seconds. HANA also brings BW to another level of real time reporting, even detailed information can be shown in no time, its very fast. The way we build views by using the HANA Modeler is very simple but yet powerful, you can do a lot with little knowledge and much more with some expertise.
reviews.cons: The tools used to work with HANA are both the HANA Studio or Eclipse with SAP HANA plugins. In my opinion, it could be better than it is; with more components, less bugs (you have to restart the environment every once in a while) and a better explanation about how the aggregation you see has been formed (Simpler than PlanViz).

reviews.title: Excellent ERP software
reviews.name: Matti P.
reviews.pros: One of the best features of SAP HANA is its high performance and real-time processing capabilities. Because it stores data in memory rather than on disk, it can handle large amounts of data and provide fast query response times. This boosts all operations of our company and minimizes downtime.
reviews.cons: Can be complex in the beginning like all ERP tools. It also has limited integration possibilities with non-SAP systems.

reviews.title: SAP Review
reviews.name: Robel T.
reviews.pros: Easy to use and understand, like the save query as it saves me alot of time in repetitive searches I have to do Reports such as: accounts payable open items, cash reconciliation, cash - open items, payment monitor, and supplier account information are easily generated and always accurate
reviews.cons: -When entering invoices with many lines in SAP, calculated tax amounts for each line sometimes changes as I add more lines in the invoice. Software sometimes has trouble calculating correct tax and gross amounts for invoices when multiple lines, cost centres, GL accounts, tax codes are entered -As I enter invoice items while entering an invoice in SAP in the view all screen, I'm unable to enter a credit memo line item. To do this I'd have to go back into basic view, enter the credit memo, then go back into view all.

reviews.title: Amazing software
reviews.name: Ali K.
reviews.pros: I liked how easy it is to use and how to navigate information to get key reports completed.
reviews.cons: Can take time to integrate as implementation is a very long process

reviews.title: I used this as a CRM
reviews.name: Ilia T.
reviews.pros: Even though I only really used it as a CRM I could tell that I was only scratching the surface of its capabilities. So the number one thing I liked about it was having everything under the one roof. It seemed to be relatively easy to navigate and pick up considering the plethora of options and buttons.
reviews.cons: The look and feel reminded me of the old minesweeper game on windows 3.1. I could tell that the business put in a lot of work to customize this package however there were a number of kinks and workaround which didn't make sense.

reviews.title: Purchase Order
reviews.name: Balamurugan L.
reviews.pros: Supplier can able to update Material status in SAP S/4 Hana.
reviews.cons: User Friendly interface.Web based applications tool.

reviews.title: Sap S4 Hana the best ERP
reviews.name: Ashokkumar s.
reviews.pros: the structural design of this software and its advanced features. its very helpful in analysis with real time data. it has a basic rules that make an disordered company structural.
reviews.cons: As everyone know that cost of the software is not affordable by small enterprises. Also its authorization procedures are complicated and will not support in urgent situations.

reviews.title: Its a tremendous user performance optimization
reviews.name: Ravikumar M.
reviews.pros: Its a column based and row based which is faster user data access , auto compressing the data and also parallel processing
reviews.cons: Its time taking if we are not giving the software required hardware like memory, CPU, Disk space etc.. and also the will suggest the certified hardware partner.

reviews.title: SAP S/4HANA Cloud Review
reviews.name: Carlos Hugo Martin C.
reviews.pros: It is a platform that has become more customizable over time to suit the needs of different companies, and the Cloud version allows companies to save costs.
reviews.cons: Migrating from an on-premise environment to a cloud environment can be very complex, especially due to the complexity of the customizations, sometimes leading to the option of starting from scratch in the cloud and performing a partial migration of the on-premise environment.

reviews.title: Proper Inventory Management Software
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: The mass amount of data storage and customizable options to ensure procurement processes are running well and the in depth view of inventory management from all levels PR, PO, GRN, Goods Issued, etc. It is a great product to track your businesses success.
reviews.cons: Can be a bit laggy at times. This is to be expected with ERP software processing large volumes of data.

reviews.title: SAP ERP is still worlds leader
reviews.name: Jose Alejandro C.
reviews.pros: I've been working with SAP ERP for last 5 years, and its a very complete suite for ERP tasks, it had made easier our job, many processes have even been speed-up and upgraded lately, they are faster than before, and its an software very much customizable, and has an good support from all modules Finance, Sales.
reviews.cons: Sometimes vendors give you high hopes on this software, and sometimes it has it limits, so i've seen some users that think this was going to be an ultra speed erp, and it is not.

reviews.title: Satisfactory to my needs
reviews.name: Taylor D.
reviews.pros: The ease of use and ability to find the reporting you need in a one stop shop. My company had a very customized environment that made finding the right reports but overall you could find what you are looking for either through the search or utilizing google or AI to guide you.
reviews.cons: My company’s environment is very customized and limits what reporting is anvailable and who has access to what. As an internal auditor it made doing my daily tasks sometimes difficult.

reviews.title: My review for SAP S/4HANA CLOUD
reviews.name: Erwyn M.
reviews.pros: The software has amazing data visualisation features which enables quick analytics and reporting. Ability of the software in Swiftly processing large volumes of data in real-time.
reviews.cons: Pricing of the software is a major challenge towards implementation of the software. It is not affordable to small organisations and businesses.

reviews.title: The Features of SAP S/4HANA Cloud Have Been Exceptional
reviews.name: Mahatma A.
reviews.pros: The flexibility of SAP S/4HANA Cloud gives us value for money. I am impressed by the impressive inventory management capabilities of SAP S/4HANA Cloud.
reviews.cons: SAP S/4HANA Cloud has been working impressively for us. I do not dislike the features of SAP S/4HANA Cloud at all.

reviews.title: Great overall experience, a true SAP product, however with its own particularities.
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: Cloud-based architecture, taking away the burden of updates and maintenance. Scalability is great - adding a new entity is a walk in the park. Integration within SAP ecosystem is excellent.
reviews.cons: Customization is limited. Integration with products outside of the SAP family can be burdensome. Performance can sometimes be an issue for larger volume operations.

reviews.title: SAP S/4HANA Cloud
reviews.name: Cory R.
reviews.pros: Consolidates finance, controlling, and logistics data into one table, simplifying reporting and removing reconciliation needs.
reviews.cons: The standardized public cloud version offers restricted flexibility for highly specific business processes compared to on-premise options.

reviews.title: Effective but overly complex
reviews.name: WILLIAM E.
reviews.pros: Basically it gets the job done. I am able to accomplish what I need to accomplish. There isn't much great I can say about this software.
reviews.cons: This software is overly complex and there is nothing intuitive or user friendly about it. I find myself having to frequently refer to notes and procedures for most applications.

reviews.title: Easy to integrate but pricey
reviews.name: Lance C.
reviews.pros: Easy to integrate with other on-premise systems. Easy to configure the system. Easy to do data analytics.
reviews.cons: Expensive. Not very user-friendly. The online help features are not intuitive. Fairly long learning curve.

reviews.title: A brilliant ERP Software
reviews.name: Lucia B.
reviews.pros: SAP S/4HANA Cloud has advanced Ai capabilities which enables efficient automation of manual process and optimization of financial operations.
reviews.cons: The product is up to scratch. I have not experienced any operational issue so far.

reviews.title: Valuable ERP Cloud solution
reviews.name: Umang R.
reviews.pros: It is a very comprehensive enterprise resource planning tool and can be applied across various functions - supply chain, finance, sales, accounting etc.
reviews.cons: It takes time to implement and get trained. Proper project management is required in implementation and return on investments.

reviews.title: My experience with SAP
reviews.name: Justin C.
reviews.pros: User Interface is easy and simple to use.
reviews.cons: Been using it for over a year and no complaints thus far!

reviews.title: S/4HANA helped massively boost our manufacturing processes
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: The best thing about it is just how integrated it is. reviews.cons: The pricing is a big disadvantage. It could be an issue for companies looking to use SAP to support their expansion.

reviews.title: Sap consultant
reviews.name: Osama K.
reviews.pros: Sap finance, sap data warehouse as well as daily financial operations.
reviews.cons: I feel it is expensive implementation and requires alot of effort to learn.

reviews.title: A step into the future.
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: SAP HANA, or Netweaver over HANA DB (HDB) is a step into the future. Before this concept of in-memory computing and memory storage (without reading the disk all the time), some reports took very long to load. Now you can get access to a larger piece of data in seconds. HANA also brings BW to another level of real time reporting, even detailed information can be shown in no time, its very fast. The way we build views by using the HANA Modeler is very simple but yet powerful, you can do a lot with little knowledge and much more with some expertise.
reviews.cons: The tools used to work with HANA are both the HANA Studio or Eclipse with SAP HANA plugins. In my opinion, it could be better than it is; with more components, less bugs (you have to restart the environment every once in a while) and a better explanation about how the aggregation you see has been formed (Simpler than PlanViz).

reviews.title: Excellent ERP software
reviews.name: Matti P.
reviews.pros: One of the best features of SAP HANA is its high performance and real-time processing capabilities. Because it stores data in memory rather than on disk, it can handle large amounts of data and provide fast query response times. This boosts all operations of our company and minimizes downtime.
reviews.cons: Can be complex in the beginning like all ERP tools. It also has limited integration possibilities with non-SAP systems.

reviews.title: SAP Review
reviews.name: Robel T.
reviews.pros: Easy to use and understand, like the save query as it saves me alot of time in repetitive searches I have to do Reports such as: accounts payable open items, cash reconciliation, cash - open items, payment monitor, and supplier account information are easily generated and always accurate
reviews.cons: -When entering invoices with many lines in SAP, calculated tax amounts for each line sometimes changes as I add more lines in the invoice. Software sometimes has trouble calculating correct tax and gross amounts for invoices when multiple lines, cost centres, GL accounts, tax codes are entered -As I enter invoice items while entering an invoice in SAP in the view all screen, I'm unable to enter a credit memo line item. To do this I'd have to go back into basic view, enter the credit memo, then go back into view all.

reviews.cons: Can take time to integrate as implementation is a very long process

reviews.name:

reviews.cons: The pricing is a big disadvantage. It could be an issue for companies looking to use SAP to support their expansion.

reviews.cons: Quote and budget wisely! Changes will soon stack up and you will be making constant implementations to make it do what you want to do, it does everything out of the box, but probable not the way you want/need it to.

reviews.title: Sap consultant

reviews.pros: Sap finance, sap data warehouse as well as daily financial operations.
reviews.cons: I feel it is expensive implementation and requires alot of effort to learn.

reviews.title: A step into the future.
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: SAP HANA, or Netweaver over HANA DB (HDB) is a step into the future. Before this concept of in-memory computing and memory storage (without reading the disk all the time), some reports took very long to load. Now you can get access to a larger piece of data in seconds. HANA also brings BW to another level of real time reporting, even detailed information can be shown in no time, its very fast. The way we build views by using the HANA Modeler is very simple but yet powerful, you can do a lot with little knowledge and much more with some expertise.
reviews.cons: The tools used to work with HANA are both the HANA Studio or Eclipse with SAP HANA plugins. In my opinion, it could be better than it is; with more components, less bugs (you have to restart the environment every once in a while) and a better explanation about how the aggregation you see has been formed (Simpler than PlanViz).

reviews.title: Excellent ERP software
reviews.name: Matti P.
reviews.pros: One of the best features of SAP HANA is its high performance and real-time processing capabilities. Because it stores data in memory rather than on disk, it can handle large amounts of data and provide fast query response times. This boosts all operations of our company and minimizes downtime.
reviews.cons: Can be complex in the beginning like all ERP tools. It also has limited integration possibilities with non-SAP systems.

reviews.title: SAP Review

reviews.cons: -When entering invoices with many lines in SAP, calculated tax amounts for each line sometimes changes as I add more lines in the invoice. Software sometimes has trouble calculating correct tax and gross amounts for invoices when multiple lines, cost centres, GL accounts, tax codes are entered -As I enter invoice items while entering an invoice in SAP in the view all screen, I'm unable to enter a credit memo line item. To do this I'd have to go back into basic view, enter the credit memo, then go back into view all.

reviews.title: Fully featured and customisable ERP system
reviews.name: Graeme H.
reviews.pros: The ease of use of the web interface is excellent. It's easy to see the status of a document at a glance and to move it to the next step of the process. Information entered in one area is automatically available elsewhere, such as contact information, shipping addresses, etc. It's all so well integrated. As well as being integrated it's also very customisable. Fields can be added to any document for any purpose. Custom scripts can be added to perform automated tasks.
reviews.cons: I found it quite a steep learning curve for setting up the system; creating and importing all the details for the component parts we use and creating the Bills of Materials. But once it's done (correctly!) it's a breeze to use. Using the system to calculate how much of a product it is possible to manufacture and for what date is not straightforward. This area of the system needs some attention from the development or documentation teams. In some ways the flexibility of the system is a disadvantage. There can be many different ways to accomplish the same thing, but they will have slightly different effects on other parts of the system. There does need to be a "recommended" and "standard" method of doing certain things which is given in the documentation.

reviews.title: ErpNext adoption experience
reviews.name: Rodrigo B.
reviews.pros: Easy to integrate with other solutions or for creating new modules. For example, in my case I could easily add an IoT solution with ingestion, reporting and analytics.
reviews.cons: Different versions mean a new big mayor release. It means that you'll have to work in a new implementation. This have an important impact in your own repository because database changes cannot be migrated directly to the new versions. Generally a new version changes all the database structure, then so many different scripts have to be constructed to migrate the business data to the new version. And in general the procedures indicated by ErpNext don't work easily.

reviews.title: ERPnext for small business
reviews.name: Mudssar A.
reviews.pros: Open source, any feature can be customized, valid and complete devolpment documentation is available, easy in use, remotely access. easy installations. Graphics and GUI is really awesome,accouting and purchasing was better.
reviews.cons: All modules are not pre build, very complex and tough work to build and integrate with other module, either its documentation is available but still a special dedicated devolper is required to run and customize process, less controlling over transactions. like approvals etc.

reviews.title: Most flexible ERP
reviews.name: Mahesh K.
reviews.pros: ERPNext is all in one suite and hence most of the issues related to data structure are resolved at the beginning itself if the implementation is done for all the modules at one go. Secondly, customization options are almost limitless and you don't need to be from an IT background to carry out some of the basic changes as per your business requirement. Document flow and control are also very easy to learn and implement giving you the requisite flexibility of each function which does help in the implementation.
reviews.cons: Except that stock and account ledgers do not offer monthly/quarterly/yearly reports and no comparison of the ledgers can be done with the previous period, there is nothing that can be negative for ERPNext.

reviews.title: ERPNext - cost effective , feature rich and easy
reviews.name: Hari M.
reviews.pros: 1. Usability is very intuitive. Lots of power user aids 2.Extendable/customisable 3. Frappe framework on which ERPNext is built has lots of great features and keeps evolving 4. Functional breadth is also good
reviews.cons: 1. Product has evolved - feature wise and even performance wise it can scale for larger customers but entity model is not well-built for larger enterprise

reviews.title: Does what needs to be done
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: Able to integrate fairly easily with API access. Uses standard db technology. Can be self-hosted or managed hosting. Cloud or in-house. Open source.
reviews.cons: Not tailored for NA markets, implementation and upgrading is tedious. Poorly implemented tools such as accounts reconciliation if compared to Quickbooks for example

reviews.title: Fully featured and customisable ERP system
reviews.name: Graeme H.
reviews.pros: The ease of use of the web interface is excellent. It's easy to see the status of a document at a glance and to move it to the next step of the process. Information entered in one area is automatically available elsewhere, such as contact information, shipping addresses, etc. It's all so well integrated. As well as being integrated it's also very customisable. Fields can be added to any document for any purpose. Custom scripts can be added to perform automated tasks.
reviews.cons: I found it quite a steep learning curve for setting up the system; creating and importing all the details for the component parts we use and creating the Bills of Materials. But once it's done (correctly!) it's a breeze to use. Using the system to calculate how much of a product it is possible to manufacture and for what date is not straightforward. This area of the system needs some attention from the development or documentation teams. In some ways the flexibility of the system is a disadvantage. There can be many different ways to accomplish the same thing, but they will have slightly different effects on other parts of the system. There does need to be a "recommended" and "standard" method of doing certain things which is given in the documentation.

reviews.title: Making ERP More Accessible for More Humans
reviews.name: Eeman B.

reviews.cons: Depending on the team's processes and learning abilities, the adoption could take time.

reviews.title: The best ERP for small and medium size companies

reviews.cons: As an active Open Source project a lot of times We face a lot of features requirements that are not so great to have in our system. Also, the permission system is a little bit complicated

reviews.title: ERPNext is a truly open-sourced ERP system.

reviews.pros: The feature we like about ERPNext is that it is a solid ERP system. All modules are available to use and can work without customization.
reviews.cons: It does not have recommended POS hardware solution.

reviews.title: Great product if you have a good internal IT team
reviews.name: Gopal K.
reviews.pros: The product is well conceptualised, and superbly designed for a small-medium firm. Their Open Source approach is great and provides tremendous value for money.
reviews.cons: Reporting is not user friendly. Tables are not easily readable and the scrolling is painful. Finance module is not designed keeping in mind Indian Chartered Accountants. They find it cumbersome and ask the firm to maintain data in their favourite Tally. This has to be addressed.

reviews.title: Erpnext Review
reviews.name: Asim N.
reviews.pros: Ease of use, Not much of training needed for new employees, Scalability
reviews.cons: Project module needs enhancement to incorporate more dynamic team allocation, deallocation and scheduling.

reviews.title: The Best ERP software out there
reviews.name: Sonal R.
reviews.pros: Easy to use, great interface, very understandable self explanatory forms. Support responds quickly to issues and they get resolved.
reviews.cons: Nothing to dislike. Don't like them hiving off HR module

reviews.title: Awesome Cloud Based ERPNext
reviews.name: Yasser E.
reviews.pros: Ease of use Customization on the fly Fully opensource
reviews.cons: very hard to install on my VPS Not Easy to develop custom apps its need to master many programing language and database Not Enough how to tutorials in good English language

reviews.title: ErpNext adoption experience
reviews.name: Rodrigo B.
reviews.pros: Easy to integrate with other solutions or for creating new modules. For example, in my case I could easily add an IoT solution with ingestion, reporting and analytics.
reviews.cons: Different versions mean a new big mayor release. It means that you'll have to work in a new implementation. This have an important impact in your own repository because database changes cannot be migrated directly to the new versions. Generally a new version changes all the database structure, then so many different scripts have to be constructed to migrate the business data to the new version. And in general the procedures indicated by ErpNext don't work easily.

reviews.title: ERPnext for small business
reviews.name: Mudssar A.
reviews.pros: Open source, any feature can be customized, valid and complete devolpment documentation is available, easy in use, remotely access. easy installations. Graphics and GUI is really awesome,accouting and purchasing was better.
reviews.cons: All modules are not pre build, very complex and tough work to build and integrate with other module, either its documentation is available but still a special dedicated devolper is required to run and customize process, less controlling over transactions. like approvals etc.

reviews.title: Most flexible ERP
reviews.name: Mahesh K.
reviews.pros: ERPNext is all in one suite and hence most of the issues related to data structure are resolved at the beginning itself if the implementation is done for all the modules at one go. Secondly, customization options are almost limitless and you don't need to be from an IT background to carry out some of the basic changes as per your business requirement. Document flow and control are also very easy to learn and implement giving you the requisite flexibility of each function which does help in the implementation.
reviews.cons: Except that stock and account ledgers do not offer monthly/quarterly/yearly reports and no comparison of the ledgers can be done with the previous period, there is nothing that can be negative for ERPNext.

reviews.title: ERPNext - cost effective , feature rich and easy
reviews.name: Hari M.
reviews.pros: 1. Usability is very intuitive. Lots of power user aids 2.Extendable/customisable 3. Frappe framework on which ERPNext is built has lots of great features and keeps evolving 4. Functional breadth is also good
reviews.cons: 1. Product has evolved - feature wise and even performance wise it can scale for larger customers but entity model is not well-built for larger enterprise

reviews.title: Does what needs to be done
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: Able to integrate fairly easily with API access. Uses standard db technology. Can be self-hosted or managed hosting. Cloud or in-house. Open source.
reviews.cons: Not tailored for NA markets, implementation and upgrading is tedious. Poorly implemented tools such as accounts reconciliation if compared to Quickbooks for example

reviews.title: Fully featured and customisable ERP system
reviews.name: Graeme H.
reviews.pros: The ease of use of the web interface is excellent. It's easy to see the status of a document at a glance and to move it to the next step of the process. Information entered in one area is automatically available elsewhere, such as contact information, shipping addresses, etc. It's all so well integrated. As well as being integrated it's also very customisable. Fields can be added to any document for any purpose. Custom scripts can be added to perform automated tasks.
reviews.cons: I found it quite a steep learning curve for setting up the system; creating and importing all the details for the component parts we use and creating the Bills of Materials. But once it's done (correctly!) it's a breeze to use. Using the system to calculate how much of a product it is possible to manufacture and for what date is not straightforward. This area of the system needs some attention from the development or documentation teams. In some ways the flexibility of the system is a disadvantage. There can be many different ways to accomplish the same thing, but they will have slightly different effects on other parts of the system. There does need to be a "recommended" and "standard" method of doing certain things which is given in the documentation.

reviews.title: ERPNext best open source alternative to other software
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: The flexibility of the software to be customized according to organization needs
reviews.cons: The navigation between screen should be improvised so that user can back to main screen while navigating to other screen

reviews.title: Cost Effective & Flexible
reviews.name: Danish Azmat A.
reviews.pros: It has topnotch customizability that gives excellent ease to its users & more importantly it is neither an expensive product to acquire nor it requires massive infrastructure to run.
reviews.cons: Since it is a very customizable product & needs to build as per business requirements that is a quite challenging task in itself.

reviews.title: Erpnext is the most agile software
reviews.name: Devang D.
reviews.pros: We were able to start using the software from day 1. Visual representation of data is beautiful. Documentation is extensive and support is always available from consultants.
reviews.cons: Almost none we could think of. Software can have more ready made reports.

reviews.title: Best ERP out there
reviews.name: Frédéric V.
reviews.pros: Not too expensive and very customizable. Not too hard to learn
reviews.cons: Manufacturing could be improve and analytics

reviews.title: Made for resourceful entrepreneurs of any scale!

Quick release cycles (follows semantic versioning) Extendable Allows connection with micro-services, acts as OAuth 2.0 Authorization server and resource server. Making it easy to connect devices, apps and gadgets to your Frappe / ERPNext server
reviews.cons: No proprietary dependencies can be put into core product. Not suitable for anti-free software companies. Rolling release, No LTS. Not suitable for organisations that cannot adapt to regularly updated ERP system. e.g Some organizations still need FoxPro based systems, not suitable for such organizations.

reviews.title: Best ERP for SME

reviews.title: ERP Next for Small and Medium Businesses

reviews.title: I love how easy the modules link with each other
reviews.name: Angie F.
reviews.pros: The ability to drill down between modules is wonderful. I've never used a software that allowed this so seamlessly.
reviews.cons: The lack of online inquiries through the internet from fellow users that might have experienced something that isn't typical to help others figure it out. This can be technical or a way to resolve a process issue.

reviews.title: Transitioned from QuickBooks to E2 MFG
reviews.name: Jeff M.
reviews.pros: Improvement of inventory tracking coming from an Excel-based, manual process that'd grown to be quite cumbersome. MFG's capabilities eliminated many spreadsheets and many hours maintaining those spreadsheets. Visibility throughout the organization of order status; pieces completed, what's in-process, what's already shipped, etc. Searchable criteria in MFG is quite robust. Prior to MFG we were only able to search via customer part numbers, this left a lot to be desired. Now we can search based on many, many more variables.
reviews.cons: The biggest hurdle/challenge in learning and implementing MFG was understanding a whole new terminology; allocations, transfers, material/job requirements, processing, etc. and how those functioned in MFG specifically. As well sometimes, certain terms are used interchangeably in certain places and this can lead to temporary confusion. There are many ways to accomplish a single task. This flexibility is nice once you're used to the system but can be overwhelming in the beginning.

reviews.title: ERP made your way
reviews.name: Pam G.
reviews.pros: This is the most customizable ERP I have ever dealt with or implemented. Love, Love this as it easily can modify to serve the challenges of about any size company, growth rate, and experience levels. This is the best feature of this software.
reviews.cons: The main con from my exoperiences has been the support personnel and the lack of knowledge of the product and the response. With that said, let me say that it is not complelely fair as the compaqny has experienced a rapid growth and with that comes new personnel and the years of experiences are just not there.

reviews.title: Excellent product and service
reviews.name: Bethany S.
reviews.pros: Helps immensely with organization and the customization options are excellent.
reviews.cons: It does not allow for a user to have more than one order open at a time, which makes it difficult for multitasking or referencing a previous order. This is one feature that we greatly miss from Job Boss. Also, the training provided could have been better, there was a lot of situations that the training did not cover and we had to learn on our own.

reviews.title: E2 First 6 months of use Survey
reviews.name: Ronnie M.
reviews.pros: The Manufacturing organizational aspect of the software is great! Helps keep the manufacturing workflow running smoothly without much intervention from administrative staff. Once the software is learned, it is a pretty intuitive and easy to use product.
reviews.cons: Ability to modify standard document layout should be included in the software and should not be an add-in. Especially working from a French/English Province we need the ability legally to have 2 languages shown on the documents but shouldn't have to pay for it. It would also be useful to have a basic functioning walkthrough tutorial for when you first start up E2.

reviews.title: Very detailed, excellent Tech Support
reviews.name: Sara H.
reviews.pros: This software is very detailed and makes it easy to make changes that keep production going. There are a lot of different steps to assist with making sure changes are correct, which helps with accuracy and decreases human error.
reviews.cons: I wish there was a grid in the Order Entry tab to search for the Part Number. When I need to see what orders are open on which parts, I have to use the binoculars to search and there is no part number available until I go into edit those orders.

reviews.title: M1 ERP Review
reviews.name: Junior T.
reviews.pros: Dashboards, reporting, and visual tools help monitor operations, improve efficiency, and provide accurate job profitability insights.
reviews.cons: Has somewhat of a clunky navigation, too many clicks, cluttered screens, and not always intuitive for end users.

reviews.title: Reliable Manufacturing ERP Solution
reviews.name: Bryan W.
reviews.pros: We really enjoy the way that we can customize the system to our exact needs. Also, it is very user friendly and easy to learn. We use it for multiple departments and love that it is integrated for inventory, production, purchasing, etc.
reviews.cons: The sales and engineering departments have difficulty with quoting - it's a bit complex. Also, the inventory for issuing materials can be manual and complex.

reviews.title: 10 Out of 10 We Recommend M1
reviews.name: Reg S.
reviews.pros: The most helpful feature is that M1 is all connected and integrated. Everything is in one place and is easy to do everything we need. Next, while we do not do our accounting in the system, it is very helpful in generating the reports we need for our accountants.
reviews.cons: In the inputs for materials in the quoting feature, it sometimes is difficult to change the inputs to exactly what I want. For example, I want to talk in terms of price per pound per material, where the system wants to talk in a different metric other than pounds.

reviews.title: M1 gets the job done but there are better options to be had
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: All the data you could ever need about your business can be housed in M1, between the data and the custom reports that can be made, it is a valuable tool to have.
reviews.cons: Its clunky to use, most things take too many clicks to find and it feels like you have to go out of your way to find what you are looking for. It takes some work to make it user friendly in the least bit

reviews.title: E2 Mfg System Review
reviews.name: Raven S.
reviews.pros: This software has a nice interface with easy to follow tabs.
reviews.cons: Very limiting software. Certain processes are too rigid and do not follow company system. Constant need to call customer support due to glitches or other defects in code.

reviews.title: E2 Shoptech
reviews.name: Vanessa M.
reviews.pros: Visibility is key for us, and with this software you can follow an opportunity through from initial stages of quoting through final stages of billing and everything in between. And Customer Service is Top Notch!
reviews.cons: It can be difficult to make changes to orders once in process, but hopefully that is something their team recognizes and will help to rectify in the future.

reviews.title: E2 Review By AMSI
reviews.name: Bassam A.
reviews.pros: The most we like about E2 is the following, 1 user friendly , specially the help line 2: database module an bill bill of married module and part search engine 3: project setup and process routing 4: real time cost capture 4: we envoy the accounting module
reviews.cons: The most we like least about E2 are, 1: Converting proposal to order 2: Lack of creating report to show the Balkance of non invoiced for any particular order

reviews.title: Solid ERP System
reviews.name: Mike P.
reviews.pros: Ease of use, functionality, reporting, scheduling.
reviews.cons: Nothing yet. We've been using V7 and are getting ready to switch to V9, looking forward to the upgrade.

reviews.title: At last, a software system that delivers on its promise.
reviews.name: John E.
reviews.pros: After months of appraisal we chose M1 because of its ability to to be configured exactly to our requirements, as opposed to the one size fits all approach of so many other ERP packages. M1 straight out of the box was immediately able to satisfy most of our needs, however, with its ability to be easily customized to suit our various processes, the system is intuitive to use from shop floor requirements through to full financial reporting and control.
reviews.cons: Same as any other system out there, rubbish in, rubbish out. Once we had that sorted out though by ensuring that all users had an understanding of how their inter-reaction with the system was a benefit to all, themselves included, we gained a complete buy in from all staff along with the required real time and accurate data input on which the system depends.

reviews.title: No Support in Australia
reviews.name: Glen C.
reviews.pros: No ad-dons, no cost for view users, i.e. unlimited clock card entry PC's.
reviews.cons: Absolutely poor support if any. Referred to external consultants as ECi M1 could not supply technical support.

reviews.title: Terrible choice
reviews.name: Slavy D.
reviews.pros: Good Sales Team :) Might be good for very small company but wouldn't recommend to any company. After trying other ERPs have almost no Pros except how they did Part Revision.
reviews.cons: Software failed when was put to load. Worked fine in pilot but when needed to manage 1.4k POs on daily basis it couldn't do math. At one point had daily meetings with development team from Australia on issues but still couldn't resolve all issues. About twice a week were getting orphan records in DB, development team were no help on this. ECi started promising us new version but promise was sliding. After 8 month of deployment time and about 6 month after go live hard decision was made, search for new ERP. When ECi was asked to give us partial refund because their product didn't perform as advertised they revealed themselves as very bad partner. M1 also has major security issue.

reviews.title: Shoptech is a full-featured ERP application that covers all of the bases
reviews.name: JP L.
reviews.pros: The integration is well done, there are many facets to the software setup that enhance the integration.
reviews.cons: I wish the training video's were more up-to-date on some of the advanced features like scheduling and the web interfaces.

reviews.title: Good ERP System

reviews.pros: The software makes it easy to find a lot of data that can be exported and used as necessary
reviews.cons: It is more difficult to set up reports and customize fields for users that do not want to see all fo the background data and only want specifics

We also like how we can customize the program to fit our needs since we are a very unique manufacturer that does many products under one roof. It has many 'cross checks' so we are making sure each department is doing exactly what they are supposed to which leads to accurate financials and job costing.
reviews.cons: I feel like some of the modules we purchased were not fully explained enough or applicable to our usage. Fortunately, they recognized this and helped us to direct our purchases in a more advantageous direction for our business. There are also adjustments in the financials that everyone could benefit from and should not be made to customize it.

reviews.cons: Software failed when was put to load. Worked fine in pilot but when needed to manage 1.4k POs on daily basis it couldn't do math. About twice a week were getting orphan records in DB, development team were no help on this. ECi started promising us new version but promise was sliding. After 8 month of deployment time and about 6 month after go live hard decision was made, search for new ERP. When ECi was asked to give us partial refund because their product didn't perform as advertised they revealed themselves as very bad partner. M1 also has major security issue.

reviews.title: Shoptech is a full-featured ERP application that covers all of the bases
reviews.name: JP L.
reviews.pros: The integration is well done, there are many facets to the software setup that enhance the integration.
reviews.cons: I wish the training video's were more up-to-date on some of the advanced features like scheduling and the web interfaces.

reviews.title: Good ERP System
reviews.name: Benjamin B.
reviews.pros: The software makes it easy to find a lot of data that can be exported and used as necessary
reviews.cons: It is more difficult to set up reports and customize fields for users that do not want to see all fo the background data and only want specifics

reviews.title: Awesome product ~ even better implementer!
reviews.name: Marylou C.
reviews.pros: Vendor has awesome support. We love how it brings all of our activities together in one program. We also like how we can customize the program to fit our needs since we are a very unique manufacturer that does many products under one roof. It has many 'cross checks' so we are making sure each department is doing exactly what they are supposed to which leads to accurate financials and job costing.
reviews.cons: I feel like some of the modules we purchased were not fully explained enough or applicable to our usage. Fortunately, they recognized this and helped us to direct our purchases in a more advantageous direction for our business. There are also adjustments in the financials that everyone could benefit from and should not be made to customize it.

reviews.title: Review
reviews.name: Jeremy B.
reviews.pros: Ease of use. Navigation of windows. Ability to run many custom reports in Hotspots.
reviews.cons: Cost of additional users can be expensive.

reviews.title: Do not use M1
reviews.name: Grant K.
reviews.pros: Excellent promises by the sales people - they never eventuate though!
reviews.cons: Support - they are the worst

reviews.title: My Review
reviews.name: Mackenzie W.
reviews.pros: I like the speed and the accuracy of this software. Its easy to navigate through and get the job done a lot quicker than other software(s) I've worked with in the past.
reviews.cons: Sometimes can be not so user-friendly, I often get confused when orders don't want to "Process".

reviews.title: Fr finance
reviews.name: Jeff S.
reviews.pros: Work stations and scanning job orders was good
reviews.cons: Reporting and finance Reporting difficult and Ul was not good

reviews.title: Installation of ECi M1
reviews.name: Mark P.
reviews.pros: This ERP software is very intuitive and very flexible relative to the previous software from Made2Manage that my organization ran for the past 24 years. The input of transactions is straightforward with minimal training, and searching for almost any data is substantially easier.
reviews.cons: The only issue we've had any challenge with so far is with the conversion of our old Made2Manage data, which was an old FoxPro version into a pure SQL format. Some data came across easily, and some data didn't come across at all. We could have come up to speed running the new software much faster if we'd have been able to convert our M2M data in a more timely fashion.

reviews.title: I love how easy the modules link with each other
reviews.name: Angie F.
reviews.pros: The ability to drill down between modules is wonderful. I've never used a software that allowed this so seamlessly.
reviews.cons: The lack of online inquiries through the internet from fellow users that might have experienced something that isn't typical to help others figure it out. This can be technical or a way to resolve a process issue.

reviews.title: Transitioned from QuickBooks to E2 MFG
reviews.name: Jeff M.
reviews.pros: Improvement of inventory tracking coming from an Excel-based, manual process that'd grown to be quite cumbersome. MFG's capabilities eliminated many spreadsheets and many hours maintaining those spreadsheets. Visibility throughout the organization of order status; pieces completed, what's in-process, what's already shipped, etc. Searchable criteria in MFG is quite robust. Prior to MFG we were only able to search via customer part numbers, this left a lot to be desired. Now we can search based on many, many more variables.
reviews.cons: The biggest hurdle/challenge in learning and implementing MFG was understanding a whole new terminology; allocations, transfers, material/job requirements, processing, etc. and how those functioned in MFG specifically. As well sometimes, certain terms are used interchangeably in certain places and this can lead to temporary confusion. There are many ways to accomplish a single task. This flexibility is nice once you're used to the system but can be overwhelming in the beginning.

reviews.title: ERP made your way
reviews.name: Pam G.
reviews.pros: This is the most customizable ERP I have ever dealt with or implemented. Love, Love this as it easily can modify to serve the challenges of about any size company, growth rate, and experience levels. This is the best feature of this software.
reviews.cons: The main con from my exoperiences has been the support personnel and the lack of knowledge of the product and the response. With that said, let me say that it is not complelely fair as the compaqny has experienced a rapid growth and with that comes new personnel and the years of experiences are just not there.

reviews.title: Excellent product and service
reviews.name: Bethany S.
reviews.pros: Helps immensely with organization and the customization options are excellent.
reviews.cons: It does not allow for a user to have more than one order open at a time, which makes it difficult for multitasking or referencing a previous order. This is one feature that we greatly miss from Job Boss. Also, the training provided could have been better, there was a lot of situations that the training did not cover and we had to learn on our own.

reviews.title: E2 First 6 months of use Survey
reviews.name: Ronnie M.
reviews.pros: The Manufacturing organizational aspect of the software is great! Helps keep the manufacturing workflow running smoothly without much intervention from administrative staff. Once the software is learned, it is a pretty intuitive and easy to use product.
reviews.cons: Ability to modify standard document layout should be included in the software and should not be an add-in. Especially working from a French/English Province we need the ability legally to have 2 languages shown on the documents but shouldn't have to pay for it. It would also be useful to have a basic functioning walkthrough tutorial for when you first start up E2.

reviews.title: Very detailed, excellent Tech Support
reviews.name: Sara H.
reviews.pros: This software is very detailed and makes it easy to make changes that keep production going. There are a lot of different steps to assist with making sure changes are correct, which helps with accuracy and decreases human error.
reviews.cons: I wish there was a grid in the Order Entry tab to search for the Part Number. When I need to see what orders are open on which parts, I have to use the binoculars to search and there is no part number available until I go into edit those orders.

reviews.title: M1 ERP Review
reviews.name: Junior T.
reviews.pros: Dashboards, reporting, and visual tools help monitor operations, improve efficiency, and provide accurate job profitability insights.
reviews.cons: Has somewhat of a clunky navigation, too many clicks, cluttered screens, and not always intuitive for end users.

reviews.title: Reliable Manufacturing ERP Solution
reviews.name: Bryan W.
reviews.pros: We really enjoy the way that we can customize the system to our exact needs. Also, it is very user friendly and easy to learn. We use it for multiple departments and love that it is integrated for inventory, production, purchasing, etc.
reviews.cons: The sales and engineering departments have difficulty with quoting - it's a bit complex. Also, the inventory for issuing materials can be manual and complex.

reviews.title: 10 Out of 10 We Recommend M1
reviews.name: Reg S.
reviews.pros: The most helpful feature is that M1 is all connected and integrated. Everything is in one place and is easy to do everything we need. Next, while we do not do our accounting in the system, it is very helpful in generating the reports we need for our accountants.
reviews.cons: In the inputs for materials in the quoting feature, it sometimes is difficult to change the inputs to exactly what I want. For example, I want to talk in terms of price per pound per material, where the system wants to talk in a different metric other than pounds.

reviews.title: M1 gets the job done but there are better options to be had
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: All the data you could ever need about your business can be housed in M1, between the data and the custom reports that can be made, it is a valuable tool to have.
reviews.cons: Its clunky to use, most things take too many clicks to find and it feels like you have to go out of your way to find what you are looking for. It takes some work to make it user friendly in the least bit

reviews.title: E2 Mfg System Review
reviews.name: Raven S.
reviews.pros: This software has a nice interface with easy to follow tabs.
reviews.cons: Very limiting software. Certain processes are too rigid and do not follow company system. Constant need to call customer support due to glitches or other defects in code.

reviews.title: E2 Shoptech
reviews.name: Vanessa M.
reviews.pros: Visibility is key for us, and with this software you can follow an opportunity through from initial stages of quoting through final stages of billing and everything in between. And Customer Service is Top Notch!
reviews.cons: It can be difficult to make changes to orders once in process, but hopefully that is something their team recognizes and will help to rectify in the future.

reviews.title: E2 Review By AMSI
reviews.name: Bassam A.
reviews.pros: The most we like about E2 is the following, 1 user friendly , specially the help line 2: database module an bill bill of married module and part search engine 3: project setup and process routing 4: real time cost capture 4: we envoy the accounting module
reviews.cons: The most we like least about E2 are, 1: Converting proposal to order 2: Lack of creating report to show the Balkance of non invoiced for any particular order

reviews.title: Solid ERP System
reviews.name: Mike P.
reviews.pros: Ease of use, functionality, reporting, scheduling.
reviews.cons: Nothing yet. We've been using V7 and are getting ready to switch to V9, looking forward to the upgrade.

reviews.title: At last, a software system that delivers on its promise.
reviews.name: John E.
reviews.pros: After months of appraisal we chose M1 because of its ability to to be configured exactly to our requirements, as opposed to the one size fits all approach of so many other ERP packages. M1 straight out of the box was immediately able to satisfy most of our needs, however, with its ability to be easily customized to suit our various processes, the system is intuitive to use from shop floor requirements through to full financial reporting and control.
reviews.cons: Same as any other system out there, rubbish in, rubbish out. Once we had that sorted out though by ensuring that all users had an understanding of how their inter-reaction with the system was a benefit to all, themselves included, we gained a complete buy in from all staff along with the required real time and accurate data input on which the system depends.

reviews.pros: This software is very detailed and makes it easy to make changes that keep production going. There are a lot of different steps to assist with making sure changes are correct, which helps with accuracy and decreases human error.
reviews.cons: I wish there was a grid in the Order Entry tab to search for the Part Number. When I need to see what orders are open on which parts, I have to use the binoculars to search and there is no part number available until I go into edit those orders.

reviews.title: M1 ERP Review
reviews.name: Junior T.
reviews.pros: Dashboards, reporting, and visual tools help monitor operations, improve efficiency, and provide accurate job profitability insights.
reviews.cons: Has somewhat of a clunky navigation, too many clicks, cluttered screens, and not always intuitive for end users.

reviews.title: Reliable Manufacturing ERP Solution
reviews.name: Bryan W.
reviews.pros: We really enjoy the way that we can customize the system to our exact needs. Also, it is very user friendly and easy to learn. We use it for multiple departments and love that it is integrated for inventory, production, purchasing, etc.
reviews.cons: The sales and engineering departments have difficulty with quoting - it's a bit complex. Also, the inventory for issuing materials can be manual and complex.

reviews.title: 10 Out of 10 We Recommend M1
reviews.name: Reg S.
reviews.pros: The most helpful feature is that M1 is all connected and integrated. Everything is in one place and is easy to do everything we need. Next, while we do not do our accounting in the system, it is very helpful in generating the reports we need for our accountants.
reviews.cons: In the inputs for materials in the quoting feature, it sometimes is difficult to change the inputs to exactly what I want. For example, I want to talk in terms of price per pound per material, where the system wants to talk in a different metric other than pounds.

reviews.title: M1 gets the job done but there are better options to be had
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: All the data you could ever need about your business can be housed in M1, between the data and the custom reports that can be made, it is a valuable tool to have.
reviews.cons: Its clunky to use, most things take too many clicks to find and it feels like you have to go out of your way to find what you are looking for. It takes some work to make it user friendly in the least bit

reviews.title: E2 Mfg System Review
reviews.name: Raven S.
reviews.pros: This software has a nice interface with easy to follow tabs.
reviews.cons: Very limiting software. Certain processes are too rigid and do not follow company system. Constant need to call customer support due to glitches or other defects in code.

reviews.title: E2 Shoptech
reviews.name: Vanessa M.
reviews.pros: Visibility is key for us, and with this software you can follow an opportunity through from initial stages of quoting through final stages of billing and everything in between. And Customer Service is Top Notch!
reviews.cons: It can be difficult to make changes to orders once in process, but hopefully that is something their team recognizes and will help to rectify in the future.

reviews.title: E2 Review By AMSI
reviews.name: Bassam A.
reviews.pros: The most we like about E2 is the following, 1 user friendly , specially the help line 2: database module an bill bill of married module and part search engine 3: project setup and process routing 4: real time cost capture 4: we envoy the accounting module
reviews.cons: The most we like least about E2 are, 1: Converting proposal to order 2: Lack of creating report to show the Balkance of non invoiced for any particular order

reviews.title: Solid ERP System
reviews.name: Mike P.
reviews.pros: Ease of use, functionality, reporting, scheduling.
reviews.cons: Nothing yet. We've been using V7 and are getting ready to switch to V9, looking forward to the upgrade.

reviews.title: At last, a software system that delivers on its promise.
reviews.name: John E.
reviews.pros: After months of appraisal we chose M1 because of its ability to to be configured exactly to our requirements, as opposed to the one size fits all approach of so many other ERP packages. M1 straight out of the box was immediately able to satisfy most of our needs, however, with its ability to be easily customized to suit our various processes, the system is intuitive to use from shop floor requirements through to full financial reporting and control.
reviews.cons: Same as any other system out there, rubbish in, rubbish out. Once we had that sorted out though by ensuring that all users had an understanding of how their inter-reaction with the system was a benefit to all, themselves included, we gained a complete buy in from all staff along with the required real time and accurate data input on which the system depends.

reviews.title: No Support in Australia
reviews.name: Glen C.
reviews.pros: No ad-dons, no cost for view users, i.e. unlimited clock card entry PC's.
reviews.cons: Absolutely poor support if any. Referred to external consultants as ECi M1 could not supply technical support.

reviews.title: Terrible choice
reviews.name: Slavy D.
reviews.pros: Good Sales Team :) Might be good for very small company but wouldn't recommend to any company. After trying other ERPs have almost no Pros except how they did Part Revision.
reviews.cons: Software failed when was put to load. Worked fine in pilot but when needed to manage 1.4k POs on daily basis it couldn't do math. At one point had daily meetings with development team from Australia on issues but still couldn't resolve all issues. About twice a week were getting orphan records in DB, development team were no help on this. ECi started promising us new version but promise was sliding. After 8 month of deployment time and about 6 month after go live hard decision was made, search for new ERP. When ECi was asked to give us partial refund because their product didn't perform as advertised they revealed themselves as very bad partner. M1 also has major security issue.

reviews.title: Shoptech is a full-featured ERP application that covers all of the bases
reviews.name: JP L.
reviews.pros: The integration is well done, there are many facets to the software setup that enhance the integration.
reviews.cons: I wish the training video's were more up-to-date on some of the advanced features like scheduling and the web interfaces.

reviews.title: Good ERP System
reviews.name: Benjamin B.
reviews.pros: The software makes it easy to find a lot of data that can be exported and used as necessary
reviews.cons: It is more difficult to set up reports and customize fields for users that do not want to see all fo the background data and only want specifics

reviews.title: Awesome product ~ even better implementer!
reviews.name: Marylou C.
reviews.pros: Vendor has awesome support. We love how it brings all of our activities together in one program. We also like how we can customize the program to fit our needs since we are a very unique manufacturer that does many products under one roof. It has many 'cross checks' so we are making sure each department is doing exactly what they are supposed to which leads to accurate financials and job costing.
reviews.cons: I feel like some of the modules we purchased were not fully explained enough or applicable to our usage. Fortunately, they recognized this and helped us to direct our purchases in a more advantageous direction for our business. There are also adjustments in the financials that everyone could benefit from and should not be made to customize it.

reviews.title: Review

reviews.pros: Ease of use. Navigation of windows. Ability to run many custom reports in Hotspots.
reviews.cons: Cost of additional users can be expensive.

reviews.title: Do not use M1

reviews.cons: Support - they are the worst

reviews.title: My Review
