The platform is very user-friendly, with no pop-ups or distracting ads. Its annual fee is minimal compared to other bookkeeping platforms, making it a great fit for our budget. Additionally, whenever issues arise, the QuickBooks support team offers helpful answers and resources directly on their website.
reviews.cons: I do not like the constant push to move to QuickBooks Online. I prefer the desktop version because it is simple and consistent, with each update making minimal changes. The online version relies heavily on internet connectivity and computer performance, which can introduce unnecessary complications and occasional disruptions.

reviews.title: A Reliable and Feature-Rich Accounting System for Growing Businesses
reviews.name: Najmudheen v.
reviews.pros: Powerful financial reporting tools with built-in templates and customization User-friendly interface that's easy to navigate even for non-accountants Advanced inventory management (especially with Platinum and Diamond editions) Multi-user access & role-based permissions ideal for medium-sized businesses Seamless integration with payroll, payments, and time-tracking tools
reviews.cons: The desktop-based architecture feels outdated compared to modern cloud ERP systems Integration with non-Intuit third-party tools is limited and sometimes buggy Customization options are not as flexible as cloud-based ERPs like Odoo or NetSuite Performance may lag with large data files or when accessed over network

reviews.title: Quickbooks for Billing
reviews.name: Cayla F.
reviews.pros: Quickbooks really does what you need it to do. It is relatively easy to use (if you're OK with technology). It saves us SO much time. We do all our invoicing through QB. Their customer support is OK, but it is a good program at a good price. When there are bugs, they seem to be resolved quickly.
reviews.cons: I have noticed that they do a lot of updates. The most recent one changed everything around, which is fine, but I know some people have a hard time finding things. I also feel like they don't have enough information online, or it is really out of date. I feel like some customer service representatives don't understand the program.

reviews.title: Accounting Manager
reviews.name: Jeanne S.
reviews.pros: The inventory system is easy to use. We spent less time on training new employees because it was so user friendly and intuitive. I recently left the company where i used QB's Enterprise inventory and went to a new office that uses and ERP . The ERP isn't intuitive for staff and take a lot longer to learn how to use it.
reviews.cons: It didn't have the capabilities of an ERP software that you can customize to your own specifications. It is good for a smaller company.

reviews.title: Quickbooks Is the Bomb!
reviews.name: Sherrie G.
reviews.pros: Invoicing, monthly reporting and financial activities, ease of use and time saving features that make my life easier
reviews.cons: Sometimes it's difficult to get to the right customer service area. I have been put on hold many times just to be transferred to various other departments.

reviews.title: QuickBooks Enterprise
reviews.name: Terry C.
reviews.pros: QuickBooks Enterprise is a very large program with the capability to support multiple lists and items. For someone who would like to utilize historical data across the platform, it is excellent. The interface of the program acts like many other software products and is not "accountant-ease" but rather English based so seems more logical for a user who is not familiar with accounting software. Invoicing, receiving payments and managing inventory are are very good in the software.
reviews.cons: QuickBooks Enterprise is not without it's problems. As lists grow the speed of the system will become slower. Customer Service is also sometimes a problems. I am a former Pro-Advisor for Intuit and remember a time when their Customer Service was outstanding. In prior years, we used to have a dedicated representative that would follow the problem until it was resolved. Today, the outsourcing of service has made that impossible which makes it difficult if not cumbersome to work a problem through to resolution without needing to explain everything over. Also, at one time you could purchase the software outright. Today it is subscription based per year. The rising cost of the subscription is becoming prohibitive on an annual basis.

reviews.title: The Best Program Ever!!
reviews.name: Natalie Y.
reviews.pros: I absolutely love QuickBooks, it is so easy to navigate. I like how it keeps track of all the data from invoices to customers and employees. This program has been a life saver to our little business.
reviews.cons: I don’t really have a negative to say besides when calling customer service support you can plan to be o the phone for a bit.

reviews.title: Still the best accounting software
reviews.name: James M.
reviews.pros: QuickBooks Desktop Enterprise offers a significant performance advantage over QuickBooks Online. Its speed and efficiency are critical to my workflow. I have relied on QuickBooks Desktop since the 1990s and it has consistently met my business needs. The comprehensive functionality of QuickBooks Desktop Enterprise supports essential accounting processes, including payroll management, credit card processing, bank transaction downloads, multi-company file management, employee access to pay stubs and W-2s, budgeting, forecasting, and payroll tax payments. The ability to simultaneously manage multiple company files is particularly valuable, and I would welcome future enhancements that increase this capacity. The current disparity in processing time between QuickBooks Desktop Enterprise and QuickBooks Online is substantial; tasks completed in one hour within the desktop environment require approximately four hours in the online version. A mandated transition to QuickBooks Online would severely impact my productivity and potentially necessitate a reevaluation of my career path. In summary, QuickBooks Desktop Enterprise remains a superior solution for my accounting needs. Its robust feature set and performance are unmatched, and any transition to a less efficient platform would be detrimental."
reviews.cons: QuickBooks Desktop Enterprise exhibits a persistent limitation when processing bulk form transmissions. Specifically, the system consistently generates errors when attempting to send more than 120 forms concurrently. For organizations with high-volume invoicing, such as ours, this translates to a significant operational inefficiency. For example, processing 400 invoices necessitates sending the initial 125, followed by manually queuing the remaining 275 invoices via the 'Send Later' function. This requires 275 individual mouse clicks, representing a substantial time investment. This issue has persisted for an extended period, spanning approximately two decades, without resolution. Furthermore, the current pricing structure of QuickBooks Desktop Enterprise presents a substantial financial burden. The discontinuation of QuickBooks Pro, previously available at a more accessible price point (approximately $199), and the mandatory adoption of the Enterprise subscription model have resulted in a significant cost increase. In 2024, our five-user license cost $4,579. Transitioning to a single-user license in 2025 resulted in a cost of $1,711. Compounding this, the shift from perpetual licenses to annual subscriptions has drastically increased the total cost of ownership. A software investment that previously yielded a multi-year lifespan now necessitates annual renewals, effectively increasing the five-year expenditure from the original $1,700 to $8,500. This pricing model represents a considerable financial commitment and warrants reevaluation.

reviews.cons: Some challenges with updates, specifically switching to single use and locking out users inadvertently. Multiuser should really be the standard for enterprise.

reviews.cons: I do not like the constant push to move to QuickBooks Online. I prefer the desktop version because it is simple and consistent, with each update making minimal changes. The online version relies heavily on internet connectivity and computer performance, which can introduce unnecessary complications and occasional disruptions.

reviews.cons: The desktop-based architecture feels outdated compared to modern cloud ERP systems Integration with non-Intuit third-party tools is limited and sometimes buggy Customization options are not as flexible as cloud-based ERPs like Odoo or NetSuite Performance may lag with large data files or when accessed over network

Their customer support is OK, but it is a good program at a good price. When there are bugs, they seem to be resolved quickly.
reviews.cons: I have noticed that they do a lot of updates. The most recent one changed everything around, which is fine, but I know some people have a hard time finding things. I also feel like they don't have enough information online, or it is really out of date. I feel like some customer service representatives don't understand the program.

reviews.cons: It didn't have the capabilities of an ERP software that you can customize to your own specifications. It is good for a smaller company.

reviews.title: Quickbooks Is the Bomb!
reviews.name: Sherrie G.
reviews.pros: Invoicing, monthly reporting and financial activities, ease of use and time saving features that make my life easier
reviews.cons: Sometimes it's difficult to get to the right customer service area. I have been put on hold many times just to be transferred to various other departments.

reviews.title: QuickBooks Enterprise
reviews.name: Terry C.
reviews.pros: QuickBooks Enterprise is a very large program with the capability to support multiple lists and items. For someone who would like to utilize historical data across the platform, it is excellent. The interface of the program acts like many other software products and is not "accountant-ease" but rather English based so seems more logical for a user who is not familiar with accounting software. Invoicing, receiving payments and managing inventory are are very good in the software.
reviews.cons: QuickBooks Enterprise is not without it's problems. As lists grow the speed of the system will become slower. Customer Service is also sometimes a problems. I am a former Pro-Advisor for Intuit and remember a time when their Customer Service was outstanding. In prior years, we used to have a dedicated representative that would follow the problem until it was resolved. Today, the outsourcing of service has made that impossible which makes it difficult if not cumbersome to work a problem through to resolution without needing to explain everything over. Also, at one time you could purchase the software outright. Today it is subscription based per year. The rising cost of the subscription is becoming prohibitive on an annual basis.

reviews.title: The Best Program Ever!!
reviews.name: Natalie Y.
reviews.pros: I absolutely love QuickBooks, it is so easy to navigate. I like how it keeps track of all the data from invoices to customers and employees. This program has been a life saver to our little business.
reviews.cons: I don’t really have a negative to say besides when calling customer service support you can plan to be o the phone for a bit.

reviews.title: Still the best accounting software
reviews.name: James M.
reviews.pros: QuickBooks Desktop Enterprise offers a significant performance advantage over QuickBooks Online. Its speed and efficiency are critical to my workflow. I have relied on QuickBooks Desktop since the 1990s and it has consistently met my business needs. The comprehensive functionality of QuickBooks Desktop Enterprise supports essential accounting processes, including payroll management, credit card processing, bank transaction downloads, multi-company file management, employee access to pay stubs and W-2s, budgeting, forecasting, and payroll tax payments. The ability to simultaneously manage multiple company files is particularly valuable, and I would welcome future enhancements that increase this capacity. The current disparity in processing time between QuickBooks Desktop Enterprise and QuickBooks Online is substantial; tasks completed in one hour within the desktop environment require approximately four hours in the online version. A mandated transition to QuickBooks Online would severely impact my productivity and potentially necessitate a reevaluation of my career path. In summary, QuickBooks Desktop Enterprise remains a superior solution for my accounting needs. Its robust feature set and performance are unmatched, and any transition to a less efficient platform would be detrimental."
reviews.cons: QuickBooks Desktop Enterprise exhibits a persistent limitation when processing bulk form transmissions. Specifically, the system consistently generates errors when attempting to send more than 120 forms concurrently. For organizations with high-volume invoicing, such as ours, this translates to a significant operational inefficiency. For example, processing 400 invoices necessitates sending the initial 125, followed by manually queuing the remaining 275 invoices via the 'Send Later' function. This requires 275 individual mouse clicks, representing a substantial time investment. This issue has persisted for an extended period, spanning approximately two decades, without resolution. Furthermore, the current pricing structure of QuickBooks Desktop Enterprise presents a substantial financial burden. The discontinuation of QuickBooks Pro, previously available at a more accessible price point (approximately $199), and the mandatory adoption of the Enterprise subscription model have resulted in a significant cost increase. In 2024, our five-user license cost $4,579. Transitioning to a single-user license in 2025 resulted in a cost of $1,711. Compounding this, the shift from perpetual licenses to annual subscriptions has drastically increased the total cost of ownership. A software investment that previously yielded a multi-year lifespan now necessitates annual renewals, effectively increasing the five-year expenditure from the original $1,700 to $8,500. This pricing model represents a considerable financial commitment and warrants reevaluation.

reviews.cons: Some challenges with updates, specifically switching to single use and locking out users inadvertently. Multiuser should really be the standard for enterprise.

reviews.pros: The modules are easy to use . The screens are easy to navigate and they are user friendly. there is excellent audit tracing for each module.
reviews.cons: The reports are minimal. The more useful reports require you to purchase a separate license for Sage intelligence which is very expensive. the stock reports require another software program (Crystal reports ) in order to modify them. The set up screens for the customer and vendor screen do not allow for more than one email address which reduces the ability to email directly from Sage. The payroll module does not email EFT check reports to employees. You have to buy another program in order to do this (Print Boss). Overall there is a hefty price tag to purchase all the modules and add on programs to use. If you can stay with Simply, then you should.

reviews.title: Senior Instructor Sage at NACIT
reviews.name: Waqar K.
reviews.pros: Industry-wide use makes Sage 300 skills transferable and valued. Modular design allows you to start with core accounting and add other module i.e. A/R, A/P, Inventory/Pyaroll, Project etc. as needed. Reliable and stable for accounting tasks once properly setups are configurated. Accuracy of system. Having very few and little bugs encounters. Good security and user-permission controls. Possibility of segment classification/segregation on chart of accounts. Allow multi-company and multi-currency support.
reviews.cons: All-in-one system for general ledger, payables, receivables, inventory, and project costing, which integrates daily accounting tasks requirements make it bit complex and complicated processing. User interface is inconvenient and not as easy as other provider provide i.e. QB etc. Learning curve is usually longer; the interface and workflows feel complex at least initially. Customization of reports is complex and not user friendly. Budgeting system is basic. Performance become slow with large datasets or many concurrent users. Add-ons are required for advanced features, increasing cost and complexity. Official support and documentation are often limited and not user friendly. Trainings are fee based whereas other competitor are giving free learning resources.

reviews.title: Satisfied User

reviews.pros: It gets the job done, is predictable, and never glitches. I haven't run into any bugs or issues with Sage300 since I started using it six years ago. (The only bugs or issues have been with the interface between our CRM program and Sage 300, and the CRM program itself.)
reviews.cons: I would like to be able to add comments to various items within the system. reviews.pros: It has been in service w/ our firm since before 2000. It consistently gets the current job done. We use most of the modules and like the integration functions.

We have had a lot of trouble with the report writer function. It turns out that changing the font size made the report really small or caused page cut-offs. Some of these reports are over 20 years old, like the A/R aging, and are mainly stock reports with a couple of modifications, like the headers and a Notes text box Office Connector has been a nightmare to get support from Sage or the 3rd party vendor. Sage ODBC and Office have an issue with Office 365 64-bit applications vs 32-bit. Everything is moving to a 64-bit environment, so why can't Sage move up to 32-bit? It is causing my office to keep several machines on the older version of Office. The Purchase Order module is not fully integrated with A/P and requires manual posting. We are still reviewing and manually uploading

reviews.title: Solid platform, but be prepared to pay extra for every new feature
reviews.name: Heather J.
reviews.pros: The dimensions-based reporting is the biggest win for us. We can slice financials by department, location, and project without creating a bloated chart of accounts. Building custom reports and dashboards is straightforward once you learn the report writer, and everything updates in real time instead of waiting on an Excel export. Support has always been able to solve my issues.
reviews.cons: The biggest frustration is that nearly every meaningful feature is a paid add-on. Basic project tracking is included, but the published capabilities you actually want? Add-on. AI features? Add-on. General journal auto-reconciliation? Add-on. Closing automation? Add-on. Every improvement or new capability they roll out and market seems to come with a separate SKU and another line on the invoice, so the "all-in" cost keeps creeping up well past what you signed for. On top of that, the learning curve is steeper than the sales process suggests, the UI feels dated in places, and support response times can vary depending on who picks up your ticket.

reviews.title: Highly Efficient and Reliable Accounting Solution
reviews.name: Yvonne V.
reviews.pros: Sage Intacct is a powerful and reliable accounting platform. Its reporting capabilities are excellent, allowing for detailed, customizable financial reports that support better decision-making. The system is user-friendly once implemented, and the cloud-based access makes it easy to work from anywhere. I also appreciate the strong audit trails and controls, which are critical for maintaining accuracy and compliance. Overall, it streamlines processes like invoicing, general ledger management, and financial analysis very effectively
reviews.cons: The initial setup and implementation can be time-consuming and may require outside support, especially for more complex organizations. Some modules and features can feel less intuitive at first, and occasional system glitches or delays can occur. Additionally, certain customizations and integrations may require technical expertise or additional cost.

reviews.title: A Comprehensive Financial System That Rewards Proper Setup
reviews.name: Nicole H.
reviews.pros: It allows us to track financial data across departments, projects, and cost centres without creating an overly complex chart of accounts. The dashboards and custom reports provide clear, real-time insights, and the automation of processes like journals and approvals saves significant time compared to manual systems.
reviews.cons: While the system is very powerful, some areas of the interface are not intuitive, and tasks that should be simple can require multiple steps.

reviews.title: Intacct is a winner!
reviews.name: Jennifer P.
reviews.pros: Intacct has given us a quicker close, better reporting, and less software to use! It’s a was to learn software.
reviews.cons: The AP approval process is not as custom as we thought. Outside vendors have a better workflow than the standard Intacct software.

reviews.title: Sage Intacct eases integrations
reviews.name: Liz B.
reviews.pros: We like the user interface of Intacct and the core modules are great and easy to navigate. Because we have to integrate our Procurement, Expense and CRM systems, we like the ability to be able to integrate so many systems that we use seamlessly with the Intacct API. The various modules we use have provided a lot of efficiencies to our internal processes. The order entry module makes customer invoicing very easy to manage and post revenue.
reviews.cons: Some of the reporting, while robust, is not conducive for public companies/auditors. Sometimes troubleshooting issues is hard or diving into objects that show up on audit logs is hard to back into. Also having the audit reports limited to people with admin privileges is problematic for managers managing their audit responsibilities and creates SOD conflicts. Having to use external systems for some of the core functionality causes additional expense but is necessary as our company has matured. Engineering problems take months to resolve with customer support.

reviews.title: Best in Class for Non-Profits
reviews.name: Elizabeth W.
reviews.pros: It is so flexible - we are able to manage grants, contracts and projects in the same space without having to increase the size of our chart of accounts.
reviews.cons: The fixed asset module is not sophisticated - we would prefer to have an internal asset management tool that calculates depreciation and allows for allocations. We currently use one of Intacct's partners for asset management within the system.

reviews.title: Sage Intacct
reviews.name: Phillip M.
reviews.pros: Accessible from anywhere, with strong role-based permissions and the ability to grow with the organization. Smooth connections with systems like Salesforce, bill-pay platforms, and budgeting tools. Real-time access, clear audit trails, and solid internal controls make audits smoother and reduce manual reconciliations. Customizable dashboards give executives and program managers clear visibility into budgets, spending, and outcomes.
reviews.cons: The system is powerful, but navigation and setup can feel complex for new users. Some advanced reports or workflows require help from consultants or Intacct partners.

reviews.title: Sage and integrated partners do it all to save staff time
reviews.name: Rick H.
reviews.pros: It creates efficient processes for all accounting functions. Partner software that integrates with Sage is outstanding.
reviews.cons: In recent years the price has increased substantially. I have seen more than a 20 percent increase and had to sign a long term contract to manage the cost increases.

reviews.title: Finance director

reviews.pros: Implementation of ai. So far we have been using the ap side and I’m working on using the early adapter program for copilot close
reviews.cons: So far not doing the manual coding correctly, in reference to due to/due from. This process is creating hundreds of account code combinations and making the audit much harder

reviews.title: Sage Review
reviews.name: Skylar B.
reviews.pros: Sage is very flexible. I've used Sage in multiple industries, and the flexibility of Sage makes it a good fit across the board.
reviews.cons: While the reporting is quite robust, it is a steep learning curve on building reports. If there was one thing I could change, it would be making a few report builds more accessible to those with limited knowledge and limited needs - while still maintaining the current structure for more complex needs.

reviews.title: Improve on Customer Service
reviews.name: Jennifer R.
reviews.pros: Sage Intacct is user friendly and has worked well for our needs. We utilize the software to manage the accounting for approximately 300 health and welfare trusts.
reviews.cons: The customer service can improve. When we were sold the product, one feature that we were looking at is the ability to make ACH payments directly from Sage. After implementation we were told it could only be set up for one bank account. We were very clear during the entire implementation process that we had a few hundred bank accounts. That was disappointing. Second, each year for our renewal we bring the ACH issue up to see if anything has changed and we have asked multiple times about reporting. We run general ledgers for each of the trusts quarterly and have to manually run each report. We want to see if there is a way to batch run and save individual reports. Last year our rep never circled back and this year it is still floating out there. I'm not sure why that request is so difficult to accommodate. Also, I just received our subscription renewal for the upcoming year and the rates increased anywhere from 31% to 44%, this is unacceptable. They threw in a 3 year subscription to lock in rate increases and that was not an option previously. I manage software costs for our CPA firm and have not seen any increase to this magnitude and it is unacceptable. Last, a couple years ago we double paid our annual subscription because we had forgotten it was on auto pay. It is impossible to get someone on the phone to address these types of issues. While it was our error, it took far too long to resolve and have the money returned to us.

It is not as easy to use as a software like QuickBooks Online, but is much more customizable and has greater controls. You can easily create recurring transactions such as journal entries, bills, and invoices for automation. The import function for journal entries has been heavily used in our month end close process which has sped up reconciliations.

However, I believe this is a benefit as it provides a better audit trail. It also helps my staff to be more diligent in inputting information correctly the first time thus cutting down on mistakes. Sometimes it also takes a few clicks to get from the general ledger down to the transaction you are looking for.

reviews.title: Strong Financial Visibility & Workflow Efficiency With Room to Modernize
reviews.name: Bob T.
reviews.pros: Sage Intacct has significantly improved financial visibility across our organization. Our entire executive team can easily access real-time financial statements and dashboards, which keeps everyone aligned on performance throughout the fiscal year. The accounts payable workflow is especially strong—routing invoices for department-level approval is straightforward and has streamlined our internal controls. We’ve also reduced paper usage dramatically, which has been a meaningful operational win. Perhaps most valuable is the integration with our CRM, allowing for real-time record keeping and better coordination between finance and revenue functions.
reviews.cons: The interface is starting to feel a bit dated compared to newer platforms, even though it remains clean and functional. Some reporting and filtering capabilities still require extra effort to fine-tune, and we occasionally rely on our consultant to get reports exactly where we need them. That said, this has also created opportunities for cross-team collaboration and deeper understanding of our data.

reviews.title: Sage Intaact Training and Implementation
reviews.name: Donna N.
reviews.pros: East of entry into the system and being able to scan everything in one place. Payment approvals in the system.
reviews.cons: Reporting is limited and hard to manipulate to get what you need. No invoice approvals in the system to assign to users to sign off to keep it paperless.

reviews.title: Solid platform, but be prepared to pay extra for every new feature
reviews.name: Heather J.
reviews.pros: The dimensions-based reporting is the biggest win for us. We can slice financials by department, location, and project without creating a bloated chart of accounts. Building custom reports and dashboards is straightforward once you learn the report writer, and everything updates in real time instead of waiting on an Excel export. Support has always been able to solve my issues.
reviews.cons: The biggest frustration is that nearly every meaningful feature is a paid add-on. Basic project tracking is included, but the published capabilities you actually want? Add-on. AI features? Add-on. General journal auto-reconciliation? Add-on. Closing automation? Add-on. Every improvement or new capability they roll out and market seems to come with a separate SKU and another line on the invoice, so the "all-in" cost keeps creeping up well past what you signed for. On top of that, the learning curve is steeper than the sales process suggests, the UI feels dated in places, and support response times can vary depending on who picks up your ticket.

reviews.title: Highly Efficient and Reliable Accounting Solution
reviews.name: Yvonne V.
reviews.pros: Sage Intacct is a powerful and reliable accounting platform. Its reporting capabilities are excellent, allowing for detailed, customizable financial reports that support better decision-making. The system is user-friendly once implemented, and the cloud-based access makes it easy to work from anywhere. I also appreciate the strong audit trails and controls, which are critical for maintaining accuracy and compliance. Overall, it streamlines processes like invoicing, general ledger management, and financial analysis very effectively
reviews.cons: The initial setup and implementation can be time-consuming and may require outside support, especially for more complex organizations. Some modules and features can feel less intuitive at first, and occasional system glitches or delays can occur. Additionally, certain customizations and integrations may require technical expertise or additional cost.

reviews.title: A Comprehensive Financial System That Rewards Proper Setup
reviews.name: Nicole H.
reviews.pros: It allows us to track financial data across departments, projects, and cost centres without creating an overly complex chart of accounts. The dashboards and custom reports provide clear, real-time insights, and the automation of processes like journals and approvals saves significant time compared to manual systems.
reviews.cons: While the system is very powerful, some areas of the interface are not intuitive, and tasks that should be simple can require multiple steps.

reviews.title: Intacct is a winner!
reviews.name: Jennifer P.
reviews.pros: Intacct has given us a quicker close, better reporting, and less software to use! It’s a was to learn software.
reviews.cons: The AP approval process is not as custom as we thought. Outside vendors have a better workflow than the standard Intacct software.

reviews.title: Sage Intacct eases integrations
reviews.name: Liz B.
reviews.pros: We like the user interface of Intacct and the core modules are great and easy to navigate. Because we have to integrate our Procurement, Expense and CRM systems, we like the ability to be able to integrate so many systems that we use seamlessly with the Intacct API. The various modules we use have provided a lot of efficiencies to our internal processes. The order entry module makes customer invoicing very easy to manage and post revenue.
reviews.cons: Some of the reporting, while robust, is not conducive for public companies/auditors. Sometimes troubleshooting issues is hard or diving into objects that show up on audit logs is hard to back into. Also having the audit reports limited to people with admin privileges is problematic for managers managing their audit responsibilities and creates SOD conflicts. Having to use external systems for some of the core functionality causes additional expense but is necessary as our company has matured. Engineering problems take months to resolve with customer support.

reviews.title: Best in Class for Non-Profits
reviews.name: Elizabeth W.
reviews.pros: It is so flexible - we are able to manage grants, contracts and projects in the same space without having to increase the size of our chart of accounts.
reviews.cons: The fixed asset module is not sophisticated - we would prefer to have an internal asset management tool that calculates depreciation and allows for allocations. We currently use one of Intacct's partners for asset management within the system.

reviews.title: Sage Intacct
reviews.name: Phillip M.
reviews.pros: Accessible from anywhere, with strong role-based permissions and the ability to grow with the organization. Smooth connections with systems like Salesforce, bill-pay platforms, and budgeting tools. Real-time access, clear audit trails, and solid internal controls make audits smoother and reduce manual reconciliations. Customizable dashboards give executives and program managers clear visibility into budgets, spending, and outcomes.
reviews.cons: The system is powerful, but navigation and setup can feel complex for new users. Some advanced reports or workflows require help from consultants or Intacct partners.

reviews.title: Sage and integrated partners do it all to save staff time
reviews.name: Rick H.
reviews.pros: It creates efficient processes for all accounting functions. Partner software that integrates with Sage is outstanding.
reviews.cons: In recent years the price has increased substantially. I have seen more than a 20 percent increase and had to sign a long term contract to manage the cost increases.

reviews.title: Finance director
reviews.name: Anita M.
reviews.pros: Implementation of ai. So far we have been using the ap side and I’m working on using the early adapter program for copilot close
reviews.cons: So far not doing the manual coding correctly, in reference to due to/due from. This process is creating hundreds of account code combinations and making the audit much harder

reviews.title: Sage Review
reviews.name: Skylar B.
reviews.pros: Sage is very flexible. I've used Sage in multiple industries, and the flexibility of Sage makes it a good fit across the board.
reviews.cons: While the reporting is quite robust, it is a steep learning curve on building reports. If there was one thing I could change, it would be making a few report builds more accessible to those with limited knowledge and limited needs - while still maintaining the current structure for more complex needs.

reviews.title: Improve on Customer Service
reviews.name: Jennifer R.
reviews.pros: Sage Intacct is user friendly and has worked well for our needs. We utilize the software to manage the accounting for approximately 300 health and welfare trusts.
reviews.cons: The customer service can improve. When we were sold the product, one feature that we were looking at is the ability to make ACH payments directly from Sage. After implementation we were told it could only be set up for one bank account. We were very clear during the entire implementation process that we had a few hundred bank accounts. That was disappointing. Second, each year for our renewal we bring the ACH issue up to see if anything has changed and we have asked multiple times about reporting. We run general ledgers for each of the trusts quarterly and have to manually run each report. We want to see if there is a way to batch run and save individual reports. Last year our rep never circled back and this year it is still floating out there. I'm not sure why that request is so difficult to accommodate. Also, I just received our subscription renewal for the upcoming year and the rates increased anywhere from 31% to 44%, this is unacceptable. They threw in a 3 year subscription to lock in rate increases and that was not an option previously. I manage software costs for our CPA firm and have not seen any increase to this magnitude and it is unacceptable. Last, a couple years ago we double paid our annual subscription because we had forgotten it was on auto pay. It is impossible to get someone on the phone to address these types of issues. While it was our error, it took far too long to resolve and have the money returned to us.

reviews.title: Sage for Non-Profits
reviews.name: Andrew P.
reviews.pros: Sale is a powerful tool for Nonprofits. It allows multiple opportunities to record and report specific Grants. Ease of use
reviews.cons: During file imports when the import has an issue, the File import error messages are pitiful. They provide no real assistance in resolving the import issue. Pricing is significantly higher than other similar products and seems excessive

reviews.title: Great Accounting Software - I would highly recommend!!!
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: Sage Intacct is a great accounting system that is very customizable. It is not as easy to use as a software like QuickBooks Online, but is much more customizable and has greater controls. You can easily create recurring transactions such as journal entries, bills, and invoices for automation. The import function for journal entries has been heavily used in our month end close process which has sped up reconciliations.
reviews.cons: Biggest complaints my staff have had with using Sage Intacct is that it isn't as easy to delete or correct mistakes like in QuickBooks Online. However, I believe this is a benefit as it provides a better audit trail. It also helps my staff to be more diligent in inputting information correctly the first time thus cutting down on mistakes. Sometimes it also takes a few clicks to get from the general ledger down to the transaction you are looking for.

reviews.name: Donna N.
reviews.pros: East of entry into the system and being able to scan everything in one place. Payment approvals in the system.

reviews.title: Solid platform, but be prepared to pay extra for every new feature
reviews.name: Heather J.
reviews.pros: The dimensions-based reporting is the biggest win for us. We can slice financials by department, location, and project without creating a bloated chart of accounts. Building custom reports and dashboards is straightforward once you learn the report writer, and everything updates in real time instead of waiting on an Excel export. Support has always been able to solve my issues.
reviews.cons: The biggest frustration is that nearly every meaningful feature is a paid add-on. Basic project tracking is included, but the published capabilities you actually want? Add-on. AI features? Add-on. General journal auto-reconciliation? Add-on. Closing automation? Add-on. Every improvement or new capability they roll out and market seems to come with a separate SKU and another line on the invoice, so the "all-in" cost keeps creeping up well past what you signed for. On top of that, the learning curve is steeper than the sales process suggests, the UI feels dated in places, and support response times can vary depending on who picks up your ticket.

reviews.title: Highly Efficient and Reliable Accounting Solution
reviews.name: Yvonne V.
reviews.pros: Sage Intacct is a powerful and reliable accounting platform. Its reporting capabilities are excellent, allowing for detailed, customizable financial reports that support better decision-making. The system is user-friendly once implemented, and the cloud-based access makes it easy to work from anywhere. I also appreciate the strong audit trails and controls, which are critical for maintaining accuracy and compliance. Overall, it streamlines processes like invoicing, general ledger management, and financial analysis very effectively
reviews.cons: The initial setup and implementation can be time-consuming and may require outside support, especially for more complex organizations. Some modules and features can feel less intuitive at first, and occasional system glitches or delays can occur. Additionally, certain customizations and integrations may require technical expertise or additional cost.

reviews.title: A Comprehensive Financial System That Rewards Proper Setup
reviews.name: Nicole H.
reviews.pros: It allows us to track financial data across departments, projects, and cost centres without creating an overly complex chart of accounts. The dashboards and custom reports provide clear, real-time insights, and the automation of processes like journals and approvals saves significant time compared to manual systems.
reviews.cons: While the system is very powerful, some areas of the interface are not intuitive, and tasks that should be simple can require multiple steps.

reviews.title: Intacct is a winner!
reviews.name: Jennifer P.
reviews.pros: Intacct has given us a quicker close, better reporting, and less software to use! It’s a was to learn software.
reviews.cons: The AP approval process is not as custom as we thought. Outside vendors have a better workflow than the standard Intacct software.

reviews.title: Sage Intacct eases integrations
reviews.name: Liz B.
reviews.pros: We like the user interface of Intacct and the core modules are great and easy to navigate. Because we have to integrate our Procurement, Expense and CRM systems, we like the ability to be able to integrate so many systems that we use seamlessly with the Intacct API. The various modules we use have provided a lot of efficiencies to our internal processes. The order entry module makes customer invoicing very easy to manage and post revenue.
reviews.cons: Some of the reporting, while robust, is not conducive for public companies/auditors. Sometimes troubleshooting issues is hard or diving into objects that show up on audit logs is hard to back into. Also having the audit reports limited to people with admin privileges is problematic for managers managing their audit responsibilities and creates SOD conflicts. Having to use external systems for some of the core functionality causes additional expense but is necessary as our company has matured. Engineering problems take months to resolve with customer support.

reviews.title: Best in Class for Non-Profits
reviews.name: Elizabeth W.
reviews.pros: It is so flexible - we are able to manage grants, contracts and projects in the same space without having to increase the size of our chart of accounts.
reviews.cons: The fixed asset module is not sophisticated - we would prefer to have an internal asset management tool that calculates depreciation and allows for allocations. We currently use one of Intacct's partners for asset management within the system.

reviews.title: Sage Intacct
reviews.name: Phillip M.
reviews.pros: Accessible from anywhere, with strong role-based permissions and the ability to grow with the organization. Smooth connections with systems like Salesforce, bill-pay platforms, and budgeting tools. Real-time access, clear audit trails, and solid internal controls make audits smoother and reduce manual reconciliations. Customizable dashboards give executives and program managers clear visibility into budgets, spending, and outcomes.
reviews.cons: The system is powerful, but navigation and setup can feel complex for new users. Some advanced reports or workflows require help from consultants or Intacct partners.

reviews.title: Sage and integrated partners do it all to save staff time
reviews.name: Rick H.
reviews.pros: It creates efficient processes for all accounting functions. Partner software that integrates with Sage is outstanding.
reviews.cons: In recent years the price has increased substantially. I have seen more than a 20 percent increase and had to sign a long term contract to manage the cost increases.

reviews.title: Finance director
reviews.name: Anita M.
reviews.pros: Implementation of ai. So far we have been using the ap side and I’m working on using the early adapter program for copilot close
reviews.cons: So far not doing the manual coding correctly, in reference to due to/due from. This process is creating hundreds of account code combinations and making the audit much harder

reviews.title: Sage Review
reviews.name: Skylar B.
reviews.pros: Sage is very flexible. I've used Sage in multiple industries, and the flexibility of Sage makes it a good fit across the board.
reviews.cons: While the reporting is quite robust, it is a steep learning curve on building reports. If there was one thing I could change, it would be making a few report builds more accessible to those with limited knowledge and limited needs - while still maintaining the current structure for more complex needs.

reviews.title: Improve on Customer Service
reviews.name: Jennifer R.
reviews.pros: Sage Intacct is user friendly and has worked well for our needs. We utilize the software to manage the accounting for approximately 300 health and welfare trusts.
reviews.cons: The customer service can improve. When we were sold the product, one feature that we were looking at is the ability to make ACH payments directly from Sage. After implementation we were told it could only be set up for one bank account. We were very clear during the entire implementation process that we had a few hundred bank accounts. That was disappointing. Second, each year for our renewal we bring the ACH issue up to see if anything has changed and we have asked multiple times about reporting. We run general ledgers for each of the trusts quarterly and have to manually run each report. We want to see if there is a way to batch run and save individual reports. Last year our rep never circled back and this year it is still floating out there. I'm not sure why that request is so difficult to accommodate. Also, I just received our subscription renewal for the upcoming year and the rates increased anywhere from 31% to 44%, this is unacceptable. They threw in a 3 year subscription to lock in rate increases and that was not an option previously. I manage software costs for our CPA firm and have not seen any increase to this magnitude and it is unacceptable. Last, a couple years ago we double paid our annual subscription because we had forgotten it was on auto pay. It is impossible to get someone on the phone to address these types of issues. While it was our error, it took far too long to resolve and have the money returned to us.

reviews.title: Sage for Non-Profits
reviews.name: Andrew P.
reviews.pros: Sale is a powerful tool for Nonprofits. It allows multiple opportunities to record and report specific Grants. Ease of use
reviews.cons: During file imports when the import has an issue, the File import error messages are pitiful. They provide no real assistance in resolving the import issue. Pricing is significantly higher than other similar products and seems excessive

reviews.title: Great Accounting Software - I would highly recommend!!!
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: Sage Intacct is a great accounting system that is very customizable. It is not as easy to use as a software like QuickBooks Online, but is much more customizable and has greater controls. You can easily create recurring transactions such as journal entries, bills, and invoices for automation. The import function for journal entries has been heavily used in our month end close process which has sped up reconciliations.
reviews.cons: Biggest complaints my staff have had with using Sage Intacct is that it isn't as easy to delete or correct mistakes like in QuickBooks Online. However, I believe this is a benefit as it provides a better audit trail. It also helps my staff to be more diligent in inputting information correctly the first time thus cutting down on mistakes. Sometimes it also takes a few clicks to get from the general ledger down to the transaction you are looking for.

reviews.cons: The budget module was a bit hard to figure out my first time. I feel there are too many steps to a lot of the features.

Reviewer

reviews.cons: Fixed Asset module is limited and clunky. The Fixed Asset reporting availability and export feature from screen or module to excel is limited.

reviews.title: Strong Financial Visibility & Workflow Efficiency With Room to Modernize

Some reporting and filtering capabilities still require extra effort to fine-tune, and we occasionally rely on our consultant to get reports exactly where we need them. That said, this has also created opportunities for cross-team collaboration and deeper understanding of our data.

The system is user-friendly once implemented, and the cloud-based access makes it easy to work from anywhere. I also appreciate the strong audit trails and controls, which are critical for maintaining accuracy and compliance. Overall, it streamlines processes like invoicing, general ledger management, and financial analysis very effectively
reviews.cons: The initial setup and implementation can be time-consuming and may require outside support, especially for more complex organizations. Some modules and features can feel less intuitive at first, and occasional system glitches or delays can occur. Additionally, certain customizations and integrations may require technical expertise or additional cost.

reviews.title: A Comprehensive Financial System That Rewards Proper Setup
reviews.name: Nicole H.
reviews.pros: It allows us to track financial data across departments, projects, and cost centres without creating an overly complex chart of accounts. The dashboards and custom reports provide clear, real-time insights, and the automation of processes like journals and approvals saves significant time compared to manual systems.
reviews.cons: While the system is very powerful, some areas of the interface are not intuitive, and tasks that should be simple can require multiple steps.

reviews.title: Intacct is a winner!
reviews.name: Jennifer P.
reviews.pros: Intacct has given us a quicker close, better reporting, and less software to use! It’s a was to learn software.
reviews.cons: The AP approval process is not as custom as we thought. Outside vendors have a better workflow than the standard Intacct software.

reviews.title: Sage Intacct eases integrations
reviews.name: Liz B.
reviews.pros: We like the user interface of Intacct and the core modules are great and easy to navigate. Because we have to integrate our Procurement, Expense and CRM systems, we like the ability to be able to integrate so many systems that we use seamlessly with the Intacct API. The various modules we use have provided a lot of efficiencies to our internal processes. The order entry module makes customer invoicing very easy to manage and post revenue.
reviews.cons: Some of the reporting, while robust, is not conducive for public companies/auditors. Sometimes troubleshooting issues is hard or diving into objects that show up on audit logs is hard to back into. Also having the audit reports limited to people with admin privileges is problematic for managers managing their audit responsibilities and creates SOD conflicts. Having to use external systems for some of the core functionality causes additional expense but is necessary as our company has matured. Engineering problems take months to resolve with customer support.

reviews.title: Best in Class for Non-Profits
reviews.name: Elizabeth W.
reviews.pros: It is so flexible - we are able to manage grants, contracts and projects in the same space without having to increase the size of our chart of accounts.
reviews.cons: The fixed asset module is not sophisticated - we would prefer to have an internal asset management tool that calculates depreciation and allows for allocations. We currently use one of Intacct's partners for asset management within the system.

reviews.title: Sage Intacct
reviews.name: Phillip M.
reviews.pros: Accessible from anywhere, with strong role-based permissions and the ability to grow with the organization. Smooth connections with systems like Salesforce, bill-pay platforms, and budgeting tools. Real-time access, clear audit trails, and solid internal controls make audits smoother and reduce manual reconciliations. Customizable dashboards give executives and program managers clear visibility into budgets, spending, and outcomes.
reviews.cons: The system is powerful, but navigation and setup can feel complex for new users. Some advanced reports or workflows require help from consultants or Intacct partners.

reviews.title: Sage and integrated partners do it all to save staff time
reviews.name: Rick H.
reviews.pros: It creates efficient processes for all accounting functions. Partner software that integrates with Sage is outstanding.
reviews.cons: In recent years the price has increased substantially. I have seen more than a 20 percent increase and had to sign a long term contract to manage the cost increases.

reviews.title: Finance director
reviews.name: Anita M.
reviews.pros: Implementation of ai. So far we have been using the ap side and I’m working on using the early adapter program for copilot close
reviews.cons: So far not doing the manual coding correctly, in reference to due to/due from. This process is creating hundreds of account code combinations and making the audit much harder

reviews.title: Sage Review
reviews.name: Skylar B.
reviews.pros: Sage is very flexible. I've used Sage in multiple industries, and the flexibility of Sage makes it a good fit across the board.
reviews.cons: While the reporting is quite robust, it is a steep learning curve on building reports. If there was one thing I could change, it would be making a few report builds more accessible to those with limited knowledge and limited needs - while still maintaining the current structure for more complex needs.

reviews.title: Improve on Customer Service
reviews.name: Jennifer R.
reviews.pros: Sage Intacct is user friendly and has worked well for our needs. We utilize the software to manage the accounting for approximately 300 health and welfare trusts.
reviews.cons: The customer service can improve. When we were sold the product, one feature that we were looking at is the ability to make ACH payments directly from Sage. After implementation we were told it could only be set up for one bank account. We were very clear during the entire implementation process that we had a few hundred bank accounts. That was disappointing. Second, each year for our renewal we bring the ACH issue up to see if anything has changed and we have asked multiple times about reporting. We run general ledgers for each of the trusts quarterly and have to manually run each report. We want to see if there is a way to batch run and save individual reports. Last year our rep never circled back and this year it is still floating out there. I'm not sure why that request is so difficult to accommodate. Also, I just received our subscription renewal for the upcoming year and the rates increased anywhere from 31% to 44%, this is unacceptable. They threw in a 3 year subscription to lock in rate increases and that was not an option previously. I manage software costs for our CPA firm and have not seen any increase to this magnitude and it is unacceptable. Last, a couple years ago we double paid our annual subscription because we had forgotten it was on auto pay. It is impossible to get someone on the phone to address these types of issues. While it was our error, it took far too long to resolve and have the money returned to us.

reviews.title: Sage for Non-Profits
reviews.name: Andrew P.
reviews.pros: Sale is a powerful tool for Nonprofits. It allows multiple opportunities to record and report specific Grants. Ease of use
reviews.cons: During file imports when the import has an issue, the File import error messages are pitiful. They provide no real assistance in resolving the import issue. Pricing is significantly higher than other similar products and seems excessive

reviews.title: Great Accounting Software - I would highly recommend!!!
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: Sage Intacct is a great accounting system that is very customizable. It is not as easy to use as a software like QuickBooks Online, but is much more customizable and has greater controls. You can easily create recurring transactions such as journal entries, bills, and invoices for automation. The import function for journal entries has been heavily used in our month end close process which has sped up reconciliations.
reviews.cons: Biggest complaints my staff have had with using Sage Intacct is that it isn't as easy to delete or correct mistakes like in QuickBooks Online. However, I believe this is a benefit as it provides a better audit trail. It also helps my staff to be more diligent in inputting information correctly the first time thus cutting down on mistakes. Sometimes it also takes a few clicks to get from the general ledger down to the transaction you are looking for.

reviews.cons: The budget module was a bit hard to figure out my first time. I feel there are too many steps to a lot of the features.

reviews.cons: cost and flexibility in set up, as a non profit i feel like we had to fit a square peg in a round hole and it feels clunky

reviews.cons: That you can't make a journal entry spanning different months. Alos, if there is an issue with Bill.com, trying to remedy the issue between the two softwares is tough.

reviews.title: Controller
reviews.name: Dylan B.
reviews.pros: Technical and highly customizable. Easy to use once it's functional with you needs! I would reccomend Lucentive as your implementation specialist.
reviews.cons: Requires time to understand and configure system directly to your needs. Once you have the necessary tailoring done for your organization, the system functions very well.

reviews.title: Sage Intacct- worth the investment even for small organizations
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: Fully SQL product customizable to specific environments. Strong quality control with smart events and triggers to support consistency in data entry and outlier transactions that require additional review.
reviews.cons: Some modules were acquired from third parties; the integration and functionality of these modules are somewhat inconsistent with the core modules integration and functionality. Reporting does not allow inclusion of unposted entries to allow users to see effects of entries before posting. The reclassify and delete functions mitigate the reporting issue. Budgeting functionality is basic. Third party solutions required for more complex budgeting and modeling.

reviews.title: Senior Director of Finance at Battlecreek Church
reviews.name: Shannon Ward W.
reviews.pros: The product itself is robust, able to build high level outputs/reporting/Dashboards as well as granular level down to account/cost center. Also dimension functionality and customer support with [sensitive content hidden] is outstanding and a reason we remain with Sage.
reviews.cons: Fixed Asset module is limited and clunky. The Fixed Asset reporting availability and export feature from screen or module to excel is limited.

reviews.title: Strong Financial Visibility & Workflow Efficiency With Room to Modernize
reviews.name: Bob T.
reviews.pros: Sage Intacct has significantly improved financial visibility across our organization. Our entire executive team can easily access real-time financial statements and dashboards, which keeps everyone aligned on performance throughout the fiscal year. The accounts payable workflow is especially strong—routing invoices for department-level approval is straightforward and has streamlined our internal controls. We’ve also reduced paper usage dramatically, which has been a meaningful operational win. Perhaps most valuable is the integration with our CRM, allowing for real-time record keeping and better coordination between finance and revenue functions.
reviews.cons: The interface is starting to feel a bit dated compared to newer platforms, even though it remains clean and functional. Some reporting and filtering capabilities still require extra effort to fine-tune, and we occasionally rely on our consultant to get reports exactly where we need them. That said, this has also created opportunities for cross-team collaboration and deeper understanding of our data.

reviews.title: The Real Guru for Financial Management.
reviews.name: Esami Allan J.
reviews.pros: It is simple to generate custom reports .Has a intuitive and user friendly interface that make it easy to use and understand.Automate billing and invoicing process.Prioritizes the security of financial data. Simple to track and manage our cash flows.Very professional and responsive customer service team .
reviews.cons: The customization of invoices of Sage Intacct require extra skills since mostly is abit advance which takes time and need a training.

reviews.name: Jake D.
reviews.pros: It is extremely reliable and very user friendly. We haven't had any issues where the software was down. All of our people have been trained to use it easily.
reviews.cons: There are some links in reports that seem to not lead anywhere. When you click it, it doesn't lead to the actual transaction where you can see the details.

reviews.title: Product expands as business grows, great product!
reviews.name: Sandy K.
reviews.pros: Sage is able to expand as our organization grows. We are able to track our invoices by contract for our contract reporting
reviews.cons: Would like to see the budgeting module able to budget by individual headcount. If Sage could do this, we would add the budget module to our subscription.

reviews.title: Work in Progress
reviews.name: Richard J.
reviews.pros: Customization of reports. Although there is out of the box reports on occasion, we need customized reports for Government Grant reporting.
reviews.cons: 3rd party integration and synchronization

reviews.title: Sage Intaact Training and Implementation
reviews.name: Donna N.
reviews.pros: East of entry into the system and being able to scan everything in one place. Payment approvals in the system.
reviews.cons: Reporting is limited and hard to manipulate to get what you need. No invoice approvals in the system to assign to users to sign off to keep it paperless.

reviews.title: Solid platform, but be prepared to pay extra for every new feature
reviews.name: Heather J.
reviews.pros: The dimensions-based reporting is the biggest win for us. We can slice financials by department, location, and project without creating a bloated chart of accounts. Building custom reports and dashboards is straightforward once you learn the report writer, and everything updates in real time instead of waiting on an Excel export. Support has always been able to solve my issues.
reviews.cons: The biggest frustration is that nearly every meaningful feature is a paid add-on. Basic project tracking is included, but the published capabilities you actually want? Add-on. AI features? Add-on. General journal auto-reconciliation? Add-on. Closing automation? Add-on. Every improvement or new capability they roll out and market seems to come with a separate SKU and another line on the invoice, so the "all-in" cost keeps creeping up well past what you signed for. On top of that, the learning curve is steeper than the sales process suggests, the UI feels dated in places, and support response times can vary depending on who picks up your ticket.

reviews.title: Strong Financial Visibility & Workflow Efficiency With Room to Modernize
reviews.name: Bob T.
reviews.pros: Sage Intacct has significantly improved financial visibility across our organization. Our entire executive team can easily access real-time financial statements and dashboards, which keeps everyone aligned on performance throughout the fiscal year. The accounts payable workflow is especially strong—routing invoices for department-level approval is straightforward and has streamlined our internal controls. We’ve also reduced paper usage dramatically, which has been a meaningful operational win. Perhaps most valuable is the integration with our CRM, allowing for real-time record keeping and better coordination between finance and revenue functions.
reviews.cons: The interface is starting to feel a bit dated compared to newer platforms, even though it remains clean and functional. Some reporting and filtering capabilities still require extra effort to fine-tune, and we occasionally rely on our consultant to get reports exactly where we need them. That said, this has also created opportunities for cross-team collaboration and deeper understanding of our data.

reviews.cons: The customization of invoices of Sage Intacct require extra skills since mostly is abit advance which takes time and need a training.

reviews.cons: There are some links in reports that seem to not lead anywhere. When you click it, it doesn't lead to the actual transaction where you can see the details.

reviews.title: Sage Intaact Training and Implementation
reviews.name: Donna N.
reviews.pros: East of entry into the system and being able to scan everything in one place. Payment approvals in the system.
reviews.cons: Reporting is limited and hard to manipulate to get what you need. No invoice approvals in the system to assign to users to sign off to keep it paperless.

reviews.title: Solid platform, but be prepared to pay extra for every new feature
reviews.name: Heather J.
reviews.pros: The dimensions-based reporting is the biggest win for us. We can slice financials by department, location, and project without creating a bloated chart of accounts. Building custom reports and dashboards is straightforward once you learn the report writer, and everything updates in real time instead of waiting on an Excel export. Support has always been able to solve my issues.
reviews.cons: The biggest frustration is that nearly every meaningful feature is a paid add-on. Basic project tracking is included, but the published capabilities you actually want? Add-on. AI features? Add-on. General journal auto-reconciliation? Add-on. Closing automation? Add-on. Every improvement or new capability they roll out and market seems to come with a separate SKU and another line on the invoice, so the "all-in" cost keeps creeping up well past what you signed for. On top of that, the learning curve is steeper than the sales process suggests, the UI feels dated in places, and support response times can vary depending on who picks up your ticket.

reviews.title: Highly Efficient and Reliable Accounting Solution
reviews.name: Yvonne V.
reviews.pros: Sage Intacct is a powerful and reliable accounting platform. Its reporting capabilities are excellent, allowing for detailed, customizable financial reports that support better decision-making. The system is user-friendly once implemented, and the cloud-based access makes it easy to work from anywhere. I also appreciate the strong audit trails and controls, which are critical for maintaining accuracy and compliance. Overall, it streamlines processes like invoicing, general ledger management, and financial analysis very effectively
reviews.cons: The initial setup and implementation can be time-consuming and may require outside support, especially for more complex organizations. Some modules and features can feel less intuitive at first, and occasional system glitches or delays can occur. Additionally, certain customizations and integrations may require technical expertise or additional cost.

reviews.title: A Comprehensive Financial System That Rewards Proper Setup
reviews.name: Nicole H.
reviews.pros: It allows us to track financial data across departments, projects, and cost centres without creating an overly complex chart of accounts. The dashboards and custom reports provide clear, real-time insights, and the automation of processes like journals and approvals saves significant time compared to manual systems.
reviews.cons: While the system is very powerful, some areas of the interface are not intuitive, and tasks that should be simple can require multiple steps.

reviews.title: Intacct is a winner!
reviews.name: Jennifer P.
reviews.pros: Intacct has given us a quicker close, better reporting, and less software to use! It’s a was to learn software.
reviews.cons: The AP approval process is not as custom as we thought. Outside vendors have a better workflow than the standard Intacct software.

reviews.title: Sage Intacct eases integrations
reviews.name: Liz B.
reviews.pros: We like the user interface of Intacct and the core modules are great and easy to navigate. Because we have to integrate our Procurement, Expense and CRM systems, we like the ability to be able to integrate so many systems that we use seamlessly with the Intacct API. The various modules we use have provided a lot of efficiencies to our internal processes. The order entry module makes customer invoicing very easy to manage and post revenue.
reviews.cons: Some of the reporting, while robust, is not conducive for public companies/auditors. Sometimes troubleshooting issues is hard or diving into objects that show up on audit logs is hard to back into. Also having the audit reports limited to people with admin privileges is problematic for managers managing their audit responsibilities and creates SOD conflicts. Having to use external systems for some of the core functionality causes additional expense but is necessary as our company has matured. Engineering problems take months to resolve with customer support.

reviews.title: Strong Financial Visibility & Workflow Efficiency With Room to Modernize
reviews.name: Bob T.
reviews.pros: Sage Intacct has significantly improved financial visibility across our organization. Our entire executive team can easily access real-time financial statements and dashboards, which keeps everyone aligned on performance throughout the fiscal year. The accounts payable workflow is especially strong—routing invoices for department-level approval is straightforward and has streamlined our internal controls. We’ve also reduced paper usage dramatically, which has been a meaningful operational win. Perhaps most valuable is the integration with our CRM, allowing for real-time record keeping and better coordination between finance and revenue functions.
reviews.cons: The interface is starting to feel a bit dated compared to newer platforms, even though it remains clean and functional. Some reporting and filtering capabilities still require extra effort to fine-tune, and we occasionally rely on our consultant to get reports exactly where we need them. That said, this has also created opportunities for cross-team collaboration and deeper understanding of our data.

reviews.cons: The customization of invoices of Sage Intacct require extra skills since mostly is abit advance which takes time and need a training.

reviews.title: Reliable and Easy to Use Accounting Software

reviews.cons: There are some links in reports that seem to not lead anywhere. When you click it, it doesn't lead to the actual transaction where you can see the details.

reviews.title: Product expands as business grows, great product!

reviews.cons: Would like to see the budgeting module able to budget by individual headcount. If Sage could do this, we would add the budget module to our subscription.

reviews.title: Work in Progress
