reviews.cons: Reporting is limited and hard to manipulate to get what you need. No invoice approvals in the system to assign to users to sign off to keep it paperless.

reviews.title: Solid platform, but be prepared to pay extra for every new feature
reviews.name: Heather J.
reviews.pros: The dimensions-based reporting is the biggest win for us. We can slice financials by department, location, and project without creating a bloated chart of accounts. Building custom reports and dashboards is straightforward once you learn the report writer, and everything updates in real time instead of waiting on an Excel export. Support has always been able to solve my issues.
reviews.cons: The biggest frustration is that nearly every meaningful feature is a paid add-on. Basic project tracking is included, but the published capabilities you actually want? Add-on. AI features? Add-on. General journal auto-reconciliation? Add-on. Closing automation? Add-on. Every improvement or new capability they roll out and market seems to come with a separate SKU and another line on the invoice, so the "all-in" cost keeps creeping up well past what you signed for. On top of that, the learning curve is steeper than the sales process suggests, the UI feels dated in places, and support response times can vary depending on who picks up your ticket.

reviews.title: Highly Efficient and Reliable Accounting Solution
reviews.name: Yvonne V.
reviews.pros: Sage Intacct is a powerful and reliable accounting platform. Its reporting capabilities are excellent, allowing for detailed, customizable financial reports that support better decision-making. The system is user-friendly once implemented, and the cloud-based access makes it easy to work from anywhere. I also appreciate the strong audit trails and controls, which are critical for maintaining accuracy and compliance. Overall, it streamlines processes like invoicing, general ledger management, and financial analysis very effectively
reviews.cons: The initial setup and implementation can be time-consuming and may require outside support, especially for more complex organizations. Some modules and features can feel less intuitive at first, and occasional system glitches or delays can occur. Additionally, certain customizations and integrations may require technical expertise or additional cost.

reviews.title: A Comprehensive Financial System That Rewards Proper Setup
reviews.name: Nicole H.
reviews.pros: It allows us to track financial data across departments, projects, and cost centres without creating an overly complex chart of accounts. The dashboards and custom reports provide clear, real-time insights, and the automation of processes like journals and approvals saves significant time compared to manual systems.
reviews.cons: While the system is very powerful, some areas of the interface are not intuitive, and tasks that should be simple can require multiple steps.

reviews.title: Intacct is a winner!
reviews.name: Jennifer P.
reviews.pros: Intacct has given us a quicker close, better reporting, and less software to use! It’s a was to learn software.
reviews.cons: The AP approval process is not as custom as we thought. Outside vendors have a better workflow than the standard Intacct software.

reviews.title: Sage Intacct eases integrations
reviews.name: Liz B.
reviews.pros: We like the user interface of Intacct and the core modules are great and easy to navigate. Because we have to integrate our Procurement, Expense and CRM systems, we like the ability to be able to integrate so many systems that we use seamlessly with the Intacct API. The various modules we use have provided a lot of efficiencies to our internal processes. The order entry module makes customer invoicing very easy to manage and post revenue.
reviews.cons: Some of the reporting, while robust, is not conducive for public companies/auditors. Sometimes troubleshooting issues is hard or diving into objects that show up on audit logs is hard to back into. Also having the audit reports limited to people with admin privileges is problematic for managers managing their audit responsibilities and creates SOD conflicts. Having to use external systems for some of the core functionality causes additional expense but is necessary as our company has matured. Engineering problems take months to resolve with customer support.

reviews.title: Best in Class for Non-Profits
reviews.name: Elizabeth W.
reviews.pros: It is so flexible - we are able to manage grants, contracts and projects in the same space without having to increase the size of our chart of accounts.
reviews.cons: The fixed asset module is not sophisticated - we would prefer to have an internal asset management tool that calculates depreciation and allows for allocations. We currently use one of Intacct's partners for asset management within the system.

reviews.title: Sage Intacct
reviews.name: Phillip M.
reviews.pros: Accessible from anywhere, with strong role-based permissions and the ability to grow with the organization. Smooth connections with systems like Salesforce, bill-pay platforms, and budgeting tools. Real-time access, clear audit trails, and solid internal controls make audits smoother and reduce manual reconciliations. Customizable dashboards give executives and program managers clear visibility into budgets, spending, and outcomes.
reviews.cons: The system is powerful, but navigation and setup can feel complex for new users. Some advanced reports or workflows require help from consultants or Intacct partners.

reviews.title: Sage and integrated partners do it all to save staff time
reviews.name: Rick H.
reviews.pros: It creates efficient processes for all accounting functions. Partner software that integrates with Sage is outstanding.
reviews.cons: In recent years the price has increased substantially. I have seen more than a 20 percent increase and had to sign a long term contract to manage the cost increases.

reviews.title: Finance director
reviews.name: Anita M.
reviews.pros: Implementation of ai. So far we have been using the ap side and I’m working on using the early adapter program for copilot close
reviews.cons: So far not doing the manual coding correctly, in reference to due to/due from. This process is creating hundreds of account code combinations and making the audit much harder

reviews.title: Sage Review
reviews.name: Skylar B.
reviews.pros: Sage is very flexible. I've used Sage in multiple industries, and the flexibility of Sage makes it a good fit across the board.
reviews.cons: While the reporting is quite robust, it is a steep learning curve on building reports. If there was one thing I could change, it would be making a few report builds more accessible to those with limited knowledge and limited needs - while still maintaining the current structure for more complex needs.

reviews.title: Improve on Customer Service
reviews.name: Jennifer R.
reviews.pros: Sage Intacct is user friendly and has worked well for our needs. We utilize the software to manage the accounting for approximately 300 health and welfare trusts.
reviews.cons: The customer service can improve. When we were sold the product, one feature that we were looking at is the ability to make ACH payments directly from Sage. After implementation we were told it could only be set up for one bank account. We were very clear during the entire implementation process that we had a few hundred bank accounts. That was disappointing. Second, each year for our renewal we bring the ACH issue up to see if anything has changed and we have asked multiple times about reporting. We run general ledgers for each of the trusts quarterly and have to manually run each report. We want to see if there is a way to batch run and save individual reports. Last year our rep never circled back and this year it is still floating out there. I'm not sure why that request is so difficult to accommodate. Also, I just received our subscription renewal for the upcoming year and the rates increased anywhere from 31% to 44%, this is unacceptable. They threw in a 3 year subscription to lock in rate increases and that was not an option previously. I manage software costs for our CPA firm and have not seen any increase to this magnitude and it is unacceptable. Last, a couple years ago we double paid our annual subscription because we had forgotten it was on auto pay. It is impossible to get someone on the phone to address these types of issues. While it was our error, it took far too long to resolve and have the money returned to us.

reviews.title: Sage for Non-Profits
reviews.name: Andrew P.
reviews.pros: Sale is a powerful tool for Nonprofits. It allows multiple opportunities to record and report specific Grants. Ease of use
reviews.cons: During file imports when the import has an issue, the File import error messages are pitiful. They provide no real assistance in resolving the import issue. Pricing is significantly higher than other similar products and seems excessive

reviews.title: Great Accounting Software - I would highly recommend!!!
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: Sage Intacct is a great accounting system that is very customizable. It is not as easy to use as a software like QuickBooks Online, but is much more customizable and has greater controls. You can easily create recurring transactions such as journal entries, bills, and invoices for automation. The import function for journal entries has been heavily used in our month end close process which has sped up reconciliations.
reviews.cons: Biggest complaints my staff have had with using Sage Intacct is that it isn't as easy to delete or correct mistakes like in QuickBooks Online. However, I believe this is a benefit as it provides a better audit trail. It also helps my staff to be more diligent in inputting information correctly the first time thus cutting down on mistakes. Sometimes it also takes a few clicks to get from the general ledger down to the transaction you are looking for.

reviews.title: Best decision
reviews.name: Amy C.
reviews.pros: I really enjoy the grant management portion of the product. It has helped our organization greatly with not having to keep track of grant spending manually.
reviews.cons: The budget module was a bit hard to figure out my first time. I feel there are too many steps to a lot of the features.

reviews.title: review nonprofit user 4 years
reviews.name: karen b.
reviews.pros: ease of invoice input and reporting capabilities, like the ability to recreate a transaction and make updates
reviews.cons: cost and flexibility in set up, as a non profit i feel like we had to fit a square peg in a round hole and it feels clunky

reviews.title: Sage is better than Solid
reviews.name: Kevin L.
reviews.pros: Easy to use for reporting and entering data. Creating custom reports is easy. Nagivating between the modules is easy. The bank feeds are great when they work and provide the entire description.
reviews.cons: That you can't make a journal entry spanning different months. Alos, if there is an issue with Bill.com, trying to remedy the issue between the two softwares is tough.

reviews.title: Controller
reviews.name: Dylan B.
reviews.pros: Technical and highly customizable. Easy to use once it's functional with you needs! I would reccomend Lucentive as your implementation specialist.
reviews.cons: Requires time to understand and configure system directly to your needs. Once you have the necessary tailoring done for your organization, the system functions very well.

reviews.title: Sage Intacct- worth the investment even for small organizations
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: Fully SQL product customizable to specific environments. Strong quality control with smart events and triggers to support consistency in data entry and outlier transactions that require additional review.
reviews.cons: Some modules were acquired from third parties; the integration and functionality of these modules are somewhat inconsistent with the core modules integration and functionality. Reporting does not allow inclusion of unposted entries to allow users to see effects of entries before posting. The reclassify and delete functions mitigate the reporting issue. Budgeting functionality is basic. Third party solutions required for more complex budgeting and modeling.

reviews.title: Senior Director of Finance at Battlecreek Church
reviews.name: Shannon Ward W.
reviews.pros: The product itself is robust, able to build high level outputs/reporting/Dashboards as well as granular level down to account/cost center. Also dimension functionality and customer support with [sensitive content hidden] is outstanding and a reason we remain with Sage.
reviews.cons: Fixed Asset module is limited and clunky. The Fixed Asset reporting availability and export feature from screen or module to excel is limited.

reviews.title: Strong Financial Visibility & Workflow Efficiency With Room to Modernize
reviews.name: Bob T.
reviews.pros: Sage Intacct has significantly improved financial visibility across our organization. Our entire executive team can easily access real-time financial statements and dashboards, which keeps everyone aligned on performance throughout the fiscal year. The accounts payable workflow is especially strong—routing invoices for department-level approval is straightforward and has streamlined our internal controls. We’ve also reduced paper usage dramatically, which has been a meaningful operational win. Perhaps most valuable is the integration with our CRM, allowing for real-time record keeping and better coordination between finance and revenue functions.
reviews.cons: The interface is starting to feel a bit dated compared to newer platforms, even though it remains clean and functional. Some reporting and filtering capabilities still require extra effort to fine-tune, and we occasionally rely on our consultant to get reports exactly where we need them. That said, this has also created opportunities for cross-team collaboration and deeper understanding of our data.

Simple to track and manage our cash flows.Very professional and responsive customer service team .
reviews.cons: The customization of invoices of Sage Intacct require extra skills since mostly is abit advance which takes time and need a training.

Because we have to integrate our Procurement, Expense and CRM systems, we like the ability to be able to integrate so many systems that we use seamlessly with the Intacct API. The various modules we use have provided a lot of efficiencies to our internal processes. The order entry module makes customer invoicing very easy to manage and post revenue.
reviews.cons: Some of the reporting, while robust, is not conducive for public companies/auditors. Sometimes troubleshooting issues is hard or diving into objects that show up on audit logs is hard to back into. Also having the audit reports limited to people with admin privileges is problematic for managers managing their audit responsibilities and creates SOD conflicts. Having to use external systems for some of the core functionality causes additional expense but is necessary as our company has matured. Engineering problems take months to resolve with customer support.

reviews.title: Best in Class for Non-Profits
reviews.name: Elizabeth W.
reviews.pros: It is so flexible - we are able to manage grants, contracts and projects in the same space without having to increase the size of our chart of accounts.
reviews.cons: The fixed asset module is not sophisticated - we would prefer to have an internal asset management tool that calculates depreciation and allows for allocations. We currently use one of Intacct's partners for asset management within the system.

reviews.title: Sage Intacct
reviews.name: Phillip M.
reviews.pros: Accessible from anywhere, with strong role-based permissions and the ability to grow with the organization. Smooth connections with systems like Salesforce, bill-pay platforms, and budgeting tools. Real-time access, clear audit trails, and solid internal controls make audits smoother and reduce manual reconciliations. Customizable dashboards give executives and program managers clear visibility into budgets, spending, and outcomes.
reviews.cons: The system is powerful, but navigation and setup can feel complex for new users. Some advanced reports or workflows require help from consultants or Intacct partners.

reviews.title: Sage and integrated partners do it all to save staff time
reviews.name: Rick H.
reviews.pros: It creates efficient processes for all accounting functions. Partner software that integrates with Sage is outstanding.
reviews.cons: In recent years the price has increased substantially. I have seen more than a 20 percent increase and had to sign a long term contract to manage the cost increases.

reviews.title: Finance director
reviews.name: Anita M.
reviews.pros: Implementation of ai. So far we have been using the ap side and I’m working on using the early adapter program for copilot close
reviews.cons: So far not doing the manual coding correctly, in reference to due to/due from. This process is creating hundreds of account code combinations and making the audit much harder

reviews.title: Sage Review
reviews.name: Skylar B.
reviews.pros: Sage is very flexible. I've used Sage in multiple industries, and the flexibility of Sage makes it a good fit across the board.
reviews.cons: While the reporting is quite robust, it is a steep learning curve on building reports. If there was one thing I could change, it would be making a few report builds more accessible to those with limited knowledge and limited needs - while still maintaining the current structure for more complex needs.

reviews.title: Improve on Customer Service
reviews.name: Jennifer R.
reviews.pros: Sage Intacct is user friendly and has worked well for our needs. We utilize the software to manage the accounting for approximately 300 health and welfare trusts.
reviews.cons: The customer service can improve. When we were sold the product, one feature that we were looking at is the ability to make ACH payments directly from Sage. After implementation we were told it could only be set up for one bank account. We were very clear during the entire implementation process that we had a few hundred bank accounts. That was disappointing. Second, each year for our renewal we bring the ACH issue up to see if anything has changed and we have asked multiple times about reporting. We run general ledgers for each of the trusts quarterly and have to manually run each report. We want to see if there is a way to batch run and save individual reports. Last year our rep never circled back and this year it is still floating out there. I'm not sure why that request is so difficult to accommodate. Also, I just received our subscription renewal for the upcoming year and the rates increased anywhere from 31% to 44%, this is unacceptable. They threw in a 3 year subscription to lock in rate increases and that was not an option previously. I manage software costs for our CPA firm and have not seen any increase to this magnitude and it is unacceptable. Last, a couple years ago we double paid our annual subscription because we had forgotten it was on auto pay. It is impossible to get someone on the phone to address these types of issues. While it was our error, it took far too long to resolve and have the money returned to us.

reviews.title: Sage for Non-Profits
reviews.name: Andrew P.
reviews.pros: Sale is a powerful tool for Nonprofits. It allows multiple opportunities to record and report specific Grants. Ease of use
reviews.cons: During file imports when the import has an issue, the File import error messages are pitiful. They provide no real assistance in resolving the import issue. Pricing is significantly higher than other similar products and seems excessive

reviews.title: Great Accounting Software - I would highly recommend!!!
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: Sage Intacct is a great accounting system that is very customizable. It is not as easy to use as a software like QuickBooks Online, but is much more customizable and has greater controls. You can easily create recurring transactions such as journal entries, bills, and invoices for automation. The import function for journal entries has been heavily used in our month end close process which has sped up reconciliations.
reviews.cons: Biggest complaints my staff have had with using Sage Intacct is that it isn't as easy to delete or correct mistakes like in QuickBooks Online. However, I believe this is a benefit as it provides a better audit trail. It also helps my staff to be more diligent in inputting information correctly the first time thus cutting down on mistakes. Sometimes it also takes a few clicks to get from the general ledger down to the transaction you are looking for.

reviews.title: Best decision
reviews.name: Amy C.
reviews.pros: I really enjoy the grant management portion of the product. It has helped our organization greatly with not having to keep track of grant spending manually.
reviews.cons: The budget module was a bit hard to figure out my first time. I feel there are too many steps to a lot of the features.

reviews.title: review nonprofit user 4 years
reviews.name: karen b.
reviews.pros: ease of invoice input and reporting capabilities, like the ability to recreate a transaction and make updates
reviews.cons: cost and flexibility in set up, as a non profit i feel like we had to fit a square peg in a round hole and it feels clunky

reviews.title: Sage is better than Solid
reviews.name: Kevin L.
reviews.pros: Easy to use for reporting and entering data. Creating custom reports is easy. Nagivating between the modules is easy. The bank feeds are great when they work and provide the entire description.
reviews.cons: That you can't make a journal entry spanning different months. Alos, if there is an issue with Bill.com, trying to remedy the issue between the two softwares is tough.

reviews.title: Controller
reviews.name: Dylan B.
reviews.pros: Technical and highly customizable. Easy to use once it's functional with you needs! I would reccomend Lucentive as your implementation specialist.
reviews.cons: Requires time to understand and configure system directly to your needs. Once you have the necessary tailoring done for your organization, the system functions very well.

reviews.title: Sage Intacct- worth the investment even for small organizations
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: Fully SQL product customizable to specific environments. Strong quality control with smart events and triggers to support consistency in data entry and outlier transactions that require additional review.
reviews.cons: Some modules were acquired from third parties; the integration and functionality of these modules are somewhat inconsistent with the core modules integration and functionality. Reporting does not allow inclusion of unposted entries to allow users to see effects of entries before posting. The reclassify and delete functions mitigate the reporting issue. Budgeting functionality is basic. Third party solutions required for more complex budgeting and modeling.

reviews.title: Senior Director of Finance at Battlecreek Church
reviews.name: Shannon Ward W.
reviews.pros: The product itself is robust, able to build high level outputs/reporting/Dashboards as well as granular level down to account/cost center. Also dimension functionality and customer support with [sensitive content hidden] is outstanding and a reason we remain with Sage.
reviews.cons: Fixed Asset module is limited and clunky. The Fixed Asset reporting availability and export feature from screen or module to excel is limited.

reviews.title: Strong Financial Visibility & Workflow Efficiency With Room to Modernize
reviews.name: Bob T.
reviews.pros: Sage Intacct has significantly improved financial visibility across our organization. Our entire executive team can easily access real-time financial statements and dashboards, which keeps everyone aligned on performance throughout the fiscal year. The accounts payable workflow is especially strong—routing invoices for department-level approval is straightforward and has streamlined our internal controls. We’ve also reduced paper usage dramatically, which has been a meaningful operational win. Perhaps most valuable is the integration with our CRM, allowing for real-time record keeping and better coordination between finance and revenue functions.
reviews.cons: The interface is starting to feel a bit dated compared to newer platforms, even though it remains clean and functional. Some reporting and filtering capabilities still require extra effort to fine-tune, and we occasionally rely on our consultant to get reports exactly where we need them. That said, this has also created opportunities for cross-team collaboration and deeper understanding of our data.

reviews.title: The Real Guru for Financial Management.
reviews.name: Esami Allan J.
reviews.pros: It is simple to generate custom reports .Has a intuitive and user friendly interface that make it easy to use and understand.Automate billing and invoicing process.Prioritizes the security of financial data. Simple to track and manage our cash flows.Very professional and responsive customer service team .
reviews.cons: The customization of invoices of Sage Intacct require extra skills since mostly is abit advance which takes time and need a training.

reviews.title: More Complex Software for demanding businesses
reviews.name: Vincent C.
reviews.pros: Streamlines complex operations with real-time data, boosts efficiency across finance/supply chain, and scales easily for growing businesses.
reviews.cons: Certain tiers be expensive, complex to set up, and may require training or consultants to use effectively.

reviews.title: Powerful and Flexible ERP with Strong Functional Depth
reviews.name: Usman K.
reviews.pros: Strong flexibility and scalability across modules, especially in finance, manufacturing, and supply chain. The system allows extensive customization, robust reporting (SQL/Query Tool), and supports complex processes like inter-site, multi-company, and regulatory compliance integrations
reviews.cons: The user interface can feel outdated and less intuitive compared to modern systems. Performance may slow down with large data volumes, and some configurations require strong technical knowledge, making implementation and troubleshooting more complex

reviews.title: I would not recommend Sage X3
reviews.name: Brian T.
reviews.pros: The modern user interface and feature richness. The ability to add custom fields and business logic in the core processes. Users can customize the menu system to exactly what they need and skip the rest.
reviews.cons: Sage charging us for services that we could not use. Their warranty is designed to be useless. The 3rd party add on for warehouse management called Datalinx is closed source and takes way too much back and forth to get customizations made by the small staff in England. I was misled by our Sage partner that Datalinx was just as customizable as core X3. Without Datalinx X3s warehouse/barcode abilities were so dismal that they would not even sell it to me. They switched to subscription only and seem to dislike us because we have a perpetual license, even though we pay annual support.

reviews.title: Good overall, better for smaller businesses
reviews.name: Sophie F.
reviews.pros: Sage X3 is a good financial system for a small to medium company. Transactions are easy to track and to post with the relevant screens that can be navigated through. It is also good for a company with multiple entities as these can be interchanged and tracked easily. The reporting functionality 'SEI' which is an excel add in is quite good and allows individuals to create reports which can be used for relevant purposes. This is a quick and easy way of getting information from the system. the debtors and creditors aging reporting is also quite good which allows us to see a good overview of the transactional aspects of the business.
reviews.cons: Difficult to make any changes if required. There is little information available for self help so if any changes need to be made or assistance then this usually requires an additional cost or discussions with specialists which can be timely and costly. For example, a change in the year end date was not easy for us as there has been forward postings for deferred revenue. Additionally control is a bit lacking with Sage X3, it is difficult to do things like close down month end or specify roles due to having to look in multiple places. A simple month end close you have to go to about 4/5 screens so it is easy to make mistakes here. It is also difficult to upgrade when different patches are released and usually you have to get specialist help with this which can be expensive.

reviews.title: Sage X3 - Worth while!
reviews.name: Spencer K.
reviews.pros: The customizability of Sage allowed for us to manage our unique products and sales processes in a way not previously possible.
reviews.cons: There are a handful of restrictions that make it difficult. An example includes not being able to allocate product to quotes.

reviews.title: DO NOT RECOMMEND
reviews.name: TEKA J.
reviews.pros: VERSITILE COVERS MANY ASPECTS OF BUSINESS. HAS MANY USEFUL TOOLS IF YOU ARE TRAINED PROPERLY AND KNOW HOW TO NAVIGATE THE SYSTEM.
reviews.cons: NOT USER-FRIENDLY AT ALL, IF YOU ARE NOT FAMILIAR YOU WILL GET A LOT OF ERRORS AND CREATE PROBLEMS BEHIND THE SCENES THAT YOU AREN'T EVEN AWARE OF. LEAVES VERY LITTLE ROOM FOR ERROR TO FIX THINGS THAT HAVE BEEN MIXED UP.

reviews.title: Powerful but not something you learn overnight
reviews.name: Claudia G.
reviews.pros: I’have been using Sage X3 close to last year now mainly handling inventory and reposting. The flexibility stand out. we’ve adjusted workflow, built custom reports using the query tool, and connected it with other system through web services. It handles multi location stock and finance together, which saves a lit of back and forth.
reviews.cons: The learning curve is real. Some workflows are not very obvious and you need proper training to understand how things connect. Documentation could be better in some areas.

reviews.title: SageX3 ERP Review
reviews.name: Louis A.
reviews.pros: Customization options within the ERP software. Compared to other players in the ERP field I think it is a good value proposition.
reviews.cons: The amount of available documentation seems a little sparse from the website. Also if you use the Sage University for training they limit documentation that you can download.

reviews.title: Sage X3 - Best Stock system
reviews.name: Lyn J.
reviews.pros: Sage X3 is a brilliant stock based sage system. It has enhanced features for costing and warehouse management.
reviews.cons: My least favourite components of sage X3 is the complexity of the system. There is not a beginner friendly system, but useful when learnt.

reviews.title: Sage X3 Review
reviews.name: Haley C.
reviews.pros: It is customizable, and widely used for a variety of company types. We use a vendor and experience easy implementation.
reviews.cons: I don’t know 4GL, so instead of in house customizations we have a third party vendor for our changes.

reviews.title: Great ERP Solution
reviews.name: Ian W.
reviews.pros: Intuitive menu structure and easy to use once the basics have been learnt. Very flexible and can be customized to suit your business
reviews.cons: Relatively complex initial set up and not the quickest of systems as always a processing delay

reviews.title: Sage X3 Review
reviews.name: PEGGIE W.
reviews.pros: So many ways to process data and a wide array of reports for data view the information that you are looking for.
reviews.cons: Data Entry of payments a bit lengthy--too much manual effort at times. Would like to be able to do multiple lines at once or in a more flowing way.

reviews.title: Powerful ERP Solution & Room for Usability Improvements
reviews.name: Preci T.
reviews.pros: Sage X3 is a robust and flexible ERP system that excels in managing complex business operations across multiple departments, locations, and even countries. I particularly appreciated the customization options and its powerful reporting capabilities. The workflow automation and audit tracking features also significantly streamlined our business processes and improved visibility across the board.
reviews.cons: The user interface is not the most intuitive especially for new users or non technical staff. There is a steep learning curve and the system requires thorough training to unlock its full potential. While customization is a strength it often requires developer support which can become costly over time. Some updates and patches have also caused temporary disruptions.

reviews.title: A Strong ERP with a Steep Learning Curve
reviews.name: Sidina S.
reviews.pros: Sage X3 excels with its robust flexibility, end-to-end ERP functionality, and industry-specific scalability.
reviews.cons: The user interface feels outdated, and the learning curve can be steep for new users due to its complex navigation.

reviews.title: Accounting
reviews.name: Francis O.
reviews.pros: My most like features about sage is that it's an easy to use all purpose software
reviews.cons: My least like features is that sage has plenty accounting formula

reviews.title: Robust ERP for Medium to Large Enterprises – But Needs Better UX
reviews.name: Omkarsingh T.
reviews.pros: Handles multiple entities and international operations well.
reviews.cons: The user interface feels outdated and can be confusing for new users. Reports and dashboards require a learning curve; not beginner-friendly. Initial setup and customization took longer than expected. Customer support can be slow at times.

reviews.title: The Wonders of Sage X3
reviews.name: Brandon R.
reviews.pros: Sage X3 offers increased scalability, enhanced visibility, improved efficiency, and better decision-making capabilities.
reviews.cons: There are some difficulties with custom configurations, inconsistent customer Support, and limited quality control.

reviews.title: Good Enough
reviews.name: Keely M.
reviews.pros: AP is what we use this for, and it is quite easy to use.
reviews.cons: Set up and customization is hard. There are so many menus in the back, to change or update anything it feels like I have to go into several menus. None of which you could figure out on your own - you will most likely be forced to have a 3rd party research and help resolve issues. At least tell you all the menus you have to go into in order to get something to work.

reviews.title: Good software
reviews.name: Kraig G.
reviews.pros: Sage X3 is good software with a very robust set of features. Tasks such as completing quotes and orders are easy to complete.
reviews.cons: The only thing that I wish was different was the creation of new users. Instead of having multiple screen for setting up a user, everything should be in one place.

reviews.title: Support Model Needs an Update
reviews.name: Ed W.
reviews.pros: This is a very functional and complex ERP application. A robust and expensive to support.
reviews.cons: The support model is lacking in overall expertise. We have used changed support organizations twice due to lack of knowledge on attempting to implement a 3rd party application. Sharing and collaboration of resources between the organizations is cumbersome and the pricing for this expertise, due to complexity of the application, is very expensive.

reviews.title: Sage X3 Review
reviews.name: Katherine H.
reviews.pros: Wide ranging solution which allows flexibility in processes
reviews.cons: When items which seem like they should be business standard are not included and bespoke is required at additional cost

reviews.title: A good ERP system
reviews.name: Christy S.
reviews.pros: X3 is highly configurable. Its intercompany functionality is substantial. Administrators have a ton of control over the user experience-- what they see, default fields, hiding fields, permissions, etc is all highly configurable without needing to be an IT genius to figure it out.
reviews.cons: The ability to receive help. The help function is somewhat helpful sometimes but is not updated as often as it should be. The user community is lacking. I would love to be able to post on a message board about my problem, but when I have done that I have rarely gotten the answers I need. Solutions to X. problems are not "googleable"

reviews.title: Natha's Review of X3
reviews.name: Nathan K.
reviews.pros: Has lots of functionality. can take acre of most of our requirements Good role based security
reviews.cons: Proprietary language for modifications. Where do I learn all the commands and see a library of examples? Interface look and feel is 20 years old. only crystal for generating reports.

reviews.title: Really software adjustable to any type of medium or large company
reviews.name: Daniel R.
reviews.pros: What I liked the most is the versatility it has to adapt to the needs of any type of business, a great alternative for ERP. The variety of configurations that can be modified as well as the functionalities that can greatly save response times. The presentation and easy to create reports with very simple and guided quearys also The user interface is foolproof which is a great solution for the support and information department.
reviews.cons: As an administrator I always have problems when it comes to support and debugging problems presented in the application in which many of them are not documented properly. The Reports are very colorful and well structured but at the moment of the output they take a long time to appear. I had some problems in the version update and the service pack caused some headaches

reviews.title: Pretty good but without advanced features
reviews.name: Matthew C.
reviews.pros: The structure of the software is good and allows for good navigation. It has some standard features that are good.
reviews.cons: It does not have many of the features that I would like to see for Quality Control. It does not have a good place to enter test results. It is not clear how to customize it for compliance with 21 CFR Part 11.

reviews.name: Katherine H.
reviews.pros: Wide ranging solution which allows flexibility in processes
reviews.cons: When items which seem like they should be business standard are not included and bespoke is required at additional cost

reviews.title: A good ERP system
reviews.name: Christy S.
reviews.pros: X3 is highly configurable. Its intercompany functionality is substantial. Administrators have a ton of control over the user experience-- what they see, default fields, hiding fields, permissions, etc is all highly configurable without needing to be an IT genius to figure it out.
reviews.cons: The ability to receive help. The help function is somewhat helpful sometimes but is not updated as often as it should be. The user community is lacking. I would love to be able to post on a message board about my problem, but when I have done that I have rarely gotten the answers I need. Solutions to X. problems are not "googleable"

reviews.title: Natha's Review of X3
reviews.name: Nathan K.
reviews.pros: Has lots of functionality. can take acre of most of our requirements Good role based security
reviews.cons: Proprietary language for modifications. Where do I learn all the commands and see a library of examples? Interface look and feel is 20 years old. only crystal for generating reports.

reviews.title: Really software adjustable to any type of medium or large company
reviews.name: Daniel R.
reviews.pros: What I liked the most is the versatility it has to adapt to the needs of any type of business, a great alternative for ERP. The variety of configurations that can be modified as well as the functionalities that can greatly save response times. The presentation and easy to create reports with very simple and guided quearys also The user interface is foolproof which is a great solution for the support and information department.
reviews.cons: As an administrator I always have problems when it comes to support and debugging problems presented in the application in which many of them are not documented properly. The Reports are very colorful and well structured but at the moment of the output they take a long time to appear. I had some problems in the version update and the service pack caused some headaches

reviews.title: Pretty good but without advanced features
reviews.name: Matthew C.
reviews.pros: The structure of the software is good and allows for good navigation. It has some standard features that are good.
reviews.cons: It does not have many of the features that I would like to see for Quality Control. It does not have a good place to enter test results. It is not clear how to customize it for compliance with 21 CFR Part 11.

reviews.title: More Complex Software for demanding businesses
reviews.name: Vincent C.
reviews.pros: Streamlines complex operations with real-time data, boosts efficiency across finance/supply chain, and scales easily for growing businesses.
reviews.cons: Certain tiers be expensive, complex to set up, and may require training or consultants to use effectively.

reviews.title: Powerful and Flexible ERP with Strong Functional Depth
reviews.name: Usman K.
reviews.pros: Strong flexibility and scalability across modules, especially in finance, manufacturing, and supply chain. The system allows extensive customization, robust reporting (SQL/Query Tool), and supports complex processes like inter-site, multi-company, and regulatory compliance integrations
reviews.cons: The user interface can feel outdated and less intuitive compared to modern systems. Performance may slow down with large data volumes, and some configurations require strong technical knowledge, making implementation and troubleshooting more complex

reviews.title: I would not recommend Sage X3
reviews.name: Brian T.
reviews.pros: The modern user interface and feature richness. The ability to add custom fields and business logic in the core processes. Users can customize the menu system to exactly what they need and skip the rest.
reviews.cons: Sage charging us for services that we could not use. Their warranty is designed to be useless. The 3rd party add on for warehouse management called Datalinx is closed source and takes way too much back and forth to get customizations made by the small staff in England. I was misled by our Sage partner that Datalinx was just as customizable as core X3. Without Datalinx X3s warehouse/barcode abilities were so dismal that they would not even sell it to me. They switched to subscription only and seem to dislike us because we have a perpetual license, even though we pay annual support.

reviews.title: Good overall, better for smaller businesses
reviews.name: Sophie F.
reviews.pros: Sage X3 is a good financial system for a small to medium company. Transactions are easy to track and to post with the relevant screens that can be navigated through. It is also good for a company with multiple entities as these can be interchanged and tracked easily. The reporting functionality 'SEI' which is an excel add in is quite good and allows individuals to create reports which can be used for relevant purposes. This is a quick and easy way of getting information from the system. the debtors and creditors aging reporting is also quite good which allows us to see a good overview of the transactional aspects of the business.
reviews.cons: Difficult to make any changes if required. There is little information available for self help so if any changes need to be made or assistance then this usually requires an additional cost or discussions with specialists which can be timely and costly. For example, a change in the year end date was not easy for us as there has been forward postings for deferred revenue. Additionally control is a bit lacking with Sage X3, it is difficult to do things like close down month end or specify roles due to having to look in multiple places. A simple month end close you have to go to about 4/5 screens so it is easy to make mistakes here. It is also difficult to upgrade when different patches are released and usually you have to get specialist help with this which can be expensive.

reviews.title: Sage X3 - Worth while!
reviews.name: Spencer K.
reviews.pros: The customizability of Sage allowed for us to manage our unique products and sales processes in a way not previously possible.
reviews.cons: There are a handful of restrictions that make it difficult. An example includes not being able to allocate product to quotes.

reviews.title: DO NOT RECOMMEND
reviews.name: TEKA J.
reviews.pros: VERSITILE COVERS MANY ASPECTS OF BUSINESS. HAS MANY USEFUL TOOLS IF YOU ARE TRAINED PROPERLY AND KNOW HOW TO NAVIGATE THE SYSTEM.
reviews.cons: NOT USER-FRIENDLY AT ALL, IF YOU ARE NOT FAMILIAR YOU WILL GET A LOT OF ERRORS AND CREATE PROBLEMS BEHIND THE SCENES THAT YOU AREN'T EVEN AWARE OF. LEAVES VERY LITTLE ROOM FOR ERROR TO FIX THINGS THAT HAVE BEEN MIXED UP.

reviews.title: Powerful but not something you learn overnight
reviews.name: Claudia G.
reviews.pros: I’have been using Sage X3 close to last year now mainly handling inventory and reposting. The flexibility stand out. we’ve adjusted workflow, built custom reports using the query tool, and connected it with other system through web services. It handles multi location stock and finance together, which saves a lit of back and forth.
reviews.cons: The learning curve is real. Some workflows are not very obvious and you need proper training to understand how things connect. Documentation could be better in some areas.

reviews.title: SageX3 ERP Review
reviews.name: Louis A.
reviews.pros: Customization options within the ERP software. Compared to other players in the ERP field I think it is a good value proposition.
reviews.cons: The amount of available documentation seems a little sparse from the website. Also if you use the Sage University for training they limit documentation that you can download.

reviews.title: Sage X3 - Best Stock system

reviews.pros: Sage X3 is a brilliant stock based sage system. It has enhanced features for costing and warehouse management.
reviews.cons: My least favourite components of sage X3 is the complexity of the system. There is not a beginner friendly system, but useful when learnt.

reviews.title: Sage X3 Review

reviews.title: Powerful ERP Solution & Room for Usability Improvements

reviews.pros: Sage X3 is a robust and flexible ERP system that excels in managing complex business operations across multiple departments, locations, and even countries. reviews.pros: Customization options within the ERP software. Compared to other players in the ERP field I think it is a good value proposition.
reviews.cons: The amount of available documentation seems a little sparse from the website. Also if you use the Sage University for training they limit documentation that you can download.

reviews.title: Sage X3 - Best Stock system
reviews.name: Lyn J.
reviews.pros: Sage X3 is a brilliant stock based sage system. It has enhanced features for costing and warehouse management.
reviews.cons: My least favourite components of sage X3 is the complexity of the system. There is not a beginner friendly system, but useful when learnt.

reviews.title: Sage X3 Review
reviews.name: Haley C.
reviews.pros: It is customizable, and widely used for a variety of company types. We use a vendor and experience easy implementation.
reviews.cons: I don’t know 4GL, so instead of in house customizations we have a third party vendor for our changes.

reviews.title: Great ERP Solution
reviews.name: Ian W.
reviews.pros: Intuitive menu structure and easy to use once the basics have been learnt. Very flexible and can be customized to suit your business
reviews.cons: Relatively complex initial set up and not the quickest of systems as always a processing delay

reviews.title: Sage X3 Review
reviews.name: PEGGIE W.
reviews.pros: So many ways to process data and a wide array of reports for data view the information that you are looking for.
reviews.cons: Data Entry of payments a bit lengthy--too much manual effort at times. Would like to be able to do multiple lines at once or in a more flowing way.

reviews.title: Powerful ERP Solution & Room for Usability Improvements
reviews.name: Preci T.
reviews.pros: Sage X3 is a robust and flexible ERP system that excels in managing complex business operations across multiple departments, locations, and even countries. I particularly appreciated the customization options and its powerful reporting capabilities. The workflow automation and audit tracking features also significantly streamlined our business processes and improved visibility across the board.
reviews.cons: The user interface is not the most intuitive especially for new users or non technical staff. There is a steep learning curve and the system requires thorough training to unlock its full potential. While customization is a strength it often requires developer support which can become costly over time. Some updates and patches have also caused temporary disruptions.

reviews.title: A Strong ERP with a Steep Learning Curve
reviews.name: Sidina S.
reviews.pros: Sage X3 excels with its robust flexibility, end-to-end ERP functionality, and industry-specific scalability.
reviews.cons: The user interface feels outdated, and the learning curve can be steep for new users due to its complex navigation.

reviews.title: Accounting
reviews.name: Francis O.
reviews.pros: My most like features about sage is that it's an easy to use all purpose software
reviews.cons: My least like features is that sage has plenty accounting formula

reviews.title: Robust ERP for Medium to Large Enterprises – But Needs Better UX
reviews.name: Omkarsingh T.
reviews.pros: Handles multiple entities and international operations well.
reviews.cons: The user interface feels outdated and can be confusing for new users. Reports and dashboards require a learning curve; not beginner-friendly. Initial setup and customization took longer than expected. Customer support can be slow at times.

reviews.title: The Wonders of Sage X3
reviews.name: Brandon R.
reviews.pros: Sage X3 offers increased scalability, enhanced visibility, improved efficiency, and better decision-making capabilities.
reviews.cons: There are some difficulties with custom configurations, inconsistent customer Support, and limited quality control.

reviews.title: Good Enough
reviews.name: Keely M.
reviews.pros: AP is what we use this for, and it is quite easy to use.
reviews.cons: Set up and customization is hard. There are so many menus in the back, to change or update anything it feels like I have to go into several menus. None of which you could figure out on your own - you will most likely be forced to have a 3rd party research and help resolve issues. At least tell you all the menus you have to go into in order to get something to work.

reviews.title: Good software
reviews.name: Kraig G.
reviews.pros: Sage X3 is good software with a very robust set of features. Tasks such as completing quotes and orders are easy to complete.
reviews.cons: The only thing that I wish was different was the creation of new users. Instead of having multiple screen for setting up a user, everything should be in one place.

reviews.title: Support Model Needs an Update
reviews.name: Ed W.
reviews.pros: This is a very functional and complex ERP application. A robust and expensive to support.
reviews.cons: The support model is lacking in overall expertise. We have used changed support organizations twice due to lack of knowledge on attempting to implement a 3rd party application. Sharing and collaboration of resources between the organizations is cumbersome and the pricing for this expertise, due to complexity of the application, is very expensive.

reviews.title: Sage X3 Review
reviews.name: Katherine H.
reviews.pros: Wide ranging solution which allows flexibility in processes
reviews.cons: When items which seem like they should be business standard are not included and bespoke is required at additional cost

reviews.title: A good ERP system
reviews.name: Christy S.
reviews.pros: X3 is highly configurable. Its intercompany functionality is substantial. Administrators have a ton of control over the user experience-- what they see, default fields, hiding fields, permissions, etc is all highly configurable without needing to be an IT genius to figure it out.
reviews.cons: The ability to receive help. The help function is somewhat helpful sometimes but is not updated as often as it should be. The user community is lacking. I would love to be able to post on a message board about my problem, but when I have done that I have rarely gotten the answers I need. Solutions to X. problems are not "googleable"

reviews.title: Natha's Review of X3
reviews.name: Nathan K.
reviews.pros: Has lots of functionality. can take acre of most of our requirements Good role based security
reviews.cons: Proprietary language for modifications. Where do I learn all the commands and see a library of examples? Interface look and feel is 20 years old. only crystal for generating reports.

reviews.title: Really software adjustable to any type of medium or large company
reviews.name: Daniel R.
reviews.pros: What I liked the most is the versatility it has to adapt to the needs of any type of business, a great alternative for ERP. The variety of configurations that can be modified as well as the functionalities that can greatly save response times. The presentation and easy to create reports with very simple and guided quearys also The user interface is foolproof which is a great solution for the support and information department.
reviews.cons: As an administrator I always have problems when it comes to support and debugging problems presented in the application in which many of them are not documented properly. The Reports are very colorful and well structured but at the moment of the output they take a long time to appear. I had some problems in the version update and the service pack caused some headaches

reviews.title: Pretty good but without advanced features
reviews.name: Matthew C.
reviews.pros: The structure of the software is good and allows for good navigation. It has some standard features that are good.
reviews.cons: It does not have many of the features that I would like to see for Quality Control. It does not have a good place to enter test results. It is not clear how to customize it for compliance with 21 CFR Part 11.

reviews.title: Still a strong performer
reviews.name: Suzanne D.
reviews.pros: Ease of use, simple to follow. This tool helps most payment and HR type functionality to z good standard
reviews.cons: With the use of modern technology it might be looking a little in need of AI visually, would suggest more options to be available

reviews.title: SAP Concur - Worth the time and Money
reviews.name: Patty B.
reviews.pros: Easy to use Can scan/ use from phone, tablet or PC on or off line. Visa statements can be sent and easily uploaded and coded Records the expenses automatically - no manual input required You can have default expense coding which can be easily changed if required Many levels of review and authorization can be set up..
reviews.cons: If an expenses is shared between departments this requires manual changes to the default expenses codes

reviews.title: Great tool for businesses
reviews.name: Stefan B.
reviews.pros: The ease of documents submission especially from the phone is amazing. After 5 trips, all i had to do is snap some photos upload, job is done
reviews.cons: User experience sometimes can be really confusing. But once you get used to it it’s actually suited for the job.

reviews.title: Convenient but Clunky: A Mixed Experience with SAP Concur
reviews.name: Arti R.
reviews.pros: SAP Concur makes expense tracking way easier—everything’s in one place and you can snap receipts on the go. Approvals are faster, and it cuts down on manual entry. I like how it integrates with travel booking too, so trips and expenses stay organized. Helps keep things compliant without much effort.
reviews.cons: SAP Concur can feel clunky and outdated, especially the interface. It’s not always intuitive, so simple tasks take extra clicks. Mobile app can be glitchy at times. Also, setup and customization seem overly complex, and syncing issues occasionally cause delays with expenses or approvals.

reviews.title: 95% of the Way is Still an "A"
reviews.name: Mark M.
reviews.pros: The expense reporting system is very easy to use, and flows nicely. Importing invoices either via app or scans is very simple and easy to use. Concur also allowed us to customize categories of expenses and accounts to put them to. Finally, it has a nice set up for booking travel via all the big outlets (hotel/airfare/rental cars/train). It also has allowed our company to identify preferred providers and push users toward those providers.
reviews.cons: Reporting isn't great. Trying to get customized reporting for accounting purposes is definitely a struggle. Additionally, if you have less than conventional travel (one way train, where you want to change category during the trip (coach for part of the trip/sleeper for second part)) it's not quite flexible enough to handle those situations. Not a huge deal, but can be annoying at times.

reviews.title: This makes expenses easy
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: It’s super straightforward for expense tracking. Making itemizations, especially for hotels, makes it very easy to use. My colleague also had a weird bug where he could t log in and we were able to get on a call with customer support quickly, who resolved the issue. It’s also helpful with showing you the approval process and audit timeline.
reviews.cons: I really don’t have any. It’s a great platform for expenses and has an efficient payment processing path batched in, making it a great option, with high value for the money.

reviews.title: The most versatile program out there
reviews.name: Jeremy H.
reviews.pros: The flexibility to use SAP programs in nearly every aspect of my work life. Being able to manipulate the programs to work with what we need when we need it
reviews.cons: Can be overwhelming over time with how many transactions interact with each other when you are needing to change something

reviews.title: SAP Concur program designers, please go back to drawing board.
reviews.name: David K.
reviews.pros: The sign in process is easy. Other than that, I cannot think of anything there is to like about SAP Concur.
reviews.cons: Cumbersome. Not user friendly. It takes hours to complete a simple report. There are many problems matching up receipts with expenses. Not being able to talk with someone to help solve use problems.

reviews.title: Media Sales using Concur for a long time
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: It's easy to navigate and to add expenses. Attachments are easy to add as a pdf. You can also add separately what the expense was for as it relates to each entry.
reviews.cons: If you don't have the name of the people at a particular business that you are adding the expense to, it's a little complicated to search. If they are there then you just add them.

reviews.title: Concur Works
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: Ease of expense reporting, uploading receipts, approving multiple expense reports and the warning system for errors.
reviews.cons: The online travel booking features are slow, do not provide the same discounts, and have added travel fees.

reviews.title: What’s SAP Concur
reviews.name: Jackline A.
reviews.pros: SAP Concur automates repetitive accounting procedures that help save time and reduce financial errors.
reviews.cons: Apart from lack of some features in mobile application that are available in cloud apps, I do not have any other issue.

reviews.title: Expense Reporting made easy with Concur
reviews.name: Gene B.
reviews.pros: My corporate card expenses get preloaded into an expense report for me and the majority of the time have the correct expense category and details filled out which saves me time.
reviews.cons: Sometimes Concur is fussy when trying to use the mileage calculator. It insists on using the shortest route, not necessarily the route taken given consideration to traffic, accidents, etc.

reviews.title: Good tool for capturing and submitting expenses
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: Great tool for submitting expenses, I like the feature that automatically identifies the value of the receipt as you load it in.
reviews.cons: Can sometimes feel like there are too many steps to capture and submit an expense. It would be good if it automatically loaded the receipts into your existing claim without you having to do it yourself.

reviews.title: SAP Concur Review: Streamlining Expenses with Some Trade-Offs
reviews.name: Faisal M.
reviews.pros: I’ve used SAP Concur for managing travel and expenses, and it has its strengths along with a few drawbacks. Great Value for Money. Strong automation for expense capture and approvals •Reliable payment and reimbursement processing •Solid corporate card integration •Detailed, customizable reporting options •Saves time once workflows are set up
reviews.cons: Interface feels outdated and not always intuitive •Steeper learning curve for new users •Report generation can be time-consuming

reviews.title: Great mobile app
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: Very easy to use with the mobile app that allows you to upload receipts on the go and also check booked travel information.
reviews.cons: It can be cumbersome to work through expense reports with multiple different click throughs and flags to respond to.

reviews.title: Good for Tracking Expenses, but Could Be More User-Friendly
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: I like that SAP Concur keeps a history of all submitted expenses, making it easy to track past reports and reference previous submissions when needed.
reviews.cons: I find the expense process a bit disorganized. When an expense is returned, it’s not easy to see the details or understand the reason. It would also be helpful to have templates for recurring expenses. Adding expenses from outside the country I work in can be challenging, especially when using a credit card, since the final amount charged often differs from what’s entered in the system. A feature that allows you to capture and reconcile the actual credit card charge would make the process much smoother.

reviews.title: Easy interface that helps to organize expenses
reviews.name: Melissa S.
reviews.pros: What I like most about SAP Concur is the iPhone app. The interface is easy to use and allows me to keep ahead of my expense report during a business trip.
reviews.cons: What I like least about Concur is that uploading receipts can be glitchy. Often, photos of receipts do not appear after taken in the app. I always take an additional photo outside of the app as a backup.

reviews.title: Can't keep track? SAP Concur does it for you.
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: What I like most about SAP concur is that it keeps all my expenses in one place and identifies expenses that is tied into my e-mail. I also liked it ensures that I include all the required information for each expense and allows me to create different reports for different expenses.
reviews.cons: I am not a fan of SAP concurs AI tool that automatically pulls information from the receipt and puts it into each category because, in my experience, most of the time the information that the AI pulls from the receipt is not correct.

reviews.title: Good system
reviews.name: Victoria H.
reviews.pros: Easy to use and get reimbursements for company expenses and travel reimbursement as well so I liked it
reviews.cons: Uploading receipts to the system which I felt was outdated because you had to scan your receipts to provide proof

reviews.title: Good expense report tool
reviews.name: Chris T.
reviews.pros: Good mobile app which makes it easy to capture receipts with your phone camera. Concur scans the receipts and fills in the details. You can also forward any email receipts.
reviews.cons: It is my 2nd favorite expense report app behind Expensify. The features are basically the same, but I find Expensify more intuitive to use.

reviews.title: It gets the job done, but the interface is a bit complex to navigate/understand
reviews.name: Dave L.
reviews.pros: What I like most about Concur is it gives me a way to enter in my company expenses, keep track of them, and give me notifications every step along the way of it's review/approval process.
reviews.cons: The user interface is complicated. So much so now I no longer create new expenses from scratch... I copy a previous one because that's theonly way I know how to enter certain expenses.

reviews.title: Expense reporting fast and easy
reviews.name: Tammy W.
reviews.pros: We have used SAP Concur for a couple of years now and it has made our expense reporting fast and easy. The photos on the go for receipts has been invaluable.
reviews.cons: The only thing I don't like about SAP Concur is to have to do a header report summary. This is double work as all the same information can be found in each expense.

reviews.title: SAP Concur - A great expenses management software
reviews.name: Kanika B.
reviews.pros: Concur makes expenses seamless as it integrates with Uber and many other vendors to offer support across purchases and filing of receipts
reviews.cons: At some places, the software seems to jump off when it comes to stating GST or non GST option - it switches this to none and gives an error. Has happened to me a few times now

reviews.title: Iconic and Full-featured Accounting Program: SAP Concur
reviews.name: Dilak S.
reviews.pros: SAP Concur was straightforward to implement and use. I like that it makes it easy to create and customize invoices automatically.
reviews.cons: The mobile application is not available for download on  App Store but I acquired it from the vendor website.

reviews.title: What I Experience with SAP Concur
reviews.name: Joy I.
reviews.pros: SAP Concur allows me to save time by managing expenses automatically which also eradicates fraud.
reviews.cons: Mobile application on Android system lack some features available on cloud apps.

reviews.cons: SAP Concur can feel clunky and outdated, especially the interface. It’s not always intuitive, so simple tasks take extra clicks. Mobile app can be glitchy at times. Also, setup and customization seem overly complex, and syncing issues occasionally cause delays with expenses or approvals.

reviews.title: 95% of the Way is Still an "A"
reviews.name: Mark M.
reviews.pros: The expense reporting system is very easy to use, and flows nicely. Importing invoices either via app or scans is very simple and easy to use. Concur also allowed us to customize categories of expenses and accounts to put them to. Finally, it has a nice set up for booking travel via all the big outlets (hotel/airfare/rental cars/train). It also has allowed our company to identify preferred providers and push users toward those providers.
reviews.cons: Reporting isn't great. Trying to get customized reporting for accounting purposes is definitely a struggle. Additionally, if you have less than conventional travel (one way train, where you want to change category during the trip (coach for part of the trip/sleeper for second part)) it's not quite flexible enough to handle those situations. Not a huge deal, but can be annoying at times.

reviews.title: This makes expenses easy
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: It’s super straightforward for expense tracking. Making itemizations, especially for hotels, makes it very easy to use. My colleague also had a weird bug where he could t log in and we were able to get on a call with customer support quickly, who resolved the issue. It’s also helpful with showing you the approval process and audit timeline.
reviews.cons: I really don’t have any. It’s a great platform for expenses and has an efficient payment processing path batched in, making it a great option, with high value for the money.

reviews.title: The most versatile program out there
reviews.name: Jeremy H.
reviews.pros: The flexibility to use SAP programs in nearly every aspect of my work life. Being able to manipulate the programs to work with what we need when we need it
reviews.cons: Can be overwhelming over time with how many transactions interact with each other when you are needing to change something

reviews.title: SAP Concur program designers, please go back to drawing board.
reviews.name: David K.
reviews.pros: The sign in process is easy. Other than that, I cannot think of anything there is to like about SAP Concur.
reviews.cons: Cumbersome. Not user friendly. It takes hours to complete a simple report. There are many problems matching up receipts with expenses. Not being able to talk with someone to help solve use problems.

reviews.title: Media Sales using Concur for a long time
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: It's easy to navigate and to add expenses. Attachments are easy to add as a pdf. You can also add separately what the expense was for as it relates to each entry.
reviews.cons: If you don't have the name of the people at a particular business that you are adding the expense to, it's a little complicated to search. If they are there then you just add them.

reviews.title: Concur Works
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: Ease of expense reporting, uploading receipts, approving multiple expense reports and the warning system for errors.
reviews.cons: The online travel booking features are slow, do not provide the same discounts, and have added travel fees.

reviews.title: What’s SAP Concur
reviews.name: Jackline A.
reviews.pros: SAP Concur automates repetitive accounting procedures that help save time and reduce financial errors.
reviews.cons: Apart from lack of some features in mobile application that are available in cloud apps, I do not have any other issue.

reviews.title: Expense Reporting made easy with Concur
reviews.name: Gene B.
reviews.pros: My corporate card expenses get preloaded into an expense report for me and the majority of the time have the correct expense category and details filled out which saves me time.
reviews.cons: Sometimes Concur is fussy when trying to use the mileage calculator. It insists on using the shortest route, not necessarily the route taken given consideration to traffic, accidents, etc.

reviews.title: Good tool for capturing and submitting expenses
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: Great tool for submitting expenses, I like the feature that automatically identifies the value of the receipt as you load it in.
reviews.cons: Can sometimes feel like there are too many steps to capture and submit an expense. It would be good if it automatically loaded the receipts into your existing claim without you having to do it yourself.

reviews.title: SAP Concur Review: Streamlining Expenses with Some Trade-Offs
reviews.name: Faisal M.
reviews.pros: I’ve used SAP Concur for managing travel and expenses, and it has its strengths along with a few drawbacks. Great Value for Money. Strong automation for expense capture and approvals •Reliable payment and reimbursement processing •Solid corporate card integration •Detailed, customizable reporting options •Saves time once workflows are set up
reviews.cons: Interface feels outdated and not always intuitive •Steeper learning curve for new users •Report generation can be time-consuming

reviews.title: Great mobile app
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: Very easy to use with the mobile app that allows you to upload receipts on the go and also check booked travel information.
reviews.cons: It can be cumbersome to work through expense reports with multiple different click throughs and flags to respond to.

reviews.title: Good for Tracking Expenses, but Could Be More User-Friendly
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: I like that SAP Concur keeps a history of all submitted expenses, making it easy to track past reports and reference previous submissions when needed.
reviews.cons: I find the expense process a bit disorganized. When an expense is returned, it’s not easy to see the details or understand the reason. It would also be helpful to have templates for recurring expenses. Adding expenses from outside the country I work in can be challenging, especially when using a credit card, since the final amount charged often differs from what’s entered in the system. A feature that allows you to capture and reconcile the actual credit card charge would make the process much smoother.

reviews.title: Easy interface that helps to organize expenses
reviews.name: Melissa S.
reviews.pros: What I like most about SAP Concur is the iPhone app. The interface is easy to use and allows me to keep ahead of my expense report during a business trip.
reviews.cons: What I like least about Concur is that uploading receipts can be glitchy. Often, photos of receipts do not appear after taken in the app. I always take an additional photo outside of the app as a backup.

reviews.title: Can't keep track? SAP Concur does it for you.
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: What I like most about SAP concur is that it keeps all my expenses in one place and identifies expenses that is tied into my e-mail. I also liked it ensures that I include all the required information for each expense and allows me to create different reports for different expenses.
reviews.cons: I am not a fan of SAP concurs AI tool that automatically pulls information from the receipt and puts it into each category because, in my experience, most of the time the information that the AI pulls from the receipt is not correct.

reviews.title: Good system
reviews.name: Victoria H.
reviews.pros: Easy to use and get reimbursements for company expenses and travel reimbursement as well so I liked it
reviews.cons: Uploading receipts to the system which I felt was outdated because you had to scan your receipts to provide proof

reviews.title: Good expense report tool
reviews.name: Chris T.
reviews.pros: Good mobile app which makes it easy to capture receipts with your phone camera. Concur scans the receipts and fills in the details. You can also forward any email receipts.
reviews.cons: It is my 2nd favorite expense report app behind Expensify. The features are basically the same, but I find Expensify more intuitive to use.

reviews.title: It gets the job done, but the interface is a bit complex to navigate/understand
reviews.name: Dave L.
reviews.pros: What I like most about Concur is it gives me a way to enter in my company expenses, keep track of them, and give me notifications every step along the way of it's review/approval process.
reviews.cons: The user interface is complicated. So much so now I no longer create new expenses from scratch... I copy a previous one because that's theonly way I know how to enter certain expenses.

reviews.title: Expense reporting fast and easy
reviews.name: Tammy W.
reviews.pros: We have used SAP Concur for a couple of years now and it has made our expense reporting fast and easy. The photos on the go for receipts has been invaluable.
reviews.cons: The only thing I don't like about SAP Concur is to have to do a header report summary. This is double work as all the same information can be found in each expense.

reviews.title: SAP Concur - A great expenses management software
reviews.name: Kanika B.
reviews.pros: Concur makes expenses seamless as it integrates with Uber and many other vendors to offer support across purchases and filing of receipts
reviews.cons: At some places, the software seems to jump off when it comes to stating GST or non GST option - it switches this to none and gives an error. Has happened to me a few times now

reviews.title: Iconic and Full-featured Accounting Program: SAP Concur
reviews.name: Dilak S.
reviews.pros: SAP Concur was straightforward to implement and use. I like that it makes it easy to create and customize invoices automatically.
reviews.cons: The mobile application is not available for download on  App Store but I acquired it from the vendor website.

reviews.title: What I Experience with SAP Concur
reviews.name: Joy I.
reviews.pros: SAP Concur allows me to save time by managing expenses automatically which also eradicates fraud.
reviews.cons: Mobile application on Android system lack some features available on cloud apps.

reviews.title: Still a strong performer
reviews.name: Suzanne D.
reviews.pros: Ease of use, simple to follow. This tool helps most payment and HR type functionality to z good standard
reviews.cons: With the use of modern technology it might be looking a little in need of AI visually, would suggest more options to be available

reviews.title: SAP Concur - Worth the time and Money
reviews.name: Patty B.
reviews.pros: Easy to use Can scan/ use from phone, tablet or PC on or off line. Visa statements can be sent and easily uploaded and coded Records the expenses automatically - no manual input required You can have default expense coding which can be easily changed if required Many levels of review and authorization can be set up..
reviews.cons: If an expenses is shared between departments this requires manual changes to the default expenses codes

reviews.title: Great tool for businesses

reviews.pros: The ease of documents submission especially from the phone is amazing. After 5 trips, all i had to do is snap some photos upload, job is done
reviews.cons: User experience sometimes can be really confusing. But once you get used to it it’s actually suited for the job.
