reviews.pros: The expense reporting system is very easy to use, and flows nicely. Importing invoices either via app or scans is very simple and easy to use. Concur also allowed us to customize categories of expenses and accounts to put them to. Finally, it has a nice set up for booking travel via all the big outlets (hotel/airfare/rental cars/train). It also has allowed our company to identify preferred providers and push users toward those providers.
reviews.cons: Reporting isn't great. Trying to get customized reporting for accounting purposes is definitely a struggle. Additionally, if you have less than conventional travel (one way train, where you want to change category during the trip (coach for part of the trip/sleeper for second part)) it's not quite flexible enough to handle those situations. Not a huge deal, but can be annoying at times.

reviews.title: This makes expenses easy
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: It’s super straightforward for expense tracking. Making itemizations, especially for hotels, makes it very easy to use. My colleague also had a weird bug where he could t log in and we were able to get on a call with customer support quickly, who resolved the issue. It’s also helpful with showing you the approval process and audit timeline.
reviews.cons: I really don’t have any. It’s a great platform for expenses and has an efficient payment processing path batched in, making it a great option, with high value for the money.

reviews.title: The most versatile program out there
reviews.name: Jeremy H.
reviews.pros: The flexibility to use SAP programs in nearly every aspect of my work life. Being able to manipulate the programs to work with what we need when we need it
reviews.cons: Can be overwhelming over time with how many transactions interact with each other when you are needing to change something

reviews.title: SAP Concur program designers, please go back to drawing board.
reviews.name: David K.
reviews.pros: The sign in process is easy. Other than that, I cannot think of anything there is to like about SAP Concur.
reviews.cons: Cumbersome. Not user friendly. It takes hours to complete a simple report. There are many problems matching up receipts with expenses. Not being able to talk with someone to help solve use problems.

reviews.title: Media Sales using Concur for a long time
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: It's easy to navigate and to add expenses. Attachments are easy to add as a pdf. You can also add separately what the expense was for as it relates to each entry.
reviews.cons: If you don't have the name of the people at a particular business that you are adding the expense to, it's a little complicated to search. If they are there then you just add them.

reviews.title: Concur Works
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: Ease of expense reporting, uploading receipts, approving multiple expense reports and the warning system for errors.
reviews.cons: The online travel booking features are slow, do not provide the same discounts, and have added travel fees.

reviews.title: What’s SAP Concur
reviews.name: Jackline A.
reviews.pros: SAP Concur automates repetitive accounting procedures that help save time and reduce financial errors.
reviews.cons: Apart from lack of some features in mobile application that are available in cloud apps, I do not have any other issue.

reviews.title: Expense Reporting made easy with Concur
reviews.name: Gene B.
reviews.pros: My corporate card expenses get preloaded into an expense report for me and the majority of the time have the correct expense category and details filled out which saves me time.
reviews.cons: Sometimes Concur is fussy when trying to use the mileage calculator. It insists on using the shortest route, not necessarily the route taken given consideration to traffic, accidents, etc.

reviews.title: Good tool for capturing and submitting expenses
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: Great tool for submitting expenses, I like the feature that automatically identifies the value of the receipt as you load it in.
reviews.cons: Can sometimes feel like there are too many steps to capture and submit an expense. It would be good if it automatically loaded the receipts into your existing claim without you having to do it yourself.

reviews.title: SAP Concur Review: Streamlining Expenses with Some Trade-Offs
reviews.name: Faisal M.
reviews.pros: I’ve used SAP Concur for managing travel and expenses, and it has its strengths along with a few drawbacks. Great Value for Money. Strong automation for expense capture and approvals •Reliable payment and reimbursement processing •Solid corporate card integration •Detailed, customizable reporting options •Saves time once workflows are set up
reviews.cons: Interface feels outdated and not always intuitive •Steeper learning curve for new users •Report generation can be time-consuming

reviews.title: Great mobile app
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: Very easy to use with the mobile app that allows you to upload receipts on the go and also check booked travel information.
reviews.cons: It can be cumbersome to work through expense reports with multiple different click throughs and flags to respond to.

reviews.title: Good for Tracking Expenses, but Could Be More User-Friendly
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: I like that SAP Concur keeps a history of all submitted expenses, making it easy to track past reports and reference previous submissions when needed.
reviews.cons: I find the expense process a bit disorganized. When an expense is returned, it’s not easy to see the details or understand the reason. It would also be helpful to have templates for recurring expenses. Adding expenses from outside the country I work in can be challenging, especially when using a credit card, since the final amount charged often differs from what’s entered in the system. A feature that allows you to capture and reconcile the actual credit card charge would make the process much smoother.

reviews.title: Easy interface that helps to organize expenses
reviews.name: Melissa S.
reviews.pros: What I like most about SAP Concur is the iPhone app. The interface is easy to use and allows me to keep ahead of my expense report during a business trip.
reviews.cons: What I like least about Concur is that uploading receipts can be glitchy. Often, photos of receipts do not appear after taken in the app. I always take an additional photo outside of the app as a backup.

reviews.title: Can't keep track? SAP Concur does it for you.
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: What I like most about SAP concur is that it keeps all my expenses in one place and identifies expenses that is tied into my e-mail. I also liked it ensures that I include all the required information for each expense and allows me to create different reports for different expenses.
reviews.cons: I am not a fan of SAP concurs AI tool that automatically pulls information from the receipt and puts it into each category because, in my experience, most of the time the information that the AI pulls from the receipt is not correct.

reviews.title: Good system
reviews.name: Victoria H.
reviews.pros: Easy to use and get reimbursements for company expenses and travel reimbursement as well so I liked it
reviews.cons: Uploading receipts to the system which I felt was outdated because you had to scan your receipts to provide proof

reviews.title: Good expense report tool
reviews.name: Chris T.
reviews.pros: Good mobile app which makes it easy to capture receipts with your phone camera. Concur scans the receipts and fills in the details. You can also forward any email receipts.
reviews.cons: It is my 2nd favorite expense report app behind Expensify. The features are basically the same, but I find Expensify more intuitive to use.

reviews.title: It gets the job done, but the interface is a bit complex to navigate/understand
reviews.name: Dave L.
reviews.pros: What I like most about Concur is it gives me a way to enter in my company expenses, keep track of them, and give me notifications every step along the way of it's review/approval process.
reviews.cons: The user interface is complicated. So much so now I no longer create new expenses from scratch... I copy a previous one because that's theonly way I know how to enter certain expenses.

reviews.title: Expense reporting fast and easy
reviews.name: Tammy W.
reviews.pros: We have used SAP Concur for a couple of years now and it has made our expense reporting fast and easy. The photos on the go for receipts has been invaluable.
reviews.cons: The only thing I don't like about SAP Concur is to have to do a header report summary. This is double work as all the same information can be found in each expense.

reviews.title: SAP Concur - A great expenses management software
reviews.name: Kanika B.
reviews.pros: Concur makes expenses seamless as it integrates with Uber and many other vendors to offer support across purchases and filing of receipts
reviews.cons: At some places, the software seems to jump off when it comes to stating GST or non GST option - it switches this to none and gives an error. Has happened to me a few times now

reviews.title: Iconic and Full-featured Accounting Program: SAP Concur
reviews.name: Dilak S.
reviews.pros: SAP Concur was straightforward to implement and use. I like that it makes it easy to create and customize invoices automatically.
reviews.cons: The mobile application is not available for download on  App Store but I acquired it from the vendor website.

reviews.title: What I Experience with SAP Concur
reviews.name: Joy I.
reviews.pros: SAP Concur allows me to save time by managing expenses automatically which also eradicates fraud.
reviews.cons: Mobile application on Android system lack some features available on cloud apps.

reviews.title: Still a strong performer
reviews.name: Suzanne D.
reviews.pros: Ease of use, simple to follow. This tool helps most payment and HR type functionality to z good standard
reviews.cons: With the use of modern technology it might be looking a little in need of AI visually, would suggest more options to be available

reviews.title: SAP Concur - Worth the time and Money
reviews.name: Patty B.
reviews.pros: Easy to use Can scan/ use from phone, tablet or PC on or off line. Visa statements can be sent and easily uploaded and coded Records the expenses automatically - no manual input required You can have default expense coding which can be easily changed if required Many levels of review and authorization can be set up..
reviews.cons: If an expenses is shared between departments this requires manual changes to the default expenses codes

reviews.title: Great tool for businesses
reviews.name: Stefan B.
reviews.pros: The ease of documents submission especially from the phone is amazing. After 5 trips, all i had to do is snap some photos upload, job is done
reviews.cons: User experience sometimes can be really confusing. But once you get used to it it’s actually suited for the job.

reviews.title: Convenient but Clunky: A Mixed Experience with SAP Concur
reviews.name: Arti R.
reviews.pros: SAP Concur makes expense tracking way easier—everything’s in one place and you can snap receipts on the go. Approvals are faster, and it cuts down on manual entry. I like how it integrates with travel booking too, so trips and expenses stay organized. Helps keep things compliant without much effort.
reviews.cons: SAP Concur can feel clunky and outdated, especially the interface. It’s not always intuitive, so simple tasks take extra clicks. Mobile app can be glitchy at times. Also, setup and customization seem overly complex, and syncing issues occasionally cause delays with expenses or approvals.

reviews.cons: The mobile application is not available for download on  App Store but I acquired it from the vendor website.

reviews.title: What I Experience with SAP Concur
reviews.name: Joy I.
reviews.pros: SAP Concur allows me to save time by managing expenses automatically which also eradicates fraud.
reviews.cons: Mobile application on Android system lack some features available on cloud apps.

reviews.title: Still a strong performer
reviews.name: Suzanne D.
reviews.pros: Ease of use, simple to follow. This tool helps most payment and HR type functionality to z good standard
reviews.cons: With the use of modern technology it might be looking a little in need of AI visually, would suggest more options to be available

reviews.title: SAP Concur - Worth the time and Money
reviews.name: Patty B.
reviews.pros: Easy to use Can scan/ use from phone, tablet or PC on or off line. Visa statements can be sent and easily uploaded and coded Records the expenses automatically - no manual input required You can have default expense coding which can be easily changed if required Many levels of review and authorization can be set up..
reviews.cons: If an expenses is shared between departments this requires manual changes to the default expenses codes

reviews.title: Great tool for businesses
reviews.name: Stefan B.
reviews.pros: The ease of documents submission especially from the phone is amazing. After 5 trips, all i had to do is snap some photos upload, job is done
reviews.cons: User experience sometimes can be really confusing. But once you get used to it it’s actually suited for the job.

reviews.title: Convenient but Clunky: A Mixed Experience with SAP Concur
reviews.name: Arti R.
reviews.pros: SAP Concur makes expense tracking way easier—everything’s in one place and you can snap receipts on the go. Approvals are faster, and it cuts down on manual entry. I like how it integrates with travel booking too, so trips and expenses stay organized. Helps keep things compliant without much effort.
reviews.cons: SAP Concur can feel clunky and outdated, especially the interface. It’s not always intuitive, so simple tasks take extra clicks. Mobile app can be glitchy at times. Also, setup and customization seem overly complex, and syncing issues occasionally cause delays with expenses or approvals.

reviews.title: 95% of the Way is Still an "A"
reviews.name: Mark M.
reviews.pros: The expense reporting system is very easy to use, and flows nicely. Importing invoices either via app or scans is very simple and easy to use. Concur also allowed us to customize categories of expenses and accounts to put them to. Finally, it has a nice set up for booking travel via all the big outlets (hotel/airfare/rental cars/train). It also has allowed our company to identify preferred providers and push users toward those providers.
reviews.cons: Reporting isn't great. Trying to get customized reporting for accounting purposes is definitely a struggle. Additionally, if you have less than conventional travel (one way train, where you want to change category during the trip (coach for part of the trip/sleeper for second part)) it's not quite flexible enough to handle those situations. Not a huge deal, but can be annoying at times.

reviews.title: This makes expenses easy
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: It’s super straightforward for expense tracking. Making itemizations, especially for hotels, makes it very easy to use. My colleague also had a weird bug where he could t log in and we were able to get on a call with customer support quickly, who resolved the issue. It’s also helpful with showing you the approval process and audit timeline.
reviews.cons: I really don’t have any. It’s a great platform for expenses and has an efficient payment processing path batched in, making it a great option, with high value for the money.

reviews.title: The most versatile program out there
reviews.name: Jeremy H.
reviews.pros: The flexibility to use SAP programs in nearly every aspect of my work life. Being able to manipulate the programs to work with what we need when we need it
reviews.cons: Can be overwhelming over time with how many transactions interact with each other when you are needing to change something

reviews.title: SAP Concur program designers, please go back to drawing board.
reviews.name: David K.
reviews.pros: The sign in process is easy. Other than that, I cannot think of anything there is to like about SAP Concur.
reviews.cons: Cumbersome. Not user friendly. It takes hours to complete a simple report. There are many problems matching up receipts with expenses. Not being able to talk with someone to help solve use problems.

reviews.title: Media Sales using Concur for a long time
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: It's easy to navigate and to add expenses. Attachments are easy to add as a pdf. You can also add separately what the expense was for as it relates to each entry.
reviews.cons: If you don't have the name of the people at a particular business that you are adding the expense to, it's a little complicated to search. If they are there then you just add them.

reviews.title: Concur Works
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: Ease of expense reporting, uploading receipts, approving multiple expense reports and the warning system for errors.
reviews.cons: The online travel booking features are slow, do not provide the same discounts, and have added travel fees.

reviews.title: What’s SAP Concur
reviews.name: Jackline A.
reviews.pros: SAP Concur automates repetitive accounting procedures that help save time and reduce financial errors.
reviews.cons: Apart from lack of some features in mobile application that are available in cloud apps, I do not have any other issue.

reviews.title: Expense Reporting made easy with Concur
reviews.name: Gene B.
reviews.pros: My corporate card expenses get preloaded into an expense report for me and the majority of the time have the correct expense category and details filled out which saves me time.
reviews.cons: Sometimes Concur is fussy when trying to use the mileage calculator. It insists on using the shortest route, not necessarily the route taken given consideration to traffic, accidents, etc.

reviews.title: Good tool for capturing and submitting expenses
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: Great tool for submitting expenses, I like the feature that automatically identifies the value of the receipt as you load it in.
reviews.cons: Can sometimes feel like there are too many steps to capture and submit an expense. It would be good if it automatically loaded the receipts into your existing claim without you having to do it yourself.

reviews.title: SAP Concur Review: Streamlining Expenses with Some Trade-Offs
reviews.name: Faisal M.
reviews.pros: I’ve used SAP Concur for managing travel and expenses, and it has its strengths along with a few drawbacks. Great Value for Money. Strong automation for expense capture and approvals •Reliable payment and reimbursement processing •Solid corporate card integration •Detailed, customizable reporting options •Saves time once workflows are set up
reviews.cons: Interface feels outdated and not always intuitive •Steeper learning curve for new users •Report generation can be time-consuming

reviews.title: Great mobile app
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: Very easy to use with the mobile app that allows you to upload receipts on the go and also check booked travel information.
reviews.cons: It can be cumbersome to work through expense reports with multiple different click throughs and flags to respond to.

reviews.title: Good for Tracking Expenses, but Could Be More User-Friendly
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: I like that SAP Concur keeps a history of all submitted expenses, making it easy to track past reports and reference previous submissions when needed.
reviews.cons: I find the expense process a bit disorganized. When an expense is returned, it’s not easy to see the details or understand the reason. It would also be helpful to have templates for recurring expenses. Adding expenses from outside the country I work in can be challenging, especially when using a credit card, since the final amount charged often differs from what’s entered in the system. A feature that allows you to capture and reconcile the actual credit card charge would make the process much smoother.

reviews.title: Easy interface that helps to organize expenses
reviews.name: Melissa S.
reviews.pros: What I like most about SAP Concur is the iPhone app. The interface is easy to use and allows me to keep ahead of my expense report during a business trip.
reviews.cons: What I like least about Concur is that uploading receipts can be glitchy. Often, photos of receipts do not appear after taken in the app. I always take an additional photo outside of the app as a backup.

reviews.title: Can't keep track? SAP Concur does it for you.
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: What I like most about SAP concur is that it keeps all my expenses in one place and identifies expenses that is tied into my e-mail. I also liked it ensures that I include all the required information for each expense and allows me to create different reports for different expenses.
reviews.cons: I am not a fan of SAP concurs AI tool that automatically pulls information from the receipt and puts it into each category because, in my experience, most of the time the information that the AI pulls from the receipt is not correct.

reviews.title: Good system
reviews.name: Victoria H.
reviews.pros: Easy to use and get reimbursements for company expenses and travel reimbursement as well so I liked it
reviews.cons: Uploading receipts to the system which I felt was outdated because you had to scan your receipts to provide proof

reviews.title: Good expense report tool
reviews.name: Chris T.
reviews.pros: Good mobile app which makes it easy to capture receipts with your phone camera. Concur scans the receipts and fills in the details. You can also forward any email receipts.
reviews.cons: It is my 2nd favorite expense report app behind Expensify. The features are basically the same, but I find Expensify more intuitive to use.

reviews.title: It gets the job done, but the interface is a bit complex to navigate/understand
reviews.name: Dave L.
reviews.pros: What I like most about Concur is it gives me a way to enter in my company expenses, keep track of them, and give me notifications every step along the way of it's review/approval process.
reviews.cons: The user interface is complicated. So much so now I no longer create new expenses from scratch... I copy a previous one because that's theonly way I know how to enter certain expenses.

reviews.title: Expense reporting fast and easy
reviews.name: Tammy W.
reviews.pros: We have used SAP Concur for a couple of years now and it has made our expense reporting fast and easy. The photos on the go for receipts has been invaluable.
reviews.cons: The only thing I don't like about SAP Concur is to have to do a header report summary. This is double work as all the same information can be found in each expense.

reviews.title: SAP Concur - A great expenses management software
reviews.name: Kanika B.
reviews.pros: Concur makes expenses seamless as it integrates with Uber and many other vendors to offer support across purchases and filing of receipts
reviews.cons: At some places, the software seems to jump off when it comes to stating GST or non GST option - it switches this to none and gives an error. Has happened to me a few times now

reviews.cons: I am not a fan of SAP concurs AI tool that automatically pulls information from the receipt and puts it into each category because, in my experience, most of the time the information that the AI pulls from the receipt is not correct.

reviews.title: Good system
reviews.name: Victoria H.
reviews.pros: Easy to use and get reimbursements for company expenses and travel reimbursement as well so I liked it
reviews.cons: Uploading receipts to the system which I felt was outdated because you had to scan your receipts to provide proof

reviews.title: Good expense report tool
reviews.name: Chris T.
reviews.pros: Good mobile app which makes it easy to capture receipts with your phone camera. Concur scans the receipts and fills in the details. You can also forward any email receipts.
reviews.cons: It is my 2nd favorite expense report app behind Expensify. The features are basically the same, but I find Expensify more intuitive to use.

reviews.title: It gets the job done, but the interface is a bit complex to navigate/understand
reviews.name: Dave L.
reviews.pros: What I like most about Concur is it gives me a way to enter in my company expenses, keep track of them, and give me notifications every step along the way of it's review/approval process.
reviews.cons: The user interface is complicated. So much so now I no longer create new expenses from scratch... I copy a previous one because that's theonly way I know how to enter certain expenses.

reviews.title: Expense reporting fast and easy
reviews.name: Tammy W.
reviews.pros: We have used SAP Concur for a couple of years now and it has made our expense reporting fast and easy. The photos on the go for receipts has been invaluable.
reviews.cons: The only thing I don't like about SAP Concur is to have to do a header report summary. This is double work as all the same information can be found in each expense.

reviews.title: SAP Concur - A great expenses management software
reviews.name: Kanika B.
reviews.pros: Concur makes expenses seamless as it integrates with Uber and many other vendors to offer support across purchases and filing of receipts
reviews.cons: At some places, the software seems to jump off when it comes to stating GST or non GST option - it switches this to none and gives an error. Has happened to me a few times now

reviews.title: Iconic and Full-featured Accounting Program: SAP Concur
reviews.name: Dilak S.
reviews.pros: SAP Concur was straightforward to implement and use. I like that it makes it easy to create and customize invoices automatically.
reviews.cons: The mobile application is not available for download on  App Store but I acquired it from the vendor website.

reviews.title: What I Experience with SAP Concur
reviews.name: Joy I.
reviews.pros: SAP Concur allows me to save time by managing expenses automatically which also eradicates fraud.
reviews.cons: Mobile application on Android system lack some features available on cloud apps.

reviews.title: Still a strong performer
reviews.name: Suzanne D.
reviews.pros: Ease of use, simple to follow. This tool helps most payment and HR type functionality to z good standard
reviews.cons: With the use of modern technology it might be looking a little in need of AI visually, would suggest more options to be available

reviews.title: SAP Concur - Worth the time and Money
reviews.name: Patty B.
reviews.pros: Easy to use Can scan/ use from phone, tablet or PC on or off line. Visa statements can be sent and easily uploaded and coded Records the expenses automatically - no manual input required You can have default expense coding which can be easily changed if required Many levels of review and authorization can be set up..
reviews.cons: If an expenses is shared between departments this requires manual changes to the default expenses codes

reviews.title: Great tool for businesses
reviews.name: Stefan B.
reviews.pros: The ease of documents submission especially from the phone is amazing. After 5 trips, all i had to do is snap some photos upload, job is done
reviews.cons: User experience sometimes can be really confusing. But once you get used to it it’s actually suited for the job.

reviews.title: Convenient but Clunky: A Mixed Experience with SAP Concur
reviews.name: Arti R.
reviews.pros: SAP Concur makes expense tracking way easier—everything’s in one place and you can snap receipts on the go. Approvals are faster, and it cuts down on manual entry. I like how it integrates with travel booking too, so trips and expenses stay organized. Helps keep things compliant without much effort.
reviews.cons: SAP Concur can feel clunky and outdated, especially the interface. It’s not always intuitive, so simple tasks take extra clicks. Mobile app can be glitchy at times. Also, setup and customization seem overly complex, and syncing issues occasionally cause delays with expenses or approvals.

reviews.title: 95% of the Way is Still an "A"
reviews.name: Mark M.
reviews.pros: The expense reporting system is very easy to use, and flows nicely. Importing invoices either via app or scans is very simple and easy to use. Concur also allowed us to customize categories of expenses and accounts to put them to. Finally, it has a nice set up for booking travel via all the big outlets (hotel/airfare/rental cars/train). It also has allowed our company to identify preferred providers and push users toward those providers.
reviews.cons: Reporting isn't great. Trying to get customized reporting for accounting purposes is definitely a struggle. Additionally, if you have less than conventional travel (one way train, where you want to change category during the trip (coach for part of the trip/sleeper for second part)) it's not quite flexible enough to handle those situations. Not a huge deal, but can be annoying at times.

reviews.title: This makes expenses easy
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: It’s super straightforward for expense tracking. Making itemizations, especially for hotels, makes it very easy to use. My colleague also had a weird bug where he could t log in and we were able to get on a call with customer support quickly, who resolved the issue. It’s also helpful with showing you the approval process and audit timeline.
reviews.cons: I really don’t have any. It’s a great platform for expenses and has an efficient payment processing path batched in, making it a great option, with high value for the money.

reviews.title: The most versatile program out there
reviews.name: Jeremy H.
reviews.pros: The flexibility to use SAP programs in nearly every aspect of my work life. Being able to manipulate the programs to work with what we need when we need it
reviews.cons: Can be overwhelming over time with how many transactions interact with each other when you are needing to change something

reviews.title: SAP Concur program designers, please go back to drawing board.
reviews.name: David K.
reviews.pros: The sign in process is easy. Other than that, I cannot think of anything there is to like about SAP Concur.
reviews.cons: Cumbersome. Not user friendly. It takes hours to complete a simple report. There are many problems matching up receipts with expenses. Not being able to talk with someone to help solve use problems.

reviews.title: Media Sales using Concur for a long time
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: It's easy to navigate and to add expenses. Attachments are easy to add as a pdf. You can also add separately what the expense was for as it relates to each entry.
reviews.cons: If you don't have the name of the people at a particular business that you are adding the expense to, it's a little complicated to search. If they are there then you just add them.

reviews.title: Concur Works
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: Ease of expense reporting, uploading receipts, approving multiple expense reports and the warning system for errors.
reviews.cons: The online travel booking features are slow, do not provide the same discounts, and have added travel fees.

reviews.title: What’s SAP Concur
reviews.name: Jackline A.
reviews.pros: SAP Concur automates repetitive accounting procedures that help save time and reduce financial errors.
reviews.cons: Apart from lack of some features in mobile application that are available in cloud apps, I do not have any other issue.

reviews.title: Expense Reporting made easy with Concur
reviews.name: Gene B.
reviews.pros: My corporate card expenses get preloaded into an expense report for me and the majority of the time have the correct expense category and details filled out which saves me time.
reviews.cons: Sometimes Concur is fussy when trying to use the mileage calculator. It insists on using the shortest route, not necessarily the route taken given consideration to traffic, accidents, etc.

reviews.title: Good tool for capturing and submitting expenses
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: Great tool for submitting expenses, I like the feature that automatically identifies the value of the receipt as you load it in.
reviews.cons: Can sometimes feel like there are too many steps to capture and submit an expense. It would be good if it automatically loaded the receipts into your existing claim without you having to do it yourself.

reviews.title: SAP Concur Review: Streamlining Expenses with Some Trade-Offs
reviews.name: Faisal M.
reviews.pros: I’ve used SAP Concur for managing travel and expenses, and it has its strengths along with a few drawbacks. Great Value for Money. Strong automation for expense capture and approvals •Reliable payment and reimbursement processing •Solid corporate card integration •Detailed, customizable reporting options •Saves time once workflows are set up
reviews.cons: Interface feels outdated and not always intuitive •Steeper learning curve for new users •Report generation can be time-consuming

reviews.title: Great mobile app
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: Very easy to use with the mobile app that allows you to upload receipts on the go and also check booked travel information.
reviews.cons: It can be cumbersome to work through expense reports with multiple different click throughs and flags to respond to.

reviews.title: Good for Tracking Expenses, but Could Be More User-Friendly
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: I like that SAP Concur keeps a history of all submitted expenses, making it easy to track past reports and reference previous submissions when needed.
reviews.cons: I find the expense process a bit disorganized. When an expense is returned, it’s not easy to see the details or understand the reason. It would also be helpful to have templates for recurring expenses. Adding expenses from outside the country I work in can be challenging, especially when using a credit card, since the final amount charged often differs from what’s entered in the system. A feature that allows you to capture and reconcile the actual credit card charge would make the process much smoother.

reviews.title: SAP Concur Review: Streamlining Expenses with Some Trade-Offs
reviews.name: Faisal M.
reviews.pros: I’ve used SAP Concur for managing travel and expenses, and it has its strengths along with a few drawbacks. Great Value for Money. Strong automation for expense capture and approvals •Reliable payment and reimbursement processing •Solid corporate card integration •Detailed, customizable reporting options •Saves time once workflows are set up
reviews.cons: Interface feels outdated and not always intuitive •Steeper learning curve for new users •Report generation can be time-consuming

reviews.title: Great mobile app
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: Very easy to use with the mobile app that allows you to upload receipts on the go and also check booked travel information.
reviews.cons: It can be cumbersome to work through expense reports with multiple different click throughs and flags to respond to.

reviews.title: Good for Tracking Expenses, but Could Be More User-Friendly
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: I like that SAP Concur keeps a history of all submitted expenses, making it easy to track past reports and reference previous submissions when needed.
reviews.cons: I find the expense process a bit disorganized. When an expense is returned, it’s not easy to see the details or understand the reason. It would also be helpful to have templates for recurring expenses. Adding expenses from outside the country I work in can be challenging, especially when using a credit card, since the final amount charged often differs from what’s entered in the system. A feature that allows you to capture and reconcile the actual credit card charge would make the process much smoother.

reviews.title: Easy interface that helps to organize expenses
reviews.name: Melissa S.
reviews.pros: What I like most about SAP Concur is the iPhone app. The interface is easy to use and allows me to keep ahead of my expense report during a business trip.
reviews.cons: What I like least about Concur is that uploading receipts can be glitchy. Often, photos of receipts do not appear after taken in the app. I always take an additional photo outside of the app as a backup.

reviews.title: Can't keep track? SAP Concur does it for you.
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: What I like most about SAP concur is that it keeps all my expenses in one place and identifies expenses that is tied into my e-mail. I also liked it ensures that I include all the required information for each expense and allows me to create different reports for different expenses.
reviews.cons: I am not a fan of SAP concurs AI tool that automatically pulls information from the receipt and puts it into each category because, in my experience, most of the time the information that the AI pulls from the receipt is not correct.

reviews.title: Good system
reviews.name: Victoria H.
reviews.pros: Easy to use and get reimbursements for company expenses and travel reimbursement as well so I liked it
reviews.cons: Uploading receipts to the system which I felt was outdated because you had to scan your receipts to provide proof

reviews.title: Good expense report tool
reviews.name: Chris T.
reviews.pros: Good mobile app which makes it easy to capture receipts with your phone camera. Concur scans the receipts and fills in the details. You can also forward any email receipts.
reviews.cons: It is my 2nd favorite expense report app behind Expensify. The features are basically the same, but I find Expensify more intuitive to use.

reviews.title: It gets the job done, but the interface is a bit complex to navigate/understand
reviews.name: Dave L.
reviews.pros: What I like most about Concur is it gives me a way to enter in my company expenses, keep track of them, and give me notifications every step along the way of it's review/approval process.
reviews.cons: The user interface is complicated. So much so now I no longer create new expenses from scratch... I copy a previous one because that's theonly way I know how to enter certain expenses.

reviews.title: Expense reporting fast and easy
reviews.name: Tammy W.
reviews.pros: We have used SAP Concur for a couple of years now and it has made our expense reporting fast and easy. The photos on the go for receipts has been invaluable.
reviews.cons: The only thing I don't like about SAP Concur is to have to do a header report summary. This is double work as all the same information can be found in each expense.

reviews.title: SAP Concur - A great expenses management software
reviews.name: Kanika B.
reviews.pros: Concur makes expenses seamless as it integrates with Uber and many other vendors to offer support across purchases and filing of receipts
reviews.cons: At some places, the software seems to jump off when it comes to stating GST or non GST option - it switches this to none and gives an error. Has happened to me a few times now

reviews.title: Iconic and Full-featured Accounting Program: SAP Concur
reviews.name: Dilak S.
reviews.pros: SAP Concur was straightforward to implement and use. I like that it makes it easy to create and customize invoices automatically.
reviews.cons: The mobile application is not available for download on  App Store but I acquired it from the vendor website.

reviews.title: What I Experience with SAP Concur
reviews.name: Joy I.
reviews.pros: SAP Concur allows me to save time by managing expenses automatically which also eradicates fraud.
reviews.cons: Mobile application on Android system lack some features available on cloud apps.

reviews.title: Still a strong performer
reviews.name: Suzanne D.
reviews.pros: Ease of use, simple to follow. This tool helps most payment and HR type functionality to z good standard
reviews.cons: With the use of modern technology it might be looking a little in need of AI visually, would suggest more options to be available

reviews.title: SAP Concur - Worth the time and Money
reviews.name: Patty B.
reviews.pros: Easy to use Can scan/ use from phone, tablet or PC on or off line. Visa statements can be sent and easily uploaded and coded Records the expenses automatically - no manual input required You can have default expense coding which can be easily changed if required Many levels of review and authorization can be set up..
reviews.cons: If an expenses is shared between departments this requires manual changes to the default expenses codes

reviews.title: Great tool for businesses
reviews.name: Stefan B.
reviews.pros: The ease of documents submission especially from the phone is amazing. After 5 trips, all i had to do is snap some photos upload, job is done
reviews.cons: User experience sometimes can be really confusing. But once you get used to it it’s actually suited for the job.

reviews.title: Convenient but Clunky: A Mixed Experience with SAP Concur
reviews.name: Arti R.
reviews.pros: SAP Concur makes expense tracking way easier—everything’s in one place and you can snap receipts on the go. Approvals are faster, and it cuts down on manual entry. I like how it integrates with travel booking too, so trips and expenses stay organized. Helps keep things compliant without much effort.
reviews.cons: SAP Concur can feel clunky and outdated, especially the interface. It’s not always intuitive, so simple tasks take extra clicks. Mobile app can be glitchy at times. Also, setup and customization seem overly complex, and syncing issues occasionally cause delays with expenses or approvals.

reviews.title: 95% of the Way is Still an "A"
reviews.name: Mark M.
reviews.pros: The expense reporting system is very easy to use, and flows nicely. Importing invoices either via app or scans is very simple and easy to use. Concur also allowed us to customize categories of expenses and accounts to put them to. Finally, it has a nice set up for booking travel via all the big outlets (hotel/airfare/rental cars/train). It also has allowed our company to identify preferred providers and push users toward those providers.
reviews.cons: Reporting isn't great. Trying to get customized reporting for accounting purposes is definitely a struggle. Additionally, if you have less than conventional travel (one way train, where you want to change category during the trip (coach for part of the trip/sleeper for second part)) it's not quite flexible enough to handle those situations. Not a huge deal, but can be annoying at times.

reviews.title: This makes expenses easy
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: It’s super straightforward for expense tracking. Making itemizations, especially for hotels, makes it very easy to use. My colleague also had a weird bug where he could t log in and we were able to get on a call with customer support quickly, who resolved the issue. It’s also helpful with showing you the approval process and audit timeline.
reviews.cons: I really don’t have any. It’s a great platform for expenses and has an efficient payment processing path batched in, making it a great option, with high value for the money.

reviews.title: The most versatile program out there
reviews.name: Jeremy H.
reviews.pros: The flexibility to use SAP programs in nearly every aspect of my work life. Being able to manipulate the programs to work with what we need when we need it
reviews.cons: Can be overwhelming over time with how many transactions interact with each other when you are needing to change something

reviews.title: SAP Concur program designers, please go back to drawing board.
reviews.name: David K.
reviews.pros: The sign in process is easy. Other than that, I cannot think of anything there is to like about SAP Concur.
reviews.cons: Cumbersome. Not user friendly. It takes hours to complete a simple report. There are many problems matching up receipts with expenses. Not being able to talk with someone to help solve use problems.

reviews.title: Media Sales using Concur for a long time
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: It's easy to navigate and to add expenses. Attachments are easy to add as a pdf. You can also add separately what the expense was for as it relates to each entry.
reviews.cons: If you don't have the name of the people at a particular business that you are adding the expense to, it's a little complicated to search. If they are there then you just add them.

reviews.title: Concur Works
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: Ease of expense reporting, uploading receipts, approving multiple expense reports and the warning system for errors.
reviews.cons: The online travel booking features are slow, do not provide the same discounts, and have added travel fees.

reviews.title: What’s SAP Concur
reviews.name: Jackline A.
reviews.pros: SAP Concur automates repetitive accounting procedures that help save time and reduce financial errors.
reviews.cons: Apart from lack of some features in mobile application that are available in cloud apps, I do not have any other issue.

reviews.title: Expense Reporting made easy with Concur
reviews.name: Gene B.
reviews.pros: My corporate card expenses get preloaded into an expense report for me and the majority of the time have the correct expense category and details filled out which saves me time.
reviews.cons: Sometimes Concur is fussy when trying to use the mileage calculator. It insists on using the shortest route, not necessarily the route taken given consideration to traffic, accidents, etc.

reviews.pros: The flexibility to use SAP programs in nearly every aspect of my work life. Being able to manipulate the programs to work with what we need when we need it
reviews.cons: Can be overwhelming over time with how many transactions interact with each other when you are needing to change something

reviews.title: SAP Concur program designers, please go back to drawing board.
reviews.name: David K.
reviews.pros: The sign in process is easy. Other than that, I cannot think of anything there is to like about SAP Concur.
reviews.cons: Cumbersome. Not user friendly. It takes hours to complete a simple report. There are many problems matching up receipts with expenses. Not being able to talk with someone to help solve use problems.

reviews.title: Media Sales using Concur for a long time
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: It's easy to navigate and to add expenses. Attachments are easy to add as a pdf. You can also add separately what the expense was for as it relates to each entry.
reviews.cons: If you don't have the name of the people at a particular business that you are adding the expense to, it's a little complicated to search. If they are there then you just add them.

reviews.title: Concur Works
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: Ease of expense reporting, uploading receipts, approving multiple expense reports and the warning system for errors.
reviews.cons: The online travel booking features are slow, do not provide the same discounts, and have added travel fees.

reviews.title: What’s SAP Concur
reviews.name: Jackline A.
reviews.pros: SAP Concur automates repetitive accounting procedures that help save time and reduce financial errors.
reviews.cons: Apart from lack of some features in mobile application that are available in cloud apps, I do not have any other issue.

reviews.title: Expense Reporting made easy with Concur
reviews.name: Gene B.
reviews.pros: My corporate card expenses get preloaded into an expense report for me and the majority of the time have the correct expense category and details filled out which saves me time.
reviews.cons: Sometimes Concur is fussy when trying to use the mileage calculator. It insists on using the shortest route, not necessarily the route taken given consideration to traffic, accidents, etc.

reviews.title: Good tool for capturing and submitting expenses
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: Great tool for submitting expenses, I like the feature that automatically identifies the value of the receipt as you load it in.
reviews.cons: Can sometimes feel like there are too many steps to capture and submit an expense. It would be good if it automatically loaded the receipts into your existing claim without you having to do it yourself.

reviews.title: SAP Concur Review: Streamlining Expenses with Some Trade-Offs
reviews.name: Faisal M.
reviews.pros: I’ve used SAP Concur for managing travel and expenses, and it has its strengths along with a few drawbacks. Great Value for Money. Strong automation for expense capture and approvals •Reliable payment and reimbursement processing •Solid corporate card integration •Detailed, customizable reporting options •Saves time once workflows are set up
reviews.cons: Interface feels outdated and not always intuitive •Steeper learning curve for new users •Report generation can be time-consuming

reviews.title: Great mobile app
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: Very easy to use with the mobile app that allows you to upload receipts on the go and also check booked travel information.
reviews.cons: It can be cumbersome to work through expense reports with multiple different click throughs and flags to respond to.

reviews.title: Good for Tracking Expenses, but Could Be More User-Friendly
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: I like that SAP Concur keeps a history of all submitted expenses, making it easy to track past reports and reference previous submissions when needed.
reviews.cons: I find the expense process a bit disorganized. When an expense is returned, it’s not easy to see the details or understand the reason. It would also be helpful to have templates for recurring expenses. Adding expenses from outside the country I work in can be challenging, especially when using a credit card, since the final amount charged often differs from what’s entered in the system. A feature that allows you to capture and reconcile the actual credit card charge would make the process much smoother.

reviews.title: Easy interface that helps to organize expenses
reviews.name: Melissa S.
reviews.pros: What I like most about SAP Concur is the iPhone app. The interface is easy to use and allows me to keep ahead of my expense report during a business trip.
reviews.cons: What I like least about Concur is that uploading receipts can be glitchy. Often, photos of receipts do not appear after taken in the app. I always take an additional photo outside of the app as a backup.

reviews.title: Can't keep track? SAP Concur does it for you.
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: What I like most about SAP concur is that it keeps all my expenses in one place and identifies expenses that is tied into my e-mail. I also liked it ensures that I include all the required information for each expense and allows me to create different reports for different expenses.
reviews.cons: I am not a fan of SAP concurs AI tool that automatically pulls information from the receipt and puts it into each category because, in my experience, most of the time the information that the AI pulls from the receipt is not correct.

reviews.title: Good system
reviews.name: Victoria H.
reviews.pros: Easy to use and get reimbursements for company expenses and travel reimbursement as well so I liked it
reviews.cons: Uploading receipts to the system which I felt was outdated because you had to scan your receipts to provide proof

reviews.title: Good expense report tool
reviews.name: Chris T.
reviews.pros: Good mobile app which makes it easy to capture receipts with your phone camera. Concur scans the receipts and fills in the details. You can also forward any email receipts.
reviews.cons: It is my 2nd favorite expense report app behind Expensify. The features are basically the same, but I find Expensify more intuitive to use.

reviews.title: It gets the job done, but the interface is a bit complex to navigate/understand
reviews.name: Dave L.
reviews.pros: What I like most about Concur is it gives me a way to enter in my company expenses, keep track of them, and give me notifications every step along the way of it's review/approval process.
reviews.cons: The user interface is complicated. So much so now I no longer create new expenses from scratch... I copy a previous one because that's theonly way I know how to enter certain expenses.

reviews.title: Expense reporting fast and easy
reviews.name: Tammy W.
reviews.pros: We have used SAP Concur for a couple of years now and it has made our expense reporting fast and easy. The photos on the go for receipts has been invaluable.
reviews.cons: The only thing I don't like about SAP Concur is to have to do a header report summary. This is double work as all the same information can be found in each expense.

reviews.title: SAP Concur - A great expenses management software
reviews.name: Kanika B.
reviews.pros: Concur makes expenses seamless as it integrates with Uber and many other vendors to offer support across purchases and filing of receipts
reviews.cons: At some places, the software seems to jump off when it comes to stating GST or non GST option - it switches this to none and gives an error. Has happened to me a few times now

reviews.title: Iconic and Full-featured Accounting Program: SAP Concur
reviews.name: Dilak S.
reviews.pros: SAP Concur was straightforward to implement and use. I like that it makes it easy to create and customize invoices automatically.
reviews.cons: The mobile application is not available for download on  App Store but I acquired it from the vendor website.

reviews.title: What I Experience with SAP Concur
reviews.name: Joy I.
reviews.pros: SAP Concur allows me to save time by managing expenses automatically which also eradicates fraud.
reviews.cons: Mobile application on Android system lack some features available on cloud apps.

reviews.title: Still a strong performer
reviews.name: Suzanne D.
reviews.pros: Ease of use, simple to follow. This tool helps most payment and HR type functionality to z good standard
reviews.cons: With the use of modern technology it might be looking a little in need of AI visually, would suggest more options to be available

reviews.title: SAP Concur - Worth the time and Money
reviews.name: Patty B.
reviews.pros: Easy to use Can scan/ use from phone, tablet or PC on or off line. Visa statements can be sent and easily uploaded and coded Records the expenses automatically - no manual input required You can have default expense coding which can be easily changed if required Many levels of review and authorization can be set up..
reviews.cons: If an expenses is shared between departments this requires manual changes to the default expenses codes

reviews.title: Great tool for businesses
reviews.name: Stefan B.
reviews.pros: The ease of documents submission especially from the phone is amazing. After 5 trips, all i had to do is snap some photos upload, job is done
reviews.cons: User experience sometimes can be really confusing. But once you get used to it it’s actually suited for the job.

reviews.title: Convenient but Clunky: A Mixed Experience with SAP Concur
reviews.name: Arti R.
reviews.pros: SAP Concur makes expense tracking way easier—everything’s in one place and you can snap receipts on the go. Approvals are faster, and it cuts down on manual entry. I like how it integrates with travel booking too, so trips and expenses stay organized. Helps keep things compliant without much effort.
reviews.cons: SAP Concur can feel clunky and outdated, especially the interface. It’s not always intuitive, so simple tasks take extra clicks. Mobile app can be glitchy at times. Also, setup and customization seem overly complex, and syncing issues occasionally cause delays with expenses or approvals.

reviews.title: 95% of the Way is Still an "A"
reviews.name: Mark M.
reviews.pros: The expense reporting system is very easy to use, and flows nicely. Importing invoices either via app or scans is very simple and easy to use. Concur also allowed us to customize categories of expenses and accounts to put them to. Finally, it has a nice set up for booking travel via all the big outlets (hotel/airfare/rental cars/train). It also has allowed our company to identify preferred providers and push users toward those providers.
reviews.cons: Reporting isn't great. Trying to get customized reporting for accounting purposes is definitely a struggle. Additionally, if you have less than conventional travel (one way train, where you want to change category during the trip (coach for part of the trip/sleeper for second part)) it's not quite flexible enough to handle those situations. Not a huge deal, but can be annoying at times.

reviews.title: This makes expenses easy
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: It’s super straightforward for expense tracking. Making itemizations, especially for hotels, makes it very easy to use. My colleague also had a weird bug where he could t log in and we were able to get on a call with customer support quickly, who resolved the issue. It’s also helpful with showing you the approval process and audit timeline.
reviews.cons: I really don’t have any. It’s a great platform for expenses and has an efficient payment processing path batched in, making it a great option, with high value for the money.

reviews.cons: User experience sometimes can be really confusing. But once you get used to it it’s actually suited for the job.

reviews.title: Convenient but Clunky: A Mixed Experience with SAP Concur
reviews.name: Arti R.
reviews.pros: SAP Concur makes expense tracking way easier—everything’s in one place and you can snap receipts on the go. Approvals are faster, and it cuts down on manual entry. I like how it integrates with travel booking too, so trips and expenses stay organized. Helps keep things compliant without much effort.
reviews.cons: SAP Concur can feel clunky and outdated, especially the interface. It’s not always intuitive, so simple tasks take extra clicks. Mobile app can be glitchy at times. Also, setup and customization seem overly complex, and syncing issues occasionally cause delays with expenses or approvals.

reviews.title: 95% of the Way is Still an "A"
reviews.name: Mark M.
reviews.pros: The expense reporting system is very easy to use, and flows nicely. Importing invoices either via app or scans is very simple and easy to use. Concur also allowed us to customize categories of expenses and accounts to put them to. Finally, it has a nice set up for booking travel via all the big outlets (hotel/airfare/rental cars/train). It also has allowed our company to identify preferred providers and push users toward those providers.
reviews.cons: Reporting isn't great. Trying to get customized reporting for accounting purposes is definitely a struggle. Additionally, if you have less than conventional travel (one way train, where you want to change category during the trip (coach for part of the trip/sleeper for second part)) it's not quite flexible enough to handle those situations. Not a huge deal, but can be annoying at times.

reviews.title: This makes expenses easy
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: It’s super straightforward for expense tracking. Making itemizations, especially for hotels, makes it very easy to use. My colleague also had a weird bug where he could t log in and we were able to get on a call with customer support quickly, who resolved the issue. It’s also helpful with showing you the approval process and audit timeline.
reviews.cons: I really don’t have any. It’s a great platform for expenses and has an efficient payment processing path batched in, making it a great option, with high value for the money.

reviews.title: The most versatile program out there
reviews.name: Jeremy H.
reviews.pros: The flexibility to use SAP programs in nearly every aspect of my work life. Being able to manipulate the programs to work with what we need when we need it
reviews.cons: Can be overwhelming over time with how many transactions interact with each other when you are needing to change something

reviews.title: SAP Concur program designers, please go back to drawing board.
reviews.name: David K.
reviews.pros: The sign in process is easy. Other than that, I cannot think of anything there is to like about SAP Concur.
reviews.cons: Cumbersome. Not user friendly. It takes hours to complete a simple report. There are many problems matching up receipts with expenses. Not being able to talk with someone to help solve use problems.

reviews.title: Media Sales using Concur for a long time
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: It's easy to navigate and to add expenses. Attachments are easy to add as a pdf. You can also add separately what the expense was for as it relates to each entry.
reviews.cons: If you don't have the name of the people at a particular business that you are adding the expense to, it's a little complicated to search. If they are there then you just add them.

reviews.title: Concur Works
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: Ease of expense reporting, uploading receipts, approving multiple expense reports and the warning system for errors.
reviews.cons: The online travel booking features are slow, do not provide the same discounts, and have added travel fees.

reviews.title: What’s SAP Concur
reviews.name: Jackline A.
reviews.pros: SAP Concur automates repetitive accounting procedures that help save time and reduce financial errors.
reviews.cons: Apart from lack of some features in mobile application that are available in cloud apps, I do not have any other issue.

reviews.title: Expense Reporting made easy with Concur
reviews.name: Gene B.
reviews.pros: My corporate card expenses get preloaded into an expense report for me and the majority of the time have the correct expense category and details filled out which saves me time.
reviews.cons: Sometimes Concur is fussy when trying to use the mileage calculator. It insists on using the shortest route, not necessarily the route taken given consideration to traffic, accidents, etc.

reviews.title: Good tool for capturing and submitting expenses
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: Great tool for submitting expenses, I like the feature that automatically identifies the value of the receipt as you load it in.
reviews.cons: Can sometimes feel like there are too many steps to capture and submit an expense. It would be good if it automatically loaded the receipts into your existing claim without you having to do it yourself.

reviews.title: SAP Concur Review: Streamlining Expenses with Some Trade-Offs
reviews.name: Faisal M.
reviews.pros: I’ve used SAP Concur for managing travel and expenses, and it has its strengths along with a few drawbacks. Great Value for Money. Strong automation for expense capture and approvals •Reliable payment and reimbursement processing •Solid corporate card integration •Detailed, customizable reporting options •Saves time once workflows are set up
reviews.cons: Interface feels outdated and not always intuitive •Steeper learning curve for new users •Report generation can be time-consuming

reviews.title: Great mobile app
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: Very easy to use with the mobile app that allows you to upload receipts on the go and also check booked travel information.
reviews.cons: It can be cumbersome to work through expense reports with multiple different click throughs and flags to respond to.

reviews.title: Good for Tracking Expenses, but Could Be More User-Friendly
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: I like that SAP Concur keeps a history of all submitted expenses, making it easy to track past reports and reference previous submissions when needed.
reviews.cons: I find the expense process a bit disorganized. When an expense is returned, it’s not easy to see the details or understand the reason. It would also be helpful to have templates for recurring expenses. Adding expenses from outside the country I work in can be challenging, especially when using a credit card, since the final amount charged often differs from what’s entered in the system. A feature that allows you to capture and reconcile the actual credit card charge would make the process much smoother.

reviews.title: Easy interface that helps to organize expenses
reviews.name: Melissa S.
reviews.pros: What I like most about SAP Concur is the iPhone app. The interface is easy to use and allows me to keep ahead of my expense report during a business trip.
reviews.cons: What I like least about Concur is that uploading receipts can be glitchy. Often, photos of receipts do not appear after taken in the app. I always take an additional photo outside of the app as a backup.

reviews.title: Can't keep track? SAP Concur does it for you.
reviews.name:
Verified
Reviewer
reviews.pros: What I like most about SAP concur is that it keeps all my expenses in one place and identifies expenses that is tied into my e-mail. I also liked it ensures that I include all the required information for each expense and allows me to create different reports for different expenses.
reviews.cons: I am not a fan of SAP concurs AI tool that automatically pulls information from the receipt and puts it into each category because, in my experience, most of the time the information that the AI pulls from the receipt is not correct.

reviews.title: Good system
reviews.name: Victoria H.
reviews.pros: Easy to use and get reimbursements for company expenses and travel reimbursement as well so I liked it
reviews.cons: Uploading receipts to the system which I felt was outdated because you had to scan your receipts to provide proof

reviews.title: Good expense report tool
reviews.name: Chris T.
reviews.pros: Good mobile app which makes it easy to capture receipts with your phone camera. Concur scans the receipts and fills in the details. You can also forward any email receipts.
reviews.cons: It is my 2nd favorite expense report app behind Expensify. The features are basically the same, but I find Expensify more intuitive to use.

reviews.title: It gets the job done, but the interface is a bit complex to navigate/understand
reviews.name: Dave L.
reviews.pros: What I like most about Concur is it gives me a way to enter in my company expenses, keep track of them, and give me notifications every step along the way of it's review/approval process.
reviews.cons: The user interface is complicated. So much so now I no longer create new expenses from scratch... I copy a previous one because that's theonly way I know how to enter certain expenses.

reviews.title: Expense reporting fast and easy
reviews.name: Tammy W.
reviews.pros: We have used SAP Concur for a couple of years now and it has made our expense reporting fast and easy. The photos on the go for receipts has been invaluable.
reviews.cons: The only thing I don't like about SAP Concur is to have to do a header report summary. This is double work as all the same information can be found in each expense.

reviews.title: SAP Concur - A great expenses management software
reviews.name: Kanika B.
reviews.pros: Concur makes expenses seamless as it integrates with Uber and many other vendors to offer support across purchases and filing of receipts
reviews.cons: At some places, the software seems to jump off when it comes to stating GST or non GST option - it switches this to none and gives an error. Has happened to me a few times now

reviews.title: Iconic and Full-featured Accounting Program: SAP Concur
reviews.name: Dilak S.
reviews.pros: SAP Concur was straightforward to implement and use. I like that it makes it easy to create and customize invoices automatically.
reviews.cons: The mobile application is not available for download on  App Store but I acquired it from the vendor website.

reviews.title: What I Experience with SAP Concur
reviews.name: Joy I.
reviews.pros: SAP Concur allows me to save time by managing expenses automatically which also eradicates fraud.
reviews.cons: Mobile application on Android system lack some features available on cloud apps.

reviews.title: Still a strong performer
reviews.name: Suzanne D.
reviews.pros: Ease of use, simple to follow. This tool helps most payment and HR type functionality to z good standard
reviews.cons: With the use of modern technology it might be looking a little in need of AI visually, would suggest more options to be available
