reviews.title: SAP Business One Review from User, and former SAP sales employee
reviews.name: Mauricio L.
reviews.pros: SAP Business One is the best ERP in the world because it requires companies that adopt the software to change their processes and customs to align with the best practices that SAP has identified over years of working with the world's largest companies. This is a major step towards innovation and process digitization for effective business management. SAP Business One offers up to 13 native SAP modules, along with numerous proprietary and third-party applications that can be of great assistance in the effective management of your business.
reviews.cons: The downside of SAP Business One is the cost. This would be the overall cost. The annual maintenance cost is usually between 17% and 20% of the value of the total licenses you have acquired. The cost of these licenses is usually between $1,750 and $2,500. So, if your company has 50 employees and your total license cost is approximately $85,000, your annual maintenance renewal is approximately $14,450. In addition, SAP consulting is the most expensive of all consulting or professional services in the ERP world. Without a doubt, due to the high costs, you can find a good ERP that can help you save more.

reviews.title: Choosing an Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) software like SAP Business One
reviews.name: Aileen M.
reviews.pros: I like most about SAP Business One is how intelligently designed it is and easy to use. SAP Business One has user-friendly configuration that can easily used for entire company and even individual users.
reviews.cons: I like least about SAP Business One is the HR module, I believe this module can improve more due to luck of functionalities only but still easy to get additional fields and tables if needed as SAP Business One can do customization itself.

reviews.title: Highly recommend SAP B1
reviews.name: Andrea E.
reviews.pros: We found the transition to SAP B1 to be unexpectedly easy. Visual business maps (workflows, relationship maps) helped new users both learn the system initially as well as audit and follow through with order to cash processes long after we had learned the system. SAP B1 (along with OptiPro WMS) allows us to have clear visibility to our inventory throughout our 4-warehouse network, which in turn helps us better manage our purchasing. Lot control is far simpler than with other similar systems. We have room to grow within SAP B1, as we know there are many features we haven't yet implemented. Very happy with the customer support we receive as well.
reviews.cons: We don't find the standard layout for financial reports to align with our needs. While these reports can be customized, the output doesn't export well to Excel. Easy to work around this through a template we created. We feel that if this is our biggest "dislike", the product is pretty much a slam dunk for our business.

reviews.title: Overall SAP Business review
reviews.name: Andrés Felipe M.
reviews.pros: I like that you can automate accounting processes, and create financial reports, and also that it keeps track of sales leads are really useful, manages the customer database and monitors sales activities
reviews.cons: the price you pay monthly for me is a little expensive although it helps a lot with business so I continue paying, also I don´t like that for an upgrade or new feature you have to pay

reviews.title: Powerful functions and good results as it is a complete software.
reviews.name: Idaly M.
reviews.pros: The simplicity and integration that is SAP Business One is what attracts the attention of this software, the large number of modules is good, perfect for inventory, finance, it is a good ERP, CRM, it is excellent for accounting transactions, it is very customizable to our different needs.
reviews.cons: We have had no problems since we used it, nor has the price been an inconvenience nor have we had errors at any time.

reviews.title: Comprehensive Business Management for Small and Medium Enterprises
reviews.name: Zobaida A.
reviews.pros: SAP Business One offers integrated modules for various business functions including accounting, CRM, inventory management, purchasing, and sales, providing a comprehensive solution for small and medium-sized enterprises. SAP Business One provides real-time data analytics and reporting capabilities, allowing users to make informed decisions based on up-to-date information, improving agility and responsiveness. Also, SAP Business One integrates seamlessly with other SAP products as well as third-party applications, facilitating interoperability and data exchange between different systems.
reviews.cons: The software can be complex to implement and configure, requiring specialized expertise and resources. Training and change management efforts may also be necessary to ensure effective adoption by users.

reviews.title: For Automation
reviews.name: Joel Neil W.
reviews.pros: Excellent in end to end automation and critical in real-time reporting. Integrates with every SAP product, especially data from Concur transfers easily and smoothly. Haven't seen any mistakes and every transaction can be traced. And on the other hand, getting support from customer service works, also lots of users in forums helps when stuck somewhere.
reviews.cons: Instead of personalisation, making a default screen for everybody in the same company, and even in the same team would be better. Each time I see another user with same system, it feels like I am using another system. Even the colours may vary, that's frustrating sometimes.

reviews.title: Easy to use with almost complete functionality
reviews.name: Rom Rulida -.
reviews.pros: SAP Business One is an ERP System that is designed for Small and Medium Entities. With a highly interactive Graphical User Interface (GUI), it allows users to easily navigate the system within a few minutes of using it. Another good feature of SAP Business One is how it divided the different business functions by modules which allow a point-and-click capability to users. Unlike its more complex counterpart, SAP All-in-One, SAP Business One removed the need to use T-codes which is a huge advantage for users who are not particular in memorizing hundreds of codes to process transactions. With that in mind, SAP Business One still covers almost all of the fundamental business process of entities along with the capability to be customized using Table and Fields Management Queries.
reviews.cons: Considering that it is an ERP Software, the adaption of Generally Accepted Accounting Principles is not fully maximized. Users that are particular in accounting might notice that some of the journal entries are not in accordance with the applicable standard in their country. This is due to the fact that there's only a limited option when it comes to the Chart of Account to be used as well as the customization of accounts.

reviews.title: My personal view of SAP Business One
reviews.name: Kenneth F.
reviews.pros: SAP Business One's interface was easy to use and intuitive. It was simple to use and understand, and it provided me with quick and easy access to the data and reports I required for my business. It was also extremely customizable, allowing me to tailor the system to my specific requirements. Finally, the assistance I received was outstanding and extremely beneficial.
reviews.cons: The cost of SAP Business One is the least like feature. SAP Business One is a powerful enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, but it can be costly to implement and maintain. Furthermore, the software requires a certain level of technical knowledge and understanding to be used properly, which can be a challenge for some businesses.

reviews.title: Sap business one – Grow your business
reviews.name: Adam G.
reviews.pros: In my experience SAP Business One is a fairly versatile ERP software designed for small and medium-sized businesses. What impresses me most is its wide range of functions, from procurement and inventory management to production suport, I personally have used it mostly for sales and accounting.
reviews.cons: In my experience with SAP Business One, there are several factors that need to be improved. First of all, the cost is expensive, It represents a substantial initial investment, especially for smaller businesses.

reviews.title: One of the best business ERP solution
reviews.name: smit s.
reviews.pros: SAP AG is Germany based company who has developed business integrated ERP software which cater all your business requirement. 1. SAP has different modules within the software like material management, sales and Distribution, fixed asset etc which very well integrates with each other and helps to provide in depth solution for all business requirement. 2. SAP has ability to maintain complete audit trail, which helps the business user to fix the accountability of each user. 3. Data analysis is the one of the best feature that ultimately helps the business to take effective decisions. 4. User security, user authorization system is also added advantage which helps in managing authorized access to any system data.
reviews.cons: 1. SAP is mainly suitable for large enterprises having employees strength more that 300-400, and where all roles and responsibility of the uses is clearly identified. 2. Its implementation cost and maintenance cost is high and sufficient training is also required to be given to all concerned users. 3. it is essential to have separate team who can help the user to solve all the issues related to SAP or some agency needs to be hired for such problems, which ultimately increases the cost of company. 4. Unless the roles and responsibility are not clearly identified there is no much benefit of the so called ERP solution. 5. In nutshell unless the company has good employee size and business then only SAP is suitable.

reviews.title: Excellent product! Been using it since 1999.
reviews.name: Michael G.
reviews.pros: We have been using Syspro since 1999 and have found it to be an excellent product to run our business. We utilize Syspro to run all of our domestic and international business and to seamlessly tie our businesses together. At any point and time we have complete visibility across the entire business. We use almost all of the core component modules (accounting, inventory, sales, WIP, Purchasing, etc.) that Syspro offers and we find the software fast, stable and extremely accurate. This is the thing I like best about this product; that it is extremely stable and accurate. I would think anyone in the market for an ERP would consider this a number one criteria and I have seen too often where other products miss this mark. With Syspro, I have found that things just work. I run a distributed system across a WAN with many users in different locations; and everything works and ties out. I rarely have any issue with the functionality of Syspro. A close second to its stability is its openness of its data. There are numerous applications that we have written to augment functionality to closer align the software with how we conduct business. This is only possible because we are able to access the data utilizing their E.NET features which allows us to execute transactions without bypassing the business logic.
reviews.cons: We are a 24 hour shop situated across the globe. Because of this, we have users in the system effectively all the time. End of Month closures and balancing functions require exclusive access in order to perform those functions. It would be better if we could perform those functions without exclusivity of the databases.

reviews.title: A very comprehensive ERP solution for a variety of small to medium size companies.
reviews.name: Alan H.
reviews.pros: SysPro is a complete ERP solution for both distribution and manufacturing companies, which is my experience with this software. However, I don't see any reason why a service company cannot use this product as the software is licensed by the module and overall implementation can be custom tailored to the needs of each organization. The accounting and finance section is robust and complete and the general ledger can serve large organizations. Inventory and warehouse menaagement are comprehensive and should only require minor customization for most companies that use it. I imagine most of the customization can be done in-house using the power-tailoring capabilities. Another powerful set of features allow each user to have a custom and unique user interface with only the needed functionality and using personalized colors, fonts, and other graphics.
reviews.cons: Browsing capability is limited to a relatively small number of records if you don't want to wait a very long time to see results. Alternatively, you can query the data you need using MS-Query or SQL Server Management Studio to get quick and accurate results. Many of the system reports are not very useful. Here again, you can design your own reports or use your own queries.

reviews.title: User-friendly and Easy to Customize
reviews.name: Thomas J.
reviews.pros: The software is easy to navigate and use and contains everything we need out of an ERP. In situations where more complex or different functionality is needed, Syspro makes it very easy to integrate with third-party softwares. There are lots of companies that offer Syspro integration out of the box, and the user base is a great community. There are also lots of customization options within Syspro that allow you to tailor the product to your company's needs without worry of those customizations not being supported by the software or the next upgrade. Administration of the software also is pretty easy.
reviews.cons: If you don't run the latest version of the software that supports the browser-based interface, remote use for sales people is a little clunkier since you would have to access a windows PC either via VPN or remote desktop. But the browser-based product seems like it will work much better on mobile devices on the go.

reviews.title: Excellent product! Been using it since 1999.
reviews.name: Michael G.
reviews.pros: We have been using Syspro since 1999 and have found it to be an excellent product to run our business. We utilize Syspro to run all of our domestic and international business and to seamlessly tie our businesses together. At any point and time we have complete visibility across the entire business. We use almost all of the core component modules (accounting, inventory, sales, WIP, Purchasing, etc.) that Syspro offers and we find the software fast, stable and extremely accurate. This is the thing I like best about this product; that it is extremely stable and accurate. I would think anyone in the market for an ERP would consider this a number one criteria and I have seen too often where other products miss this mark. With Syspro, I have found that things just work. I run a distributed system across a WAN with many users in different locations; and everything works and ties out. I rarely have any issue with the functionality of Syspro. A close second to its stability is its openness of its data. There are numerous applications that we have written to augment functionality to closer align the software with how we conduct business. This is only possible because we are able to access the data utilizing their E.NET features which allows us to execute transactions without bypassing the business logic.
reviews.cons: We are a 24 hour shop situated across the globe. Because of this, we have users in the system effectively all the time. End of Month closures and balancing functions require exclusive access in order to perform those functions. It would be better if we could perform those functions without exclusivity of the databases.

reviews.title: A very comprehensive ERP solution for a variety of small to medium size companies.
reviews.name: Alan H.
reviews.pros: SysPro is a complete ERP solution for both distribution and manufacturing companies, which is my experience with this software. However, I don't see any reason why a service company cannot use this product as the software is licensed by the module and overall implementation can be custom tailored to the needs of each organization. The accounting and finance section is robust and complete and the general ledger can serve large organizations. Inventory and warehouse menaagement are comprehensive and should only require minor customization for most companies that use it. I imagine most of the customization can be done in-house using the power-tailoring capabilities. Another powerful set of features allow each user to have a custom and unique user interface with only the needed functionality and using personalized colors, fonts, and other graphics.
reviews.cons: Browsing capability is limited to a relatively small number of records if you don't want to wait a very long time to see results. Alternatively, you can query the data you need using MS-Query or SQL Server Management Studio to get quick and accurate results. Many of the system reports are not very useful. Here again, you can design your own reports or use your own queries.

reviews.title: User-friendly and Easy to Customize
reviews.name: Thomas J.
reviews.pros: The software is easy to navigate and use and contains everything we need out of an ERP. In situations where more complex or different functionality is needed, Syspro makes it very easy to integrate with third-party softwares. There are lots of companies that offer Syspro integration out of the box, and the user base is a great community. There are also lots of customization options within Syspro that allow you to tailor the product to your company's needs without worry of those customizations not being supported by the software or the next upgrade. Administration of the software also is pretty easy.
reviews.cons: If you don't run the latest version of the software that supports the browser-based interface, remote use for sales people is a little clunkier since you would have to access a windows PC either via VPN or remote desktop. But the browser-based product seems like it will work much better on mobile devices on the go.

reviews.title: Great Product
reviews.name: Joanne M.
reviews.pros: Sales Order Processing for adding orders
reviews.cons: Reports are limited when trying to pull information out

reviews.title: Syspro Review
reviews.name: Olga B.
reviews.pros: It's good at managing inventory, keeping track of everything and providing reporting into excel that allows one to work in and create and look for whatever is needed.
reviews.cons: I found it at first a little hard to know how to use it, I found I would accidentally delete fields in my search area screen and not know how I did it and how to get it back. But other than that once you know how to use it, its fairly user friendly.

reviews.title: Big Product for Big Business
reviews.name: Timothy Y.
reviews.pros: It's a massive piece of software with enormous capability.
reviews.cons: Highly technical and can be very difficult to use. Requires a lot of training and setup, and lots of support to maintain and troubleshoot. Not very user-friendly.

reviews.title: ERP Solution for Small/Mid-Size Organization
reviews.name: Anthony G.
reviews.pros: This is an ideal enterprise resource planning (ERP) solution for small to mid-size manufacturers and distributors.
reviews.cons: We had a tumultuous implementation experience, primarily due to the third-party vendor, but afterwards it was fine.

reviews.title: Expensive to purchase, setup, and maintain.
reviews.name: Chip M.
reviews.pros: A plethora of functionality and data collected. Can perform modifications of limited functionality by user.
reviews.cons: Very expensive to setup and maintain the data. Requires constant technical support for users and data.

reviews.title: Great All Around ERP
reviews.name: Jessica D.
reviews.pros: I love the stability. The software runs without major issues. If an issue does arise there are multiple outlets to look for help; forums online as well as VAR and Direct Syspro Support. The software covers everything we do, from purchasing to sales, customer and inventory management, it does it all.
reviews.cons: Sometimes you have to rely on an outside product like Access to get more detailed reports than what is provided. If you have someone on site who knows and understands how databases work then you're ahead of the game. If not, your VAR can help a lot in this area.

reviews.title: SYSPRO Review
reviews.name: Anne C.
reviews.pros: Syspro integrated all the necessary information as you need it. I like how I handle its customization feature to be more understandable.
reviews.cons: A little limited based on its features. Fixing on some updates should be properly affixed to be more competitive.

reviews.title: Syspro has been our work-horse for 16+ years!
reviews.name: John S.
reviews.pros: The support is great and they are always enhancing the product. Our CRR is awesome and very helpful. The manufacturing side is great and the BOM function works very well with formulas and batching in the food industry. The lot functions and traceability is great as well.
reviews.cons: Having to upgrade our custom modifications every time there is a major release. This is self-inflicted somewhat.. but it keeps us behind in the upgrade cycle. And the custom programming is expensive!

reviews.title: Accounting Manager/Controller
reviews.name: Lonna B.
reviews.pros: Flexibility, detail. You can use the mass options it offers or just the ones you need. I am sure we could use more than we do. You have support you can use as much or as little as you need. I have used Syspro for 20 years. I am still happy with the choice for accounting, inventory and manufacturing.
reviews.cons: We did require special detail down costing. NOT available on any software. Manual not as user friendly as it could be. Updates are not automatic.

reviews.title: Best value for a small business.
reviews.name: Anne G.
reviews.pros: Syspro is highly customizable and can be configured to fit just about any business structure, from process manufacturing to ecommerce retail. The online help is robust, and the online forums are available for technical help.
reviews.cons: The downside of the product being highly customizable is that configuration must be well planned and well thought out prior and during implementation. A bad implementation can lead to a bad experience with this product.

reviews.title: Excellent ERP software
reviews.name: Matt C.
reviews.pros: Very comprehensive ERP software with a lot of capabilities and customization opportunities
reviews.cons: The permissions are very complicated. This is both a positive and a negative. There are many options for different user tiers, which is a good thing, but it can be difficult to find exactly what you are trying to give access to a particular user and sometimes they overlap in multiple places. Some kind of wizard would be helpful.

reviews.title: SYSPRO GROWS WITH US
reviews.name: SUSAN K.
reviews.pros: As our company grows our technology needs change. Syspro meets our demands and grows with us. Syspro vendors have an array of experts to assist users in creating system solutions, both simple and complex. Syspro provides us with the "edge" we need to be competitive in a rapidly changing market place.
reviews.cons: The product is so feature rich that I know we can take better use of it. We have just scratch the surface.

reviews.title: Syspro Software Review
reviews.name: Jeff T.
reviews.pros: The software is flexible enough to be tailored to meet your needs. Many customizable fields and functions and access to the data through ODBC connectivity allows users to report on data and update as necessary. The vendor is very responsive to the needs of the user and quick to resolve issues that are presented.
reviews.cons: Help files could be a bit more detailed for individual fields in the system.

reviews.title: Intuitive and flexible
reviews.name: Janice P.
reviews.pros: Syspro is highly intuitive and offers an impressive level of customizability. Several of our staff members who've come from companies that use other ERP applications have remarked about how comparatively quickly and easily they've learned Syspro.
reviews.cons: Some add-ins offer surprisingly little functionality for the relatively high price tag.

reviews.title: Syspro, A leader in software systems
reviews.name: Glenn S.
reviews.pros: The flexibility to view information differently by user as well as the quickness of the system to retrieve information or statistics.
reviews.cons: We have issues from time to time recently with the updating of JAVA and it's interfacing smoothly with the Syspro SRS system. It requires some additional editing on our part when JAVA updates.

reviews.pros: I love the stability. The software runs without major issues. If an issue does arise there are multiple outlets to look for help; forums online as well as VAR and Direct Syspro Support. The software covers everything we do, from purchasing to sales, customer and inventory management, it does it all.
reviews.cons: Sometimes you have to rely on an outside product like Access to get more detailed reports than what is provided. If you have someone on site who knows and understands how databases work then you're ahead of the game. If not, your VAR can help a lot in this area.

reviews.title: SYSPRO Review
reviews.name: Anne C.
reviews.pros: Syspro integrated all the necessary information as you need it. I like how I handle its customization feature to be more understandable.
reviews.cons: A little limited based on its features. Fixing on some updates should be properly affixed to be more competitive.

reviews.title: Syspro has been our work-horse for 16+ years!
reviews.name: John S.
reviews.pros: The support is great and they are always enhancing the product. Our CRR is awesome and very helpful. The manufacturing side is great and the BOM function works very well with formulas and batching in the food industry. The lot functions and traceability is great as well.
reviews.cons: Having to upgrade our custom modifications every time there is a major release. This is self-inflicted somewhat.. but it keeps us behind in the upgrade cycle. And the custom programming is expensive!

reviews.title: Accounting Manager/Controller
reviews.name: Lonna B.
reviews.pros: Flexibility, detail. You can use the mass options it offers or just the ones you need. I am sure we could use more than we do. You have support you can use as much or as little as you need. I have used Syspro for 20 years. I am still happy with the choice for accounting, inventory and manufacturing.
reviews.cons: We did require special detail down costing. NOT available on any software. Manual not as user friendly as it could be. Updates are not automatic.

reviews.title: Best value for a small business.
reviews.name: Anne G.
reviews.pros: Syspro is highly customizable and can be configured to fit just about any business structure, from process manufacturing to ecommerce retail. The online help is robust, and the online forums are available for technical help.
reviews.cons: The downside of the product being highly customizable is that configuration must be well planned and well thought out prior and during implementation. A bad implementation can lead to a bad experience with this product.

reviews.title: Excellent ERP software
reviews.name: Matt C.
reviews.pros: Very comprehensive ERP software with a lot of capabilities and customization opportunities
reviews.cons: The permissions are very complicated. This is both a positive and a negative. There are many options for different user tiers, which is a good thing, but it can be difficult to find exactly what you are trying to give access to a particular user and sometimes they overlap in multiple places. Some kind of wizard would be helpful.

reviews.title: SYSPRO GROWS WITH US
reviews.name: SUSAN K.
reviews.pros: As our company grows our technology needs change. Syspro meets our demands and grows with us. Syspro vendors have an array of experts to assist users in creating system solutions, both simple and complex. Syspro provides us with the "edge" we need to be competitive in a rapidly changing market place.
reviews.cons: The product is so feature rich that I know we can take better use of it. We have just scratch the surface.

reviews.title: Syspro Software Review
reviews.name: Jeff T.
reviews.pros: The software is flexible enough to be tailored to meet your needs. Many customizable fields and functions and access to the data through ODBC connectivity allows users to report on data and update as necessary. The vendor is very responsive to the needs of the user and quick to resolve issues that are presented.
reviews.cons: Help files could be a bit more detailed for individual fields in the system.

reviews.title: Intuitive and flexible
reviews.name: Janice P.
reviews.pros: Syspro is highly intuitive and offers an impressive level of customizability. Several of our staff members who've come from companies that use other ERP applications have remarked about how comparatively quickly and easily they've learned Syspro.
reviews.cons: Some add-ins offer surprisingly little functionality for the relatively high price tag.

reviews.title: Syspro, A leader in software systems
reviews.name: Glenn S.
reviews.pros: The flexibility to view information differently by user as well as the quickness of the system to retrieve information or statistics.
reviews.cons: We have issues from time to time recently with the updating of JAVA and it's interfacing smoothly with the Syspro SRS system. It requires some additional editing on our part when JAVA updates.

reviews.title: Syspro Review
reviews.name: Joseph W.
reviews.pros: Syspro has made efforts to help us move forward. I oversee three companies and each one has a different business plan. Syspro works with all three with minimal problems.
reviews.cons: The support can be hard to reach at times. They do call back but the main issues is that I am east coast and they are west coast.

reviews.title: Great product
reviews.name: Payman S.
reviews.pros: We are a manufacturing company and we have a complicated Inventory. Syspro is a great program for managing our inventory. It also has a great product configurator. All other modules works very well too.
reviews.cons: Syspro constantly has updates and I wished the updates would install automatically.
